śiraḥ prabhṛti pāṭyante ghoraiḥ karmabhir ātmajaiḥ / khādayanti svamāṃsāni pāyayanti svaśoṇitam
annaṃ pānaṃ na dattaṃ yair mūḍhair nāpy anumoditam / ikṣuvatte prapīḍyante jarjarīkṛtya mudgaraiḥ
asitālavane ghore chidyante khaṇḍakhaṇḍaśaḥ / sūcībhir bhinnasarvāṅgās tataḥ śūle praropitāḥ
cācalyamānāḥ kṛṣyante na mriyante tathāpi ca / dehād utpāṭyate māṃsaṃ teṣām asthīni mudgaraiḥ
bahuśaḥ kṛṣyate tūrṇaṃ yamadūtair balotkaṭaiḥ / te 'nucchvāsenānuchvāsās tiṣṭhanti narake ciram
ucchvāse ca sadocchvāsā bālukāvadanāvṛtāḥ / rauraveṣu tu dante vai pīḍyante vividhaiś caraiḥ
mahārauravapīḍābhir mahānto 'pi rudanti hi / upasthāsye gude pārśve pāde corasi mastake
nihanyante bhaṭais tīkṣṇaiḥ sutaptair lohamudgaraiḥ / nindanti ye svarūpeṇa paradārān hasanti ca
āliṅganti patīn anyān na vindanti svakān striyaḥ / kimu dhāvasi vegena na smarer atiśāśvatīm
vañcitaś ca tvayā bhartā pāpāndhaś ca yathā sukham / lohakumbhe vinikṣiptāḥ citāś ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ
samṛddhāgnau prapācyante praveśyante śilāsu ca / kṣipyante cāndhakūpeṣu daśyante 'jagarair bhṛśam
ye nindanti mahātmānam ācāryaṃ dharmardarśinam / śivabhaktaṃ ca vipraṃ ca śivadharmaṃ ca śāśvatam
teṣām urasi kaṇṭhe ca jihvāyāṃ dehasandhiṣu / kīlakairoṣṭhapuṭake kīlyante yamakiṅkaraiḥ
evam ādimahāghorā yātanāḥ pāpakarmiṇām / ekaika narake jñeyāḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
yātanā gahanā rājan sarveṣāṃ pāpakarmiṇām / ityeva yātanānantāḥ sarveṣu narakeṣu ca
kastā varṣaśatenāpi vaktuṃ śaknoti mānavaḥ / ity evaṃ vividhair ghoraiḥ pātyamānāḥ svakarmabhiḥ
kramāt sarveṣu pacyante narakeṣu na saṃśayaḥ / mahāpātakinaś cāpi sarveṣu narakeṣu ca
ācandratārakaṃ yāvat pīḍyante vividhaiś caraiḥ / tathā pātakinaḥ sarve nirayeṣv eṣu sarvadā
caturdikṣu supacyante narakeṣu na saṃśayaḥ / upapātakinaś cāpi tadarddhaṃ yānti mānavāḥ
mṛtyur na jñāyate tāta kadā kasya bhaviṣyati / prāpte cākasmike mṛtyau varṣaṃ vindati ko naraḥ
parityajya yataḥ sarvam ekākī yāsyasi dhruvam / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena satyadharmaparo bhava
etat te sarvamākhyātaṃ narakāṇā tu lakṣaṇam

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narakāyātanānuvarṇano nāma tripañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 54 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: tīryate kena dharmeṇa saṃsārābdhiḥ sudustaraḥ / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tena nirbhartsitaiḥ pāpaiḥ kathyamānāṃ kathāṃ śṛṇu
rakto mūḍhaś ca loko 'yam akārye saṃpravartate / na cātmānaṃ vijānāti na paraṃ na ca daivatam
na śṛṇoti paraṃ śreyaḥ sati cakṣuṣi nekṣate / same pathi śanair gacchan plavate sma pade pade
evam ukto dharmarājaḥ saṃkṣepāt pāpadehinām / vistareṇa yadā cakhyau teṣāṃ tac chṛṇu sāmpratam
yama uvāca: mayā mukto na jānāti bodhyamāno budhair api / saṃsāre kliśyate nānā rāgalobhavaśāt naraḥ
garbhapātena bhāvena śāstram uktaṃ na budhyate / narair na śrūyate karma svargamokṣaprasādhakam
santapyati śivadhyāne sarvakāmārthasādhane / narakād ātmanaḥ śreyo yadatra mahadadbhutam
pretabhūtā narāḥ sarve yamalokaṃ samāgatāḥ / ākhyānaṃ kathayiṣyāmi yathoddiṣṭaṃ purātanam
sūryeṇa kathitaṃ tv āsīn narmadākhyānam uttamam / devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca mama pitrānukampayā
sapādalakṣam adhikaṃ brahmaṇā kathitaṃ raveḥ / tatra śrutaṃ mayā kṛtsnaṃ brahmaṇā tu śivāc chrutam
śivena kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ pārvatyāḥ ṣaṇmukhasya tu / jambūdvīpaṃ samāsādya mānuṣīṃ yonim āśritaḥ
nāśrayennarmadāṃ devīṃ saptakalpavahāṃ tu yaḥ / snānāvagāhanāt pānāt tathā dānakriyādibhiḥ
loke 'smin gatidā kānyā pāpopahatacetasām / ye dhyāyanti mahādevīṃ narmadāṃ pāpahāriṇīm
aghāni teṣāṃ naśyanti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā / narmadāṃ saṃsmared yas tu kīrtayed yas tu vā girā
paralokaṃ samāyāto yamadūtair na bādhyate / narmadāṃ kīrtayed yas tu pāpakarmā narādhamaḥ
narakān samayoddiṣṭān na ca krāmati karhicit / gaṅgādyāḥ saritastatra tīrthakoṭir anekadhā
revātejaḥ pratāpena śuddhiṃ gacchanti tatkṣaṇāt / narakasthaḥ smared yas tu mekalāṃ tu haraṃ harim
mucyate yamadūtaiḥ sa tatkṣaṇān nātra saṃśayaḥ / yadi tiṣṭhati vaidūryaparvate 'marakaṇṭake
oṃkāraḥ parameśāno bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ / kimarthaṃ tv iha śocanti pāpopahatacetasaḥ
siddheśvaraṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ lokānugrahakārakam / yajñeśvaraṃ ca madhye tu tatraiva śaśibhūṣaṇam
narmadā dakṣiṇe bhāge liṅgaṃ caiva maheśvaram / caturthaṃ kapileśaṃ ca śivakṣetraṃ vidurbudhāḥ
ye 'rcayanti sadā bhaktyā puṣpadhūpārtitarpaṇaiḥ / śivalokaṃ tu te yānti narakān nātra saṃśayaḥ
etat te sarvam ākhyātaṃ yathā pṛṣṭaṃ tvayānagha / pāpiṣṭhān nṝnadharmasthān kathayāmāsa bhārata (?)
[steht so dort] godānaṃ hemadānaṃ ca tiladānaṃ tathaiva ca / annadānaṃ payodānaṃ sarvopaskaram eva ca
prāsādārāmadānaṃ ca ye kurvanti narottamāḥ / yamalokaṃ na te yānti narakaṃ ghorarūpiṇam
mucyante sarvapāpebhyaḥ śivasya vacanaṃ yathā / sanmānaṃ cāpamānena viyogeneṣṭasaṅgamam
yauvanaṃ jarayā grastaṃ kaṣṭāt saukhyamupadrutam / valibhiḥ palitaiś cāpi jarjarīkṛtavigrahaḥ
kiṃ karoti naraḥ prājño jarayā jarjarīkṛtaḥ / strīpuṃsor yauvanaṃ rūpaṃ yadanyo 'nyaṃ priyaṃkaram
tad eva jarayā grastam ubhayor api na priyam / apūrvavat tathātmānaṃ śaithilyena samanvitam
yaḥ paśyan na virajyeta ko 'nyas tasmād acetanaḥ / jarābhibhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ patnīputrādibāndhavaiḥ
aśaktatvād durācārair bhṛtyaiś ca paribhūyate / dharmam arthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ na jarayā yutaḥ
śaktaḥ sādhayituṃ tasmāt purā dharmaṃ samācaret / vātapittakaphādīnāṃ vaiṣamyaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira
vātādīnāṃ samūhaś ca dehajaḥ parikīrtitaḥ / tasmād vyādhiparaṃ jñeyaṃ śarīram idam ātmanaḥ
vātotpatty atirekeṇa bādhito vai jvareṇa ca / rogair nānāvidhibhavair bahuduḥkhāny anekadhā
tāni ca svātmavedyāni kim anyat kathayāmy aham / ekottaraṃ mṛtyuśatam asmin dehe pratiṣṭhitam
atraikaṃ kālarūpaṃ ca śeṣāstvāgantavaḥ smṛtāḥ / ye tv ihāgantavaḥ proktāste praśāmyanti bhaiṣajaiḥ
japahomapradānaiś ca kālamṛtyur na śāmyati / apamṛtyuś ca sarvasya viṣam adyādisambhavaḥ
na cātipuruṣas tasmād apamṛtyor babheti vai / vividhā vyādhayaḥ kaṣṭāḥ savaidyāḥ prāṇinas tathā
viṣāṇi tv abhicārāś ca mṛtyor dvārāṇi dehinām / pīḍitaṃ rogasarpādyair api dhanvantariḥ svayam
svasthaṃ kartuṃ na śaknoti kālaprāptaṃ hi dehinam / naiṣadhaṃ na tapo dānaṃ na mitrāṇi na bāndhavāḥ
paritrātuṃ no samarthāḥ kālena paripīḍitam / nāsti mṛtyusamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti mṛtyusamo ripuḥ
nāsti mṛtyusamaḥ kālaḥ sarveṣām eva dehinām / sadbhāryā putramitrāṇi rājyaiśvaryasukhāni ca
mṛtyuśchinatti sarvāṇi vividhāny api bhārata / idaṃ te kathitaṃ rājañjñātisaṃsāradustaram
pariṇāma iti jñātvā sarvaṅkālasya bhojanam / tasmāt sarvaprayatnena saṃsevyā saptakalpagā
sarvaduḥkhāpahā nityaṃ sarvaśokavināśinī / yo yān kāmayate kāmāṃstāṃstān devī prayacchati
idaṃ jñānam idaṃ dhyānaṃ pāṇḍityaṃ veda vedanam / nivāsaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sevyate saptakalpagā
yajño dānaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam / saphalaṃ labhate teṣāṃ yo revāmbu niṣevate
brahmakūrcasahasrāṇi somapānāyutaṃ tathā / narmadātoyapānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm
saṃyukto 'pi mahāpāpair nānājanmakṛtair api / oṃkāradakṣiṇe ghoraṃ mucyate tatkṣaṇāj japan
godānānna paraṃ dānaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / narmadāpayasi snātvā yo dadyād gāṃ dvijanmane
saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ yathāvac ca na devair api śakyate

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe karmagatiyamavākyaṃ nāma catuṣpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 55 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: dhenuḥ katividhā proktā kasmin kāle ca dīyate / sarvopaskarasaṃyuktā tvatta icchāmi veditum
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan mahābāho kathyamānaṃ nibodha me / kathayāmi tavākhyānam ādikalpe kṛte yuge
cakravartī śaśāṅko 'bhūt sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / na ca varṇayituṃ śakyaḥ satyadharmavrate sthitaḥ
bubhuje sa mahīmetāmekacchatrāṃ samāhitaḥ / navakhaṇḍāṃ saptadvīpā yathā śakro 'marāvatīm
hariścandrasya tasyāpi saṃvādaś cakravartinaḥ / hariścandraḥ kurukṣetre gavām ayutam uttamam
hemabhāramalaṅkārasarvaratnavibhūṣitam / brahmarṣir mudgalo nāma svayaṃ brahma pratiṣṭhitaḥ
mudgalāś ca dvijāḥ sarve satyadharmaparāyaṇāḥ / śatamaṣṭottaraṃ sāgraṃ brāhmaṇā brahmavādinaḥ
hariścandro dadau tebhyo rāhusūryasamāgame / dvijān sampūjya vidhicchraddhayā parayā yutaḥ
arcayitvā maheśānaṃ sthānaṃ paramasiddhidam / cakrapāṇiṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ mudā paramayā yutaḥ
sarasvatyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha tiladarbhānvitasya tu / dānasyāsya prabhāveṇa lokāstenākhilā jitāḥ
antarikṣe purī prāptā sarvalokamanoharā / hariścandrapurī khyātā sā 'smil loke carācare
satyadānasarvatyāgair ityādibhir alaṃkṛtaḥ / hariścandrasamo rājā na bhūto na bhaviṣyati
evaṃ gāthā purā gītā śakrādyaiḥ surasattamaiḥ / śaśāṅko 'pyakarot sarvaṃ narmadātīramāśritaḥ
dānaṃ yajña tapaḥ satyaṃ parvate 'marakaṇṭake / dadau cārdhaprasūtāṃ brāhmaṇāya mahātmane
dānasyāsya prabhāveṇa hariścandrādhiko 'bhavat / anekabhāvikaṃ pāpaṃ dagdhvā tūlaughavacchikhī
yāvad vatsasya pādau dvau mukhaṃ yonau pradṛśyate / tāvad gauḥ pṛthivī jñeyā saśailavanakānanā
svarṇaśṛṅgī raupyakhurī savatsā kāṃsyadohanā / narmadāsnānayuktā tu sakuśā tilasaṃyutā
oṃkārāmarayor madhye koṭitīrthe narādhipaḥ / etāḥ sahasrasakhyātā brāhmaṇebhyo nyavedayat
etasminn antare nedurdevadundubhayo divi / tatkṣaṇād yānam ārūḍho jvalan maṇigaṇair iva
stūyamānaḥ samīpasthair asaṃkhyātair vimānibhiḥ / dhṛtasvarṇātapatras tu vījyamānas tu cāmaraiḥ
yojanānāṃ sahasreṇa hariścandro 'py adhaḥ sthitaḥ / tad dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ karma śaśāṅkasya viśāmpateḥ
sa vinindya kurukṣetraṃ vismayāviṣṭacetanaḥ / mahānadyāṃ śaśāṅkena rāhusomasamāgame
dattaṃ dānaṃ na sāmānyaṃ bhaved iti samāsataḥ / viṣaṇṇavadano bhūtvā hariścandro nṛpottamaḥ
brahmalokaṃ gataḥ kṣipraṃ yatra lokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ / abhivādya yathā nyāyaṃ papraccha sa pitāmaham
dānena nirjitā devāḥ śaśāṅkena mahātmanā / kiṃ ca puṇyamidaṃ brahman kurukṣetrād viśiṣyate
amareśvaratīrthaṃ tu nāma revāsamudbhavam / kenāpi na samaṃ bhūtam uparyupari dīpyate
iti śrutvā vacas tasya hariścandrasya dhīmataḥ / uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā hariścandraṃ nṛpottamam
viṣādaṃ tyaja rājendra gahanā karmaṇāṃ gatiḥ / śaśāṅkasadṛśo rājā na dṛṣṭo na śruto mayā
evaṃ vaktuṃ na yogyo 'haṃ na devāpi savāsavāḥ / anekāni sahasrāṇi purā vai cakravartinā
iṣṭāni ca vidhānena parvate 'marakaṇṭake / rāhusūryasamāyoge tīrthalakṣāṇi bhārata
sarasvatīṃ kurukṣetraṃ puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā / tīrthāny etāni cānyāni snānaṃ kartuṃ samāyayuḥ
mekalāyāṃ hariścandra koṭitīrthe narādhipa / tīrthānāṃ tyaja rājendra sāmyaṃ mekalayā saha
vārāṇasyā kurukṣetraṃ tolitaṃ ca mayā purā / tīrthāni na samaṃ yānti tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ
khyātamātraṃ kurukṣetraṃ lokayātrāpravartakam / purāṇaṃ na śrutaṃ yais tu mithyājñānasamanvitaiḥ
sevyatāṃ kalpagā devī yadīcchet paramaṃ padam / namaskṛtya vidhātāram ayodhyādhipatis tadā
mudā paramayā yuktaḥ sa yayāv amareśvaram / etat sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yathāvat tava suvrata
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro rājan gosahasraphalaṃ labhet

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe godānamahimānuvarṇano nāma pañcapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 56 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: māhiṣmatyāḥ paścime vai tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ param / aśokavanikā nāma sarvaśokavināśanam
snātvā tatrārcayed gaurīṃ yathā vibhavavistaraiḥ / mātaṅgasyāśrama tadvat siddhagandharvasevitam
śuklakṛṣṇātṛtīyāyāṃ gandhadhūpavilepanaiḥ / upahārair anekaiś ca dīpamālāprabodhanaiḥ
tatra yā pūjayen nārī gaurīṃ bhaktisamanvitā / rūpasaubhāgyasampannaṃ labhate satpatiṃ tu sā
kārttikyāṃ tu gataprāṇā modamānā tu saṃyatā / asya tīrthasya māhātmyāt prāptā māheśvaraṃ puram
mātaṅgo nāma devarṣiḥ purākalpe yudhiṣṭhira / narmadātīramāśritya tapas tepe suduṣkaram
purā janmaniṣādaḥ sa jātiṃ smarati pūrvikām / aghamarṣaṇadeśasthaḥ sarvadharma bubodha ca
maharṣīṇāṃ prasaṅgena narmadādarśanena ca / pāpabuddhiṃ parityajya dharmabuddhiṃ cakāra saḥ
nirviṇṇo 'haṃ ca bhikṣuś cādhunā śvapacayoniṣu / evam uktvā tato rājann aśokavanikāṃ gataḥ
jaṭāvalkaladhārī ca kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu śivārādhanatatparaḥ
śivadhyānaparaḥ so 'bhūd ugre tapasi saṃsthitaḥ / divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ hi tathā tasya tapasyataḥ
ekāśītisahasrāṇi jaṭāgrebhyo viniḥsmṛtāḥ / svayaṃ patanti vividhā narmadātoyam adhyataḥ
tatkṣaṇād yakṣiṇīrūpā anantāś cāpramāṇikāḥ / śyāmavarṇāḥ sutejaḥ kāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
yakṣalokaṃ vrajanty āśu tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ / mantrayantravihīno 'pi śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ
ṣaḍakṣaram imaṃ mantraṃ hṛdi cakre divāniśam / oṃnamaḥ śivāya iti sarvamantrottamottamam
tasya bhaktiṃ parāṃ jñātvā devadeva umāpatiḥ / pratyakṣarūpo bhagavān chūlapāṇiḥ samāgataḥ
uvāca vacanaṃ devo mātaṅgaṃ prati bhārata / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te dhyānenānena suvrata
mātaṅga uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa varaṃ dātum ihecchasi / mātaṅganāmnā vikhyātiṃ tīrtham etat prayātu vai
cāṇḍālāḥ śvapacāś caiva pāpayonigatā 'pi / japādi rahitāś cāpi mucyante 'trāpi kilbiṣāt
mātaṅganāmaliṅgaṃ tu narmadātīram āśritam / snātvā yo 'trārcayet tasya bhaved bandhavimokṣaṇam
idaṃ varam ahaṃ manye tvatprasādāt maheśvara / tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvā praty uvāca śivāpatiḥ
evam bhavatu tatsarvaṃ matprasādān na saṃśaya / evam uktvā yayau deva kailāsaṃ parvatottamam
varaṃ samprāpya mātaṅga umāmāheśvaraṃ puram / kāmikaṃ yānam ārūḍhaḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣita
jagāmāśu ciraṃ bhoktuṃ bhogān snānaprabhāvataḥ / yā caitramāse 'māvāsyā kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī
tasyāṃ tatra hutaṃ dattam anantaphalam aśnute / tilodakapradānena pāpayonigatā 'pi
saktvāḍhyaguḍapiṇḍena pitṝn modayate tu yaḥ / pitarastasya tṛpyanti yāvadindrāś caturdaśa
tilataṇḍulamiśraṃ yaḥ kuryāl liṅgasya pūjanam / so 'pi varṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate
aśokavanikā nāma mātaṅgaṃ tīrtham ucyate / revāyā uttare kūle kathitaṃ tava bhārata
athānyat kathayiṣyāmi yāmyabhāge vyavasthitam / tīrthaṃ mṛgavanaṃ nāma sarvapāpapraṇāśanam
tatra snātvā 'rcayed viṣṇuṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam / ekādaśyāṃ mahārāja nirāhāro niśāṃ nayet
hariṃ mṛgavane tatra gandhapuṣpaiś ca pūjayet / ekasmin bhojite vipre lakṣaṃ bhavatu bhojitam
tilodakapradānena pitṝṇāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ padam / tatraiva sanniviṣṭaṃ tu vārāhaṃ tīrthamuttamam
yatra vārāharūpeṇa dharā caiva samuddhṛtā / viśvarūpaṃ tathā cānyaddhariṇāmitatejasā
pativratā ca nārī vai tathā māsopavāsinī / tatra snātvā vidhānena lokaṃ prāpnoti vaiṣṇavam

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe mātaṅgāśramavarṇano nāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 57 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ākhyānaṃ kathayiṣyāmi khyātaṃ mṛgavanaṃ yathā / vyādha kaścid durācāraḥ sarvabhūteṣu nirdayaḥ
pāśahasto dhanuṣpāṇir vicaran girikandare / ājaghāna mṛgān sarvān kuṭumbārthe nṛpottama
jyeṣṭhe māsi tu saṃprāpte nidāghe jvalanaprabhe / bhramati sma tṛṣārtaś ca vṛkṣamūle samāśritaḥ
rātrau svapiti niśceṣṭo duḥkhārtaś ca kṣudhānvitaḥ / vanasaṃgharṣajo vahnir utthito girikandarāt
pradagdhaṃ ca vana tena mṛgavyāghrasamāvṛtam / bhasmībhūtaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ reṇubhūtaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ
meghāgamoktakāle tu pravāhe nārmade śubhe / kanyārāśigate bhānau dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇena tu
narmadātoya saṃsargād yakṣā jātās tu pannagāḥ / tatkṣaṇād divyadehās tu vaiṣṇavaṃ yānamāsthitāḥ
sa vyādhaś cābhavad rājā tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ / daśavarṣasahasrāṇi bhogān bhuṅkte manoharān
ye 'pi dagdhā mṛgās tatra te 'pi gandharvatāṃ gatāḥ / vaiṣṇavenaiva yānena prāptās tu vaiṣṇavaṃ padam
avaśaḥ svavaśo vāpi yas tu prāṇān parityajet / divyavarṣasahasraṃ tu viṣṇuloke sa modate
tilodakapradānena pitṝṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ / manorathaṃ nāma tīrtham anyat paramasiddhidam
triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ revātīrasamudbhavam / yaṃ yaṃ prārthayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ snātvāpi mānavaḥ
sarva ca samavāpnoti tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ / aṅgarāvartasaṃbhedo gosahasraphalapradaḥ
aṅgāreśvaradevaś ca tatra tiṣṭhati saṅgame / snānamātro naras tatra gāṇapatyam avāpnuyāt
aṅgāraś ca caturthyāṃ ca yadā bhavati bhārata / hiraṇyapuruṣaṃ kṛtvā raktavastreṇa veṣṭayet
ghṛtapūrṇaṃ tāmrapātraṃ guḍenāpi prapūritam / tatsarvaṃ vidhivad dadyāc chrotriyāya viśeṣataḥ
dānatīrthaprabhāveṇa śakrārddhāsanabhāg bhavet / yasmāt pāpāni duḥkhāni tīvrāṇy api bahūnyapi
tasmāt pāpaṃ na kartavyam ātmapīḍākaraṃ hi tat / yasmin kāle ca deśe ca vayasā yādṛśena ca
kṛtaṃ śubhāśūbhaṃ karma tat tathā tena bhujyate / tasmāt sadaiva dātavyam avicchinna tayārthine
vicchidyante 'nyathā bhogā grīṣme kusarito yathā / saṃsevyate yathā devī saptakalpavahā śubhā
saṃsārasya samucchittyai jñānayogaṃ bravīmi te / śivaprakāśakaṃ jñānaṃ yogas tatraiva cintitaḥ
durvijñeya gatir yogo narmadāśivasannidhau / śivājñā vartate tatra snānapūjāvidhir yathā
sa siddhāntā 'virodhena pustakair na virodhayet / dharmajñānāpavargārthaṃ sahitaṃ vindate naraḥ
pūrvottaravirodhena kutrārtho 'bhimato bhavet / dṛṣṭvādyamūlatas tarkaṃ śrutyā saha vivarjayet
tasmād āgamayuktena sadātmārthavicāraṇam / kartavyaṃ nānumānena kevalena vipaścitā
hīnottamādyasya phalaṃ bahudhā svaṃ ca tatsmṛtam / tasmāt parīkṣāṃ kurvīta puṇyaṃ sādhu mahatphalam
pākhaṇḍino vikarmasthān vaiḍālavratikāṃ śaṭhān / varjayed dūrato dhīmān haitukyān tīrthanindakān
digambarān śvetapaṭān ye cānye hetuvādinaḥ / etaiḥ saha na saṃvādaṃ saṃsargaṃ na kathaṃcana
viparītaṃ kalau dharmaṃ nagnā muṇḍā malāśinaḥ / tasmāt taṃ ca parityajya tretādharmaṃ samācaret
pramāṇaṃ sarvadharmeṣu brahmaviṣṇuśivoditam / anyathā kurute yas tu narake patati dhruvam
sarveṣām eva śāstrāṇām evaṃ śāstraviniścayaḥ / sevyatāṃ kalpagā devī śivapūjārataiḥ sadā
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ kuryād bhikṣāṃ dadyāc ca bhikṣave / kāruṇyaṃ sarvabhūteṣu narmadākhyānacintanam
idaṃ jñānamaśeṣaṃ ca sarvakarmaviśodhanam / ādimadhyāntarahitaḥ svabhāvavimalaḥ prabhuḥ
sarvajñaḥ paripūrṇaś ca śivo jñeyaḥ śivāgame / sarvārthasādhakaṃ jñānaṃ tatpraṇītam asaṃśayam
yaḥ sarvajñaḥ susampūrṇaḥ svabhāvavimalaḥ śivaḥ / sarvadoṣavinirmuktaḥ sa brūyāt katham anyathā
śivājñām antareṇāpi jagatsṛṣṭiḥ katham bhavet / acaitanyāt pradhānena ajñatvāt puruṣasya ca
pradhānaṃ paramāṇvādi yāvat kiṃcid acetanam / tanna kartṛ svayaṃ draṣṭṛ buddhimatkaraṇaṃ vinā
na yathā ghaṭam ānena mṛtpiṇḍaḥ svayam ṛcchati / tathājñābuddhibhāvena na tiṣṭhet prakṛtiḥ svayam
dharmādharmopadeśo na dharmādharmavicāraṇam / sarvajñena vinā jātu nādisarge prasiddhyati
yathānādi pravṛtto 'yaṃ ghoraḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ / śivo 'pi hi tathānādiḥ saṃsārān mocakaḥ smṛtaḥ
vyādhīnāṃ bhaiṣajaṃ yadvat pratipakṣaṃ svabhāvataḥ / tadvatsaṃsāraghorāṇāṃ pratipakṣaḥ śivaḥ smṛtaḥ
vaidyaṃ vinā nirākrandāḥ kliśyante rogiṇo yathā / śivena tu vinā sarvaṃ nirākrandaṃ jagat tathā
tasmād anādiḥ sarvajñaḥ paripūrṇaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ / asti nātaḥ paritrātā pumān saṃsārasāgare
ye 'bhyasanti śivajñānaṃ hṛdaye śivabhāvitāḥ / yadi vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ tu teṣāṃ jñānaṃ prajāyate
iyaṃ ca sarvabhūtānāṃ śaraṇaṃ bhuvi narmadā / apāṃ rūpatayā devī lokānugrahakāriṇī
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham / bhagavaty uddharaty eṣāṃ patantaṃ narake dhruvam
evaṃjñātvā naraśreṣṭha śivam anvīkṣya kalpagām / uccairgṛhāṇi divyāni dhanadhānyānvitāni ca
sarvopaskaradivyāni brāhmaṇebhyo nivedayet / anāthāyātivṛddhāya vikalāya kuṭumbine
kāṣṭhamṛnmayagehaṃ ca yo dvijāya prayacchati / evaṃ vidhān gṛhān ramyān sarvato 'marakaṇṭake
kārayed yaḥ pumān divyāṃs tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / kiṃ tasya bahubhir dattair dānair bhavati bhārata
etad eva paraṃ dānaṃ sarvakāmārthasādhakam / yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye saptapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 58 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: śrutvaitat paramaṃ guhyaṃ gavāṃ devasam udbhavam / brahmakūrcasya māhātmyaṃ śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ
ākhyāhi bhagavan sarvaṃ golokaḥ kīdṛśaḥ smṛtaḥ / prāpyate karmaṇā kena ke tasminn aniśaṃ sthitāḥ
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śrūyatām abhidhāsyāmi namaskṛtya maheśvaram / gomātṛlokaṃ paramaṃ sarvakām asamanvitam
yathāvat sarvalokānām uparyupari saṃsthitam / pātālāni tataḥ sapta pātālaṃ ca tatas tathā
yāvat pramāṇaṃ paritaḥ paricchinnaṃ mahītalam / tāvat pramāṇaṃ tasyāḥ samudrās tāni caiva tu
teṣāṃ pratyekam utsedhapramāṇaṃ parikīrtitam / yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi daśārdhāni tatas tataḥ
sahasrayojanotsedhas tasyābhyantaratas tathā / vivarāṇāṃ samastānāṃ sahasrāṇi nava smṛtam
teṣāṃ ruciramāhātmyaṃ nāmatas tu mahītale / divyadivyopasampannaḥ śrīmaccāmīkaradyutiḥ
nāgarājaḥ sadaivāste tasmin kṛtaniketanaḥ / ananto 'nantadhāmā ca mukundo nṛpaśaivalaḥ
tato rasātalaṃ nāma śivasantoṣabhūmikam / vāsuker nāgarājasya tatra cāru mahāpuram
pura ca suralomnas tu dānavādhipater mahat / suparṇasya ca daityānām aśeṣāṇāṃ mahātmanām
tataḥ sutalanāmāsti śarkarāñcitabhūmikam / nāgādīnāṃ svastikānāṃ tatraiva vasatiḥ sadā
dānavādhipatīnāṃ ca tatraiva nilayaḥ paraḥ / vairocanahiraṇyākhyaprabhṛtīnāṃ mahātmanām
tataścātalam ityuktaṃ pātālānāṃ tasya tu vai / teṣām ūrdhvavastusarveṣāṃ mṛnmayaṃ ca talaṃ kṣiteḥ
asurādhipates tāvat kālanemermahāpuram / cārucāmīkarābhāsaṃ vainateyasya cāparam
tataś ca vitalaṃ nāma pātālaṃ raktabhūtalam / tasmin mahāntako nāma dānavendrakṛtālayaḥ
tālako 'gnimukhas tasmin nalahrādaś ca dānavāḥ / nivasanti kṛtāgārās tathā prahlādavarcasaḥ
pātālaṃ vitalaṃ nāma śuklaṃ kṣititalaṃ tataḥ / kambalāśvatarau nāgau sahitau tatra tiṣṭhataḥ
mahājambhahayagrīvaprabhṛtīnāṃ mahātmanām / vārāṇasyasurendrāṇāṃ nivāsas tatrakalpitaḥ
kṛṣṇaṃ kṣititalaṃ tasmāt pātālatalasaṃjñakam / śaṅkukarṇamahānādanamucīnāṃ niketanam
pātālāt saptamād ūrdhvaṃ saptadvīpā mahī sthitā / samudraiḥ saptabhir yuktā parvataiḥ samalaṃkṛtā
jambūdvīpaś ca tan madhye plakṣadvīpas tataḥ paraḥ
krauñcadvīpaś ca parataḥ śākadvīpaś ca tadbahiḥ / parataḥ puṣkaradvīpaḥ saptamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
kṣārodakaś cekṣurasaḥ surodaś ca ghṛtodadhiḥ / dadhitoyaḥ kṣīrapūrṇaḥ svādūdaḥ saptamaḥ smṛtaḥ
saptadvīpasamudrāṇāṃ dviguṇadviguṇāntaraḥ / pramāṇavistaro jñeyo niyutaḥ prathamaḥ smṛtaḥ
himavān hemakūṭaś ca niṣadhaś ceti dakṣiṇe / nīlaś ca śvetaḥ śṛṅgaś ca meroruttarataḥ smṛtāḥ
merur asti sthito madhye jambūdvīpasya bhārata / mālyavān pūrvato jñeyaḥ paścime gandhamādanaḥ
ete parvatarājāno jambūdvīpe nava smṛtāḥ / plakṣadvīpādiṣu jñeyāḥ saptasaptaiva parvatāḥ
puṣkaradvīpamadhye tu parvato valayākṛtiḥ / ekaḥ smṛtaḥ samantāc ca nāmato mānasaḥ smṛtaḥ
vindhyo nāma mahābhāgo jambūdvīpe vyavasthitaḥ / yatraiṣā narmadādevī plavantī lokatāriṇī
vindhyasya cānujo bhrātā sahyo dakṣiṇataḥ smṛtaḥ / urvī kūrmatalākārā kāñcanī parimaṇḍalā
aṇureva tathā sā tu nirdiṣṭātividaḥ kṣitiḥ / tasyāḥ pramāṇaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ daśayojanakoṭayaḥ
lokāloka iti khyātas tasyāḥ prānte samantataḥ / sphīto hemamayaḥ śrīmān saralaḥ parimaṇḍalaḥ
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi cārdhamasya vyavasthitam / tāvadeva ca vistīrṇaṃ tadardhe bhānurāhitaḥ
prakāśayati sa jyotiḥ parabhāge nihanyate / lokāloka iti proktas tato 'sāvacalo mahān
lokālokāvasāno 'yaṃ bhūrlokaḥ parikīrtitaḥ / gandharvayakṣarakṣobhiḥ piśācaiś ca niṣevitaḥ
mānuṣaiḥ paśubhiś caiva mṛgapakṣisarīsṛpaiḥ / sthāvarairvividhākārair bhūtair etaiś ca ṣaḍvidhaiḥ
bhūrlokaś ca bhuvarloko yāvad ādityamaṇḍalam / vasanti satataṃ rudrās satataṃ vaktrabhāskarāḥ
ādityamaṇḍalādūrdhvaṃ smṛtā svarlokasaṃsthitiḥ / vimānakoṭayas tasminn aṣṭāviṃśatirāśayaḥ
meḍhībhūto vimānānāṃ sarveṣām upari dhruvaḥ / niyutā anilaskandhāḥ saptāsminn antare sthitāḥ
pṛthivyāḥ prathamaḥ skandhaḥ sthitaś cāmeghamaṇḍalam / āhavo nāma vai vāto vyūhānāṃ vyūhakṛt tathā
dvitīyaḥ pravaho nāma nibaddhaḥ sūryamaṇḍale / tṛtīyaḥ saṃvaho māma suskandho 'sau pratiṣṭhitaḥ
caturthaḥ sodvahaḥ skandhaḥ sthito nakṣatramaṇḍale / tato dvayor vinirdiṣṭā vimānodvahanakriyā
yojanānāṃ dhruvaḥ koṭir maharlokaḥ samucchritaḥ / skandhaḥ parivaho nāma nibaddhaḥ saptamo dhruve
annādīni karoty eṣa parvaṇām upari sthitaḥ / vinirvṛttaṃ vikārāṇām adhivāso mahātmanām
tatrādhikāridevānām aṣṭāviṃśati koṭayaḥ / janāt svarlokam āgatya niyogāt padmajanmanaḥ
sthitā manvantaraṃ tatra svavyāpārāvasāyinaḥ / āruhya ca maharlokam āgacchanti tataḥ punaḥ
brahmaṇo divasaikena devāḥ svarge caturdaśa / krameṇa kṛtvā karmāṇi maharloke vasanti te
koṭidvayaṃ maharlokāj janalokaḥ samucchritaḥ / sādhyānām asurās tatra vasanti sukhinaḥ sadā
yojanānāṃ catuḥkoṭyaḥ janād apy ucchritaṃ tapaḥ / prajānāṃ patayas tatra sthitās tu brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
satyalokas tapolokāt koṭiṣaṭkaṃ samucchritam / āste parivṛtas tatra devāsuragaṇair virāṭ
brahmalokād viṣṇuloko dviguṇena samucchritaḥ / vistareṇa tadūrdhve ca divyalokaḥ samanvitaḥ
viṣṇulokāc ca parataḥ śrīmac chivapuraṃ mahat / dvāviṃśat koṭivistīrṇaṃ tadūrdhve samupasthitam
sūryāyutapratīkāśaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam / anekāraṇyavinyāsaṃ svarganadyupaśobhitam
sarvaratnānvitair divyais taptajāmbūnadaprabhaiḥ / sahasrakhaṇḍabhaumaiś ca sarvaśobhāsamanvitaiḥ
vimānaiḥ sarvato vyāptaṃ candrair ivanabhastalam / apsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ sarvavidyādharānvitam
nṛtyagītaravopetair aprameyaguṇānvitaiḥ / manojavair asaṃkhyātaiḥ parivārasamanvitaiḥ
kvacid dolāgṛhair ramyaiḥ kiṅkiṇīr avakānvitaiḥ / udgatair ardhacandraiś ca ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ
maṇimuktāvitānaiś ca maṇiratnacayaiḥ śubhaiḥ / sarvaratnārcitair dravyair muktādāmasuśobhanaiḥ
mahāsiṃhāsanair divyaiḥ sarvaratnavibhūṣitaiḥ / kvacit puṇyagṛhair vyāptam asaṃkhyaguṇānvitaiḥ
sadā puṣpaphalair vṛkṣaiḥ kvacid vyāptaṃ manoramaiḥ / puṣpodyānair mahāramyaiḥ śataśo 'tha sahasraśaḥ
saptakalpavahā puṇyā tatraivāste saridvarā / tatkalāyāḥ sahasrāṃśo jambūdvīpe pradṛśyate
avatīrṇā mahīpṛṣṭhe lokānugrahakāmyayā / sarvātmanā 'vatāraś ca gaṅgādisaritām iha
amṛtasyandinībhiś ca nadībhir upaśobhitam / hemaratnāñcitā vāpyaḥ sopānaiḥ sphāṭikair yutāḥ
sitaraktāsitaiḥ pītaiḥ sarojairyāḥ sugandhibhiḥ / pañcavarṇaiś ca gurubhiḥ śobhitāḥ kāñcanākulaiḥ
mahāvikāśi saṃsnigdhaiḥ śrīmadbhiḥ pañcahastakaiḥ / daśa dvādaśahastaiś ca tathā viṃśatihastakaiḥ
nālair marakataprakhyair manoharadalānvitaiḥ / pūrṇanīlotpalaiś cānyair dīrghikāś ca kvacit kvacit
siṃhavyāghramukhair divyair gajavājimṛgānanaiḥ / gomukhaiś chāgavadanaiḥ kapipakṣimukhais tathā
ekavaktrair mahāvaktrair bahuvaktrair avaktrakaiḥ / ekapādais tripādaiś ca bahupādair apādakaiḥ
vāmanair jaṭilair muṇḍair dīrghagrīvair mahodaraiḥ / mahākāyair mahānāsair mahākarṇair akarṇakaiḥ
nānārūpākṛtidharair nānābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ / nānāveṣadharair divyaiḥ kāmarūpair mahābalaiḥ
nānāprabhāvasaṃyuktair nānāśāstraviśāradaiḥ / asaṃkhyā jātayaś cānyā nivasanti tathā vidhāḥ
kubjāvāmanakādīrghā varadehā varānanāḥ / muṇḍāś ca vikaṭā nīcā hrasvadīrghaś ca tādṛśāḥ
lambodarā hrasvabhujā vinatā hrasvajānukāḥ / mṛgendravadanāś cānyā gajavājimukhās tathā
hrasvakuñcitakeśāś ca sundarapriyadarśanāḥ / pañcāśatkoṭayas tatra śivasya paricārikāḥ
maṇimāṇikyageheṣu ramante tā bahiḥ kvacit / tatra geheṣu yad dvārisahasraśatabhūmiṣu
vicitrabhūmayas tatra vajravaidūryabhūṣitāḥ / iti sarvaguṇopetaiḥ strīsahasrair varānanaiḥ
asaṃkhyātaiḥ puraṃ vyāptam īśvarasya samantataḥ / tan madhye sarvatobhadraṃ divyamāyatanaṃ mahat
śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ sthānam ādyam umāpateḥ / tatrāste bhagavān somaḥ pūjyamāno gaṇeśvaraiḥ
siddhaiḥ svasthānasaṃprāptair brahmaviṣṇvādibhis tathā / dharmas tatra sthitaḥ śrīmānīśvarāyatane 'nagha
yatra vīravṛṣaḥ tatra nityaṃ gomātaraḥ sthitāḥ / tatra sā narmadādevī pūjyamānā surāsuraiḥ
tenodakena tṛpyanti govatsāḥ sarvadevatāḥ / brahmāviṣṇuḥ sureśāna umayā sahito 'nagha
surāś ca ṛṣayo bhūtāḥ pitaro mātaras tathā / sa lokaḥ śivaloko 'tra narmadāloka eva ca
ye guṇā rudralokasya golokasya tathaiva ca / nandā bhadrā subhadrā ca suśīlā surabhis tathā
iti gomātaraḥ pañca śivalokavinirgatāḥ / ṣaṣṭhī tu narmadādevī lokānugrahakāmyayā
etāḥ sarvā jagatsarvaṃ sarvalokasya mātaraḥ / tarpayanti mahārāja nityam atrātmikair guṇaiḥ
kāraṇāc ca śivasthānād īśvarecchāvaśā 'nugā / oṃkārāt sarvalokānām imaṃ lokaṃ samāśritāḥ
tṛṇāni khādanti caranty araṇye pibanti toyāni sunirmalāni / dugdhaṃ prayacchanti punanti dehaṃ gāvo yato jīvati jīvalokaḥ
kutas teṣāṃ hi pāpāni yeṣāṃ gṛhamalaṃkṛtam / satataṃ bālavatsābhir gobhiḥ strībhiriva svayam
ye smaranti sadoṃkāraṃ narmadāṃ ca śivātmanā / na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttirghore saṃsārasāgare
ye kurvanti parāṃ bhaktiṃ tṛṇatoyapradānataḥ / prasādāt tu gavāṃ tāsāṃ śivalokaṃ vrajanti te
etāḥ sadānukūlena mātaraḥ sarvakāmadāḥ / ye rakṣanti śubhā gāś ca śivalokaṃ vrajanti te
ye 'rcayanti śivaṃ bhaktyā sadvidhānaiḥ samāhitāḥ / te vindanti mahābhogān puraṃ yānti śivasya vai
ye śivāśrayatīrthāni śraddhayā yānti mānavāḥ / kalpagāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa śailaṃ cāmarakaṇṭakam
te krīḍanti mahābhogair brahmaviṣṇuśivālaye / payo 'mṛtaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ madhudadhyādikaṃ tu yat
na paśyati mahābhāga kalpagāyāṃ vimohitaḥ / etatte kathitaṃ rājan revāvataraṇaṃ śubham
asyākhyānena bhagavān /# prīyatāṃ me śivaḥ svayam

# iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe śivalokavarṇano nāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 59 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: dānadharmavidhānaṃ ca śrotum icchāmi kalpaga / daridrā bhikṣavo vāpi kathaṃ yānti śivālayam
vidhinā kena dānena mucyate duṣkṛtaṃ tathā / lokānāṃ ca hitārthāya kathayasva mahāmune
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan yathā nyāyaṃ kathayāmi tavānagha / puṣkaraṃ bilvapatraṃ ca kuśāstoyaṃ ca nārmadam
svayambhūr bhagavān āha sāmānyaṃ dharmakāraṇam / śraddhāpūtāḥ sarvadharmāḥ purāṇaṃ śrutayas tathā
tasyopadeśadharmeṇa narā yānti triviṣṭapam / yas tūlapūrṇavistīrṇaṃ raktavastraṃ sasūtrakam
vyāghracarmakṛtaṃ vāpi navavastrāvaguṇṭhitam / kṛṣṇājinopavītaṃ ca puṇyadhūpādhivāsitam
śivadhyānābhiyuktāya śraddhayā vinivedayet / tat tūlavastratantūnāṃ romasaṃkhyāsti yāvatī
tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate / modate sarvalokeṣu bhuktvā bhogān anekaśaḥ
punaś ca kṣitimāsādya siṃhāsanapatir bhavet / tṛṇavalkalaparṇāni śayyā prāvaraṇādikam
dattvā tadarthine bhūmau śivaloke mahīyate / śivamuddiśya naivedyaṃ yo dadyāc chivadarśine
śākaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ vāpi tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / yāvat syāt taṇḍulādīnāṃ saṃkhyāphaladaleṣu ca
tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi śivaloke mahīyate / bhikṣāṃ savyañjanāṃ dattvā śivabhaktāya bhaktitaḥ
varṣalakṣaṃ mahābhāga śivaloke mahīyate / dadhibhaktaṃ susampūrṇaṃ bhikṣāpātraṃ suśobhanam
dadyād yaḥ śivabhaktāya tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / varṣakoṭisamaṃ divyaṃ mahābhogaiḥ samanvitam
sthitvā śivapure divye tasyānte ca mahīpatiḥ / suśītalena toyena śivabhaktaṃ sitāyujā
tarpayitvā śambhuloke varṣalakṣaṃ ca modate / kalaśaṃ śarkaropetaṃ vastrapūtāmbupūritam
dadyād yaḥ śivabhaktāya tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ vimānaṃ sarvakāmikam
saṃprāpya śivaloke tu varṣakoṭiṃ sa modate / palāśaparṇaiḥ patrair vā yaḥ kuryāt puṭakāni tu
pradadyācchivayogibhyas tāmrapātraprado hi saḥ / yas tāmrapātraṃ sukṛtaṃ pradadyāc chivayogine
koṭiṣaṭ kaṃ sa kalpānāṃ śivaloke mahīyate / śūlaṃ vahati yaḥ pāṇau śaktiṃ pṛṣṭhe kamaṇḍalum
taṃ bhojayitvā yatnena śivalokam avāpnuyāt / bhojayec ca yathā śaktyā yaḥ śivavratacāriṇam
bhogaiḥ sa krīḍati śreṣṭhaiḥ śivaloke vyavasthitaḥ / yaḥ śivāśramadharmaṃ ca gṛhasthaṃ bhojayed budhaḥ
vipulaiḥ sa mahābhogaiḥ śivaloke mahīyate / śivāśramavratasthaṃ yaḥ kandādyair bhojayet naraḥ
sa divyānāpnuyād bhogān īśvarasya pure sthitaḥ / evaṃ pāśupataṃ bhaktaṃ bhojayitvā praṇamya ca
nānāvidhair mahābhogaiḥ śivaloke mahīyate / mahāvratadharāyaiva bhikṣāṃ yaḥ pratipādayet
sa divyaiḥ śobhanair bhogaiḥ śivaloke mahīyate / sayamaniyam ācāraṃ śivabhaktiparaṃ naram
bhojayitvā yathāśaktyā śivaloke mahīyate / jñānayogabahiḥsthā ye lokasāmānyadharmiṇaḥ
pūjayanti śivaṃ bhaktyā śivalokaṃ vrajanti te / anāśikenāpi karīṣavahṇinā payaḥ pradānena tapobhir ugraiḥ
prayānti yajñaiś ca na tāṃ gatiṃ narā / nīco 'pi yāṃ yāti hi rudrabhaktaḥ
yathā revājalasparśāl labhante sadgatiṃ narāḥ / na tathā yajñadānādyair upāyair bharatarṣabha
ity eṣa śivalokas tu prasaṅgāt samudāhṛtaḥ / golokaḥ kalpagālokaḥ śivabhaktaiḥ samanvitaḥ
jñānayogena ye śāntā japanti paramaṃ śivam / te sarvaduḥkhanirmuktā bhavanti sukhinaḥ sadā
śivalokaś ca vijñeyo maṇḍalāvaraṇātmakaḥ / pañcabhūtānyahaṃkāraḥ sattvaṃ prakṛtiraṣṭamī
īdṛśānāṃ tu nāgānāṃ koṭyo jñeyāḥ sahasraśaḥ / sarvāṅgatvāt pradhānasya tiryagūrdhvamadhaḥ sthitam
viṣṇulokāt paraṃ sthānaṃ kumārasya mahātmanaḥ / svacchamauktikasaṃkāśaṃ paramā śrīsamanvitam
skandalokāt paraṃ sthānam umādevyāḥ prakīrtitam / taptacāmīkaraprakhyam aśeṣaguṇasaṃyutam
umāsthānāt paraṃ caiva harasthānaṃ taduttamam / sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ sarvakām asamanvitam
gaṇair adhyuṣitaṃ sarvair asaṃkhyair yogatatparaiḥ / hiraṇyagarbhakūrmādyair vasurudradivākaraiḥ
stūyate bhagavān nityaṃ tasyānti pratikāṅkṣibhiḥ / jñānadhyānaparaiḥ śāntair bhikṣāhārair jitendriyaiḥ
prāpyaṃ taiś ca paraṃ sthānaṃ sūryāyutasamaprabham / tatsatkarmakarair nityaṃ brāhmaṇair dagdhakalmaṣaiḥ
vasanti yadṛtaṃ siddhāśayās tu kleśavarjitāḥ / narmadā sevyamānāś ca labhante tatpadaṃ narāḥ
etat te kathitaṃ pārtha yathoddiṣṭaṃ tu śambhunā / yan mayā kathitaṃ dānaṃ narmadātīram āśritam
gacchanti ye 'nyat tīrthaṃ tu sahasrāṃśo viśiṣyate / sarvajñāḥ sarvagāḥ śuddhāḥ paripūrṇā bhavanti te
śuddhakarmakarā ye tu paramaiśvaryasaṃyutāḥ / sadehāś ca videhāś ca bhavanti svecchayā punaḥ
iti nityaṃ viśuddhaṃ ca sthānam ādyam umāpateḥ / divyaṃ śrīkaṇṭhanāthasya jagadbhartuḥ samaṃsthitam
sthānaṃ navakamity evaṃ nirgatā yatra kalpagā / paramāṣṭaguṇaiśvaryanityam akṣayam avyayam
śaśvadgurupraṇītena dhyānayogena ye narāḥ / dhyāyanti devatāṃ nityaṃ te siddhā yānti tatpadam
ye 'bhyasanti śivajñānaṃ narmadātīram āśritāḥ / kāmatṛṣṇāvinirmuktās te 'pi yānti ca tatpuram
apy ekadivasaṃ yāvac chivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ / śivadharmaparas tasya dharmasyānto na vidyate
yogadharmasu sāratvādabhedyaṃ pāpamudgaraiḥ / vajrataṇḍulavaj jñeyaṃ tasmāt tasya phalaṃ mahat
dehāntenaiva dharmeṇa sthānamādyaṃ śivālayam / yatrāste vipulair bhogaiḥ krīḍan kalpāyutaṃ naraḥ
tataḥ kalpāyutasyānte sthānaṃ kaumāram āpnuyāt / tatrārdhasammitaṃ kālaṃ sa krīḍan sasukhaṃ vaset
tadante viṣṇulokaṃ ca saṃprāpya vasate punaḥ / brahmalokaṃ gataś cānte tatrāpi vasate naraḥ
brahmalokaparibhraṣṭo vasec chivapure sukham / tat tasmād brahmaviṣṇvādyāṃl lokān prāpnoty anukramāt
ity evaṃ sarvalokeṣu ramitvā kramaśas tataḥ / manuṣyalokam āsādya śivaṃ revāṃ samāśrayet
mayā te kathitā 'nyatra yāni dānāni bhārata / tāni sarve praśaṃsanti parvate 'marakaṇṭake

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye śivamahimānuvarṇano nāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 60 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: vaiṣṇavaṃ dānadharmaṃ ca kathyamānaṃ nibodha me / viṣṇuyogaṃ samabhyasya sarvakleśāpanuttaye
viṣṇuṃ sampūjya vidhinā ghṛtasnānādibhiḥ stavaiḥ / dvādaśyāṃ viṣṇum uddiśya dadyād ekāṃ payasvinīm
narmadātīram āsādya tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / pūjyate dharmarājena yathā viṣṇus tathaiva saḥ
śaivānāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca sahasram bhojayet tu yaḥ / garbhiṇī dhenusaṃmiśraṃ vṛṣabhair daśabhiryutam
arcitaṃ gandhapuṣpādyair hemavastrair alaṃkṛtam / pradakṣiṇam upākramya mantrarājaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevayeti samuccaran / vedavidbhiḥ samākīrṇaṃ viṣṇor ārādhanaiḥ śubhaiḥ
narmadātoyam āsādya dīpamālāṃ prabodhayet / gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva ca
gāvo me hṛdaye vāpi gavāṃ madhye vasāmy aham / imaṃ mantraṃ samutthāya japed āsāṃ puro gavām
gandhato yākṣatair miśrair gṛhītvā tāmrabhājanam / śṛṅgapuccha jalasnātaḥ śuklavastrasamanvitaḥ
narmadāsnānapānena gavāṃ pucchāmbhasā tathā / sarvakalmaṣanirmuktaḥ susiddhaḥ suciravrataḥ
snāpayitvā gatas tatra sa vipro narmadātaṭe / paurṇamāsyāṃ pūrṇacandre rāhusomasamāgame
taireva sārddhaṃ viprendraiḥ saṃprapūjya hariṃ smaret / bhṛtyaputrakalatrād yair yuktaḥ svajanabāndhavaiḥ
nivedayet tu kṛṣṇāya mantreṇa śraddhayānvitaḥ / śrāddhe dāne ca home ca vivāhe maṅgale tathā
gomātaraḥ sthitā nityaṃ viṣṇuloke śivātmikāḥ / śivāyaitā mayā dattā viṣṇave ca mahātmane
evaṃ viprāya yo dadyād yajñārthaṃ samalaṃkṛtāḥ / evaṃ nivedya puruṣo gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
kulāni triṃśaduttārya narakād bhṛtyabāndhavān / sthāpayed vaiṣṇave loke śivasya ca mahātmanaḥ
sarvajñaḥ paripūrṇaś ca viśuddhaḥ sarvagaḥ prabhuḥ / saṃsārasāgarān mukto haritulyaḥ prajāyate
anenaiva vidhānena gṛhasthāḥ prāpnuyur divam / vināpi jñānayogena gosahasrapradānataḥ
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi śūdro 'thāpi ca bhaktitaḥ / narmadākapilāyoge yathā vibhavavistaraiḥ
brāhmaṇāya daridrāya dīkṣitāyopaśobhine / candrasūryoparāge tu vyatīpāte ca saṃkrame
ṣaḍaśīti mukhe dadyād amāsomasamāgame / kārttikyā vā yugādau vā puṇye vāhani bhārata
yaddhi gāyanti pitaro gāthām etāṃ narādhipa / api syāt sa kule 'smākaṃ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ
narmadākapilāyoge koṭitīrthe ca muktide / narakād uddhared asmān dattvā gā yas tu saṃyutāḥ
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi loke krīḍati vaiṣṇave / tasmāt tvam api rājendra gosahasraprado bhava
devavad divi modante yena te pitaraḥ sadā / kathayāmi tavāthāhamitihāsaṃ purātanam
yuvanāśvaḥ purā rājā cakravartī mahāyaśāḥ / śakrāc chatagaṇaṃ puṇyaṃ prajāpālanatatparaḥ
ayodhyānagarī yasya brahmalokasamaprabhā / tasyā kṛtayuge cādau sarvadharmaparāyaṇaḥ
bṛhaspatibrahmasamaṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ svapurohitam / abhivādya yathānyāyam uvāca munisattamam
kasmin sthāne yajed yajñaṃ tīrthe deśe surālaye / vaśiṣṭhapramukhāḥ sarve munayaś cedam abruvan
pṛthivyāṃ naimiṣaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthamayaṃ śubham / saphalo hayamedhas tu koṭikoṭigaṇottaraḥ
purāṇe kīrtitaṃ rājan matsyarūpeṇa viṣṇunā / sūryeṇa kīrtitaṃ rājan manuputrāya cātmanaḥ
sarveṣāṃ tu purāṇānāṃ purāṇaṃ matsyakīrtitam / vedāścaiva purā naṣṭā matsyarūpeṇa coddhṛtāḥ
vedahīnāś ca vartante dvijā vai yajñakarmasu / evaṃ vidhaṃ tu tat tīrthaṃ yuvanāśva tavoditam
evaṃ śrutvā tato vākyaṃ vaśiṣṭhasya purodhasaḥ / ādideśa tato 'mātyān dharmiṣṭhān satyavādinaḥ
yajñopaskaram ādāya samāgacchata satvaram / ghoṣaṇā kriyatāṃ rāṣṭre daṇḍahastaiś ca kiṅkaraiḥ
āhūtās tu tato devā nṛpater yajñakarmaṇi / brahmā viṣṇuḥ sureśaś ca skando vaiśravaṇas tathā
śambhuś caiva viśeṣeṇa surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ / dhenūnāṃ daśalakṣāṇi hemaratnānvitāni ca
lakṣamekaṃ hayānāṃ ca dantinām ayutatrayam / maṇimāṇikyamuktāś ca hiraṇyaṃ cāpy anantakam
nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi bhakṣyabhojyamalaṃkṛtam / yajñadravyaṃ ca yac cānyat tat sarvasahito nṛpaḥ
nānāsahasrayānais tu nānādeśagatair nṛpaiḥ / nānāvādyasahasrais tu nānāgītair manoharaiḥ
vedaghoṣeṇa mahatā divaṃ bhūmiṃ vinādayan / viveśa naimiṣaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ
hariṃ sadyaḥ prabhuṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate yatra kilbiṣāt / svargasopānam etat tu pratyakṣaṃ devalokavat
tatra snātvā 'bhyarcya hariṃ haraṃ svargam avāpnuyāt / kīrtanān naimiṣasyāsya naro dahati tatkṣaṇāt
anekabhāvikaṃ ghoraṃ tūlarāśim ivānalaḥ / dīkṣitā brāhmaṇā devāḥ kutaścit tu samāgatāḥ
ārtānām ayutaṃ tebhyo dadau devāya cānagha / sahasram ekaṃ nṛpatirbhūṣaṇānāṃ ca bhārata
oṃ namaḥ śaṅkarāyeti mādhavāyeti cottamaḥ / jaladarbhau samādāya pātre rājā hiraṇmaye
evaṃ saṃkalpya rājendra yajñavāṭam akārayat / daśayojanaparyantaṃ yajñayūpāś ca hemajān
tato nirvartito yajño vaśiṣṭhapramukhair dvijaiḥ / muditā devatāḥ sarvā divyayānasamāśritāḥ
jayaśabdaṃ pracakrus tā rājā nānyo bhavatsamaḥ / nānyo mama samaḥ kaścid ityahaṃkāravān nṛpaḥ
yāvad yānaṃ samāruhya sāntaḥpuraparicchadaḥ / niḥsṛto naimiṣāraṇyāt tāvat paśyati vānaram
tiṣṭha tiṣṭhety uvācātha śṛṇu rājan vaco mama / kiṃ te yajñavidhānena devatādānakarmaṇi
ahaṃkāravimūḍhātmā kartāham iti manyase / purāmareśvare yajñe satyadharmasya bhūpateḥ
varjayitvā mukham me 'bhūt kaṇṭhādho hemavarṇakam / ye gatāḥ śiśavas teṣāṃ sarvāṅgāś ca hiraṇmayāḥ
kapilā narmadāyoge yajñatoyapravāhataḥ / snānāvagāhanāt pānāl loḍanāt kardame tathā
gandharvalokaṃ samprāpto bhūtagrāmaś caturvidhaḥ / tvadīye lulitaṃ yajñe naimiṣāraṇyasambhave
paṅkena liptaṃ gātraṃ me kṣālitaṃ cāmbunā tathā / na kiṃcit phalamāsīn me tava yajño nirarthakaḥ
gavāṃ tvayāyute dattaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā bahu / bhūbhujā satyadharmeṇa kiṃtu tāvan nirarthakam
dānena tapasā vāpi trayo lokāḥ samarjitāḥ / sarveṣām eva tīrthānāṃ mātā vai mekalā smṛtā
etat te kathitaṃ rājan yathābhūd amareśvare / svasti vo 'stu gamiṣyāmi tvaṃ vāyodhyā prati vraja
aham eva gamiṣyāmi narmadāṃ saptakalpagām / śrutvā tvadīyaṃ yajñaṃ hi naimiṣāraṇyam āgataḥ
nirāśo 'haṃ gamiṣyāmi nābhūn me kāṃcanaṃ mukham / vānarasya vacaḥ śrutvā yuvanāśvo 'bravīd vacaḥ
kastvaṃ vānararūpeṇa satyam etad bravīṣi me / vānara uvāca: ahaṃ jābālinaḥ putraḥ kadambo nāma viśrutaḥ
tiryagyonau praviṣṭaś ca prākṛtaiḥ karmabhiḥ svakaiḥ / bhrāntāni sarvatīrthāni veṣeṇānena suvrata
paritrāṇaṃ paraṃ nābhūt satyadharmamakhottame / vapur hiraṇmayaṃ sarvaṃ mukhavarjaṃ mamābhavat
vānarasya vacaṃ śrutvā sannivṛtya nṛpottamaḥ / ārādhya devadeveśaṃ naimiṣe yajñapūruṣam
uvāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ praṇipatya prasādya ca / madīyayajñe dānena tapasā niyamena ca
śamicchaṃ chrāvayāmāsa eko vānararūpadhṛk / hiraṇmayaṃ mukhaṃ cāsya yathā syāt tvaṃ tathā kuru
uvāca vacanaṃ devo yuvanāśvaṃ mahīpatim / pratyakṣaṃ naimiṣaṃ tīrthaṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham
pṛthivyāṃ naimiṣaṃ tīrtham antarikṣe ca puṣkaram / triṣu lokeṣu vikhyāto giriś cāmarakaṇṭakaḥ
na ca śrutaṃ tvayā tāta purāṇaṃ skandakīrtitam / mātā sā yatra saritāṃ tīrthānāṃ ca saridvarā
nāmasaṃkīrtanādasyā mucyate bhavabandhanāt / viṣādaṃ tyaja tīrthānāṃ pradhāno 'marakaṇṭakaḥ
satyadharmaḥ punas tatra kariṣyati makhottamam / revākapilayor yoge mukhaṃ tatra hiraṇmayam
bhaviṣyati na sandehas tava vānarasattama / naimiṣaṃ sa namaskṛtya ādidevaṃ haraṃ harim
sthānaṃ svaṃ ca jagāmātha mudā paramayā yutaḥ / naimiṣasya vacaḥ śrutvā ayodhyādhipatis tathā
viveśa nagarīṃ puṇyāṃ yathā śakro 'marāvatīm / vānaro 'pi gatas tatra satyadharmo yataḥ svayam
praṇamya satyadharmākhyam idaṃ vacanam abravīt / revākapilayor yoge tvadīye ca mahāmakhe
avabhṛthasnānajanite kardame luṭhanān mama / śarīraṃ kāñcanībhūtaṃ mukham evāvaśiṣyate
yajñamiṣṭvā punas tatra mukhaṃ me kāñcanaṃ kuru / gandharvādhipatir bhūyo mukto vānarayonitaḥ
hemībhūtavapus tatra yadā vānarasattamaḥ / devandundubhinādena nānālaṅkārabhūṣitaḥ
haṃsayuktena yānena vījyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ / jagāma śāṅkaraṃ lokaṃ tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ
tatra ye śvāpadās sarve te 'pi snātvā divaṅgatāḥ / etat te kathitaṃ pārtha yathāvṛttaṃ purātanam
śravaṇāt kīrtanāc cāsya gosahasraphalaṃ labhet

mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: gāvaḥ pavitramatulaṃ gāvaḥ sarvārthasādhakāḥ / tasmāddhi gopradānena śivabhaktyā pramucyate
yasmin deśe bhaven nityaṃ śivabhaktisamanvitaḥ / so 'pi deśo bhavet pūtaḥ kiṃ punaś ca sabāndhavaḥ
uktāni ṣaṭsahasrāṇi purāṇe mekalātaṭe / ityāha jñānayogasya dharmayogasya tattvavit
dharmādharmagatīnāṃ ca svarūpam upavarṇitam / tīrthākhyānasamāyuktaṃ narmadākhyānam uttamam
kīrtanāc chravaṇāt tasya mucyate bhavabandhanāt / vidyāṃ siṃhāsane divye vastrapuṣpādhivāsitām
pūjayitvā haraṃ viṣṇuṃ śṛṇuyād vācayet tathā / śrīmatsiṃhāsanaṃ vāpi kḷptaṃ haimaṃ suśobhanam
hemavastroparicchannaṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitam / rājataṃ tāmrakaṃ kāṃsyaṃ brahmacārivinirmitam
tat tu tārasamudbhūtaṃ śṛṅgavad ratnabhūṣitam / divyaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ vāpi pūjāṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ
gandhādhivasitakaraḥ śrīmadāsanasaṃsthitaḥ / śambhvāyatanatīrtheṣu narendra bhavaneṣu ca
bodhayet paramaṃ dharmaṃ gṛhagrāmapureṣu ca / narmadākīrtanācchrotā śivaloke mahīyate
idaṃ tīrtham idaṃ tīrthaṃ paryaṭan neti vai naraḥ / narmadaiva paraṃ tīrtham ity āha bhagavān chivaḥ
asmiṃstīrthe naraśreṣṭha śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ vidhānataḥ / svāgatena yamaḥ prītaś cāsanena śatakratuḥ
pitaraḥ pādaśaucena atrādyena prajāpatiḥ / viprapādodakaklinnā yāvat tiṣṭhati medinī
tāvat puṣkarapātreṣu pibanti pitaro jalam / vidyāvate snātakāya bhikṣave śrotriyāya ca
tathā paramahaṃsāya viṣṇuvratadharāya ca / sarvopaskaraṇaṃ dattvā śivaloke mahīyate
anāhitāgniṃ yo vipram āhitāgniṃ karoti ca / brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ svavittenaiva kārayet
ardhārdhaṃ saphalaṃ tasya yāvaj jīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ / viṣṇuloke 'ntakāle ca bhogān bhuṅkte ca puṣkalān
svadravyeṇa ca yo yajñaṃ karoti vidhivad dvijaḥ / narmadātīram āsādya brahmaloke sa modate
dhātrīṃ hiraṇmayīṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāya prakalpayet / kalpagā tīram āśritya viṣṇuloke mahīyate
tilataṇḍulakarpūrasusambhojyavimiśritaiḥ / kuṅkumair vastradhānyaiś ca nirmitaṃ śivasannidhau
parvakāle ca yo dadyāt parvate mekalātaṭe / vaset viṣṇulokeṣu naraḥ svarge na saṃśayaḥ
pratyakṣadhenuṃ yo dadyāt hemaratnavibhūṣitām / ghṛtadhenuṃ guḍadhenuṃ śarkarādhenum eva ca
revākapilayor yoge dattvaitān narasattamaḥ / sarvapāpavinirmukto loke krīḍati vaiṣṇave
yadi tatra mahārāja bhikṣānnaṃ ca niveditam / tasya saṃkhyā na vidyeta sa yāvat saṃgamo nṛpa
etat sarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ kathitaṃ tava suvrata / vaivasvate 'ntare 'thānyac chṛṇu tvaṃ nṛpasattama
vīraṇasya tu rājarṣer maitreyo 'bhūt purohitaḥ / tena cāyatanaṃ viṣṇoḥ kāritaṃ narmadātaṭe
puryāś caivāmarāvatyā diśi yāmyāṃ vyavasthitam / tadāyatanamāhātmyān narmadāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ
modate vaiṣṇave loke yugasyārddhaṃ dvijottamaḥ / śṛṇu tvaṃ yāni tīrthāni revāyāḥ paścimottare
vanaṃ meghavanaṃ nāma yajñaparvatam āśritam / rantidevaḥ purā tatra cakravartī yudhiṣṭhira
gavi nītaṃ kulaṃ yena sa devāsuramānuṣam / pitaro mocitā yena gobhir vinihatāḥ purā
cāṇḍālaiś ca hatā ye ca prāpnuvanti parāṃ gatim / cāṇḍālād udakāt sarpād vidyuto brāhmaṇād api
dantibhyaś ca paśubhyaś ca maraṇaṃ pāpaśālinām / viṣṇor balipradānena kriyāṇāṃ karaṇena ca
tīrthapiṇḍapradānena te yānti paramāṃ gatim / dadhīcir nāma rājarṣir avantyadhipatis tathā
sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ śakratulyaparākramaḥ / purā devāsure yuddhe daityair devā vinirjitāḥ
devānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca hantāro daityakaṇṭakāḥ / naṣṭāḥ svapāpadoṣeṇa sabhṛtyakulabāndhavāḥ
devāḥ samuditāḥ sarve lokapālāḥ savāsavāḥ / nirvighnaṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā lokaṃ caiva carācaram
vindhyaṃ giriṃ gatās te tu yasmin vahati kalpagā / samarthaṃ bhūpatiṃ jñātvā dadhīciṃ kurusattama
dattāny astrāṇi rakṣārthaṃ tasya rājñaḥ surottamaiḥ / vajraṃ śaktiṃ tathā pāśaṃ daṇḍaṃ khaḍgaṃ dhvajaṃ gadām
triśūlaṃ ceti devānām āyudhāni pracakṣate / tāni dattvā yathā nyāyaṃ nākapṛṣṭhaṃ mudā yayuḥ
purāṇamatamājñāya dadhīciḥ satyavikramaḥ / śāpasyaiva bhayād bhīto namaskṛtya pragṛhya ca
prabhāvāt toyatāṃ nītvā śarīrāntar nyaveśayat / tataḥ kālāntare prāpte dānavā baladarpitāḥ
jambhakumbhahayagrīvapramukhāḥ punarutthitāḥ / dānavānāṃ balaṃ jñātvā trastā devāḥ savāsavāḥ
kāryakāle samutpanne saṃsmṛtyāstrāyudhāni ca / nārada preṣayāmāsuḥ dadhīciṃ prati bhārata
avantīṃ sa purīṃ prāpya devarṣir nāradas tathā / viveśa bhavanaṃ rājño maṇikāñcanavedikam
utthito nṛpaśārdūlo muniṃ dṛṣṭvā sutejasam / pūjayitvā yathā nyāyaṃ hemakāsanasaṃsthitam
taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā sukhāsīnaṃ rājā vacanam abravīt / kim arthaṃ mānuṣe loke devalokāt samāgataḥ
nārada uvāca: yuddhaṃ mahat samutpannaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha / samarpaya tvaṃ śastrāṇi kṣīyante dānavā yathā
kuru kāryaṃ ca devānāṃ satyadharmavrate sthitaḥ / dadhīcir uvāca: śṛṇu kāryaṃ ca devarṣe devānāṃ hitakāmyayā
acireṇaiva kālena kṣayaṃ yāsyanti dānavāḥ / mayā tāny eva śastrāṇi rakṣaṇārthaṃ mahāmune
āpobhūtāni pītāni śarīre santi tāni vai / upāyena hi gṛhṇantu dāsyāmy etāni vai punaḥ
ityuktvā ca nṛpaśreṣṭha ājuhāva ca gāḥ purā / māṃsādibhakṣitaṃ gobhir asthivarjaṃ viśāmpate
astragrāmas tataḥ prāpto lokapālair yathā tathā / gonardaṃ nāma nagaraṃ tat tu lokeṣu viśrutam
dānavā nihatā devaiḥ punaḥ sṛṣṭiḥ pravartitā / acintayat tadā tatra rantidevo mahīpatiḥ
govidyutpaśucāṇḍālasarpairvinihatā narāḥ / devalokaṃ na te yānti na teṣāmudakakriyā
śocayitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ sāntaḥpuraparigrahaḥ / prakṣālya narmadātoye tadasthīni vyasarjayat
liṅgaṃ brahmeśvaraṃ tatra yajñaparvatasannidhau / dharmasaṃśayam āpanno rantidevo mahīpatiḥ
papraccha muniśārdūlān vaśiṣṭhapramukhān dvijān / triḥpradakṣiṇam āvṛtya yathā nyāyam idaṃ vacaḥ
ke deśāḥ parvatāḥ puṇyā nadyaḥ kāḥ kīrtitāḥ śubhāḥ / narakasthān pitṝn yatra tadvadeyuḥ samuddharet
akṣayaṃ ca pitṛśrāddhaṃ pitṝṇām akṣayā gatiḥ / ṛṣaya ūcuḥ: mārkaṇḍeyāśramaṃ gaccha asmābhiḥ saha bhūpate
so 'pi sarvaṃ vijānīyāt kalpagā tīramāśritaḥ / tac chrutvā rantidevo 'pi munibhiḥ paribhāṣitaḥ
jagāma munibhiḥ sārddhaṃ kalpagātīravāsinam / sa rājā brāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ praṇipatya tathā 'rcayat
samutthāyābravīd vākyam upaviṣṭaḥ kuśāsane / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: kān na mocayate ghorān pitṝn saṃsārasāgarāt
śṛṇvantu mama vākyāni munayo viditātmanaḥ / sarvatīrthamayī revā sarvārthātmamayī śubhā
śivenaitat nigaditaṃ purāṇe skandakīrtite / kubjārevāsamāyoge viśeṣāt surapūjite
tatra snātā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ / tatra śrāddhena yogena pitṝṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ
idaṃ te kathitaṃ rājan kubjārevāsamāgame / arcayitvā maheśānaṃ tatra bilvāmrakāhvayam
sarvapāpavinirmukto gāṇapatyam avāpnuyāt / sārdhakoṭis tu kanyānāṃ tatra siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ
śaptāstāḥ pūrvamunibhiḥ kāmadoṣeṇa bhārata / vidyādharāś ca yakṣāś ca gandharvāḥ kinnarās tathā
śaptāstenaiva doṣeṇa kuberapuravāsinaḥ / sarve te siddhim āpannāḥ kubjārevāsamāgame
amāsomasamāyoge kārttikyāṃ caiva parvaṇi / vārāṇasī prayāgaś ca puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā
ete snātuṃ samāyānti kubjārevāsamāgame / śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya śivaloke mahīyate

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe rantidevopākhyānaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 62 rantideva uvāca: yathā śaptās tu tāḥ kanyās tāsāṃ nāmāni kalpaga / śrotum icchāmi tattvena keṣu sthāneṣu pūjitā
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: vārāṇasyāṃ viśālākṣī naimiṣe liṅgadhāriṇī / prayāge lalitādevī kāmukā gandhamādane
mānase kumudā nāma viśvayonis tathāmbare / gomante gomatī nāma mandare kāmacāriṇī
madotkaṭā caitrarathe tapantī hastināpure / kānyakubje tathā gaurī prabhā kamalaparvate
ekāgre kīrtimatyākhyā viśvā viśveśvare tathā / puṣkare puruhūteti kedāre mārgadāyinī
nandā himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe gokarṇe bhadrakārṇikā / sthāneśvare bhavānīti bilvake bilvapatrikā
śrīśaile mādhavī nāma bhadrā bhadreśvare tathā / jayā vārāhaśaile tu kamalā kamalālaye
rudrakoṭyāṃ tu rudrāṇī koṭiḥ kālañjare tathā / mahāliṅge tu kapilā mākoṭe mukuṭeśvarī
śālagrāme mahādevī śivaliṅge jalapriyā / māyāpuryāṃ kumārī tu santāne lalitā tathā
utpalākhye sahasrākṣī hiraṇyākṣe mahotpalā / tīrthāyāṃ maṅgalā nāma vimalā puruṣottame
vipāśāyāmamoghākṣī pāṭalā puṇḍravardhane / nārāyaṇī supārśve ca trikūṭe bhadrasundarī
vipule vipulā nāma kalyāṇī pralayācale / koṭīvikoṭi tīrthe tu yamunāyāṃ mṛgāvatī
karavīre mahālakṣmīr umādevī vināyake / ārogyā vaidyanāthe tu mahākāle maheśvarī
abhayā kṛṣṇatīrthe tu amṛtā vindhyakandare / māṇḍavye māṇḍukā nāma svāhā māheśvare pure
chāgalambā pracaṇḍe ca caṇḍikā 'marakaṇṭake / someśvare varāhī tu prabhāse puṣkarāvatī
devamātā sarasvatyāṃ pārā pārāvate tathā / mahālaye mahābhāgā payoṣṇyāṃ piṅgaleśvarī
saṃhitā kṛtaśauce tu kārttikeye tu śāṅkarī / utpalā varṣake lolā subhadrā śoṇasaṅgame
mālāsiddhatale lakṣmīranantā bhāratāśrame / jālandhare siddhamukhī tārā kiṣkindhaparvate
devadāruvane puṣṭir medhā kaśmīramaṇḍale / bhīmādevī himādrau tu tuṣṭir vastreśvare tathā
kapālamocane siddhir mātā kāyāvarohaṇe / śaṅkhoddhāre dhṛtir nāma dhvaniḥ piṇḍārake tathā
kalā tu candrabhāgāyām akṣode śivadhāriṇī / vaijayanty amṛtā nāma badaryām oṣadhī tathā
oṣadhī cottarakurau kuśadvīpe kuśodakā / manmathā himakūṭe tu pramate satyavādinī
aśvatthe vandinī nāma nidhirvaiśravaṇe tathā / gāyatrī vedavadane pārvatī śivasannidhau
devaloke tathendrāṇī brahmaṇāsye sarasvatī / sūryabimbe prabhā nāma mātṛkā vaiṣṇavī tathā
arundhatī satīnāṃ ca apsarassu tilottamā / citirbrahmakalā nāma śaktiḥ sarvaśarīriṇām
etad uddeśataḥ proktaṃ nāmāṣṭaśatam uttamam / aṣṭottaraṃ tu tīrthānāṃ śatam ekaṃ hy udāhṛtam
yaḥ paṭhet prātarutthāya sa yāti paramāṃ gatim / eṣu tīrtheṣu ye snātvā etāḥ paśyānti mānavāḥ
sarvapāpavinirmuktās te yānti paramāṃ gatim / yaḥ karoti tanutyāgam umāsthāneṣu mānavaḥ
sa bhittvā brahmasadanaṃ padamāpnoti śāṅkaram / nāmāṣṭakaśataṃ yas tu śrāvayec chivasannidhau
tṛtīyāyāṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ bahuputro bhaven naraḥ / godāne śrāddhakāle ca vivāhe maṅgale tathā
devārcanavidhau vāpi paṭhan brahmatvam āpnuyāt / śrutvaitat stotramatulaṃ namaskṛtya ca parvatam
rājā svapitṛmokṣāya yajñārthaṃ prāha kalpagam / kasmiṃs tīrthe bhaved yajñaḥ pitṝṇāṃ mokṣadāyakaḥ
iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe mātṛstutirnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 63 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: revātaṭe mahāpuṇye pitṝṇāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ prati / kuru yajñaṃ mahābhāga mucyante pitaro yathā
iti śrutvā mahārāja namaskṛtya ca kalpagām / vaśiṣṭhapramukhaiḥ sārddhaṃ jagāma svapuraṃ nṛpaḥ
sa vatsānāṃ ca lakṣaikamaprasūtāyutaṃ tathā / viṃśatiḥ śyāmakarṇānāṃ hayānāṃ ca daśāyutam
maṇimāṇikyamuktādi bhūṣitoccaiḥ śravastviṣām / ayutaṃ ca karīndrāṇāṃ ghaṇṭābharaṇaśobhinām
maṇimāṇikyaratnānāṃ saṃkhyāṃ kartuṃ na śakyate / nānādeśanṛpaiḥ sārddhaṃ brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ
veṇuvīṇāninādena brahmaghoṣaraveṇa ca / āpūrayan diśaḥ sarvā divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca saṃspṛśan
harṣeṇa mahatā yukto yajñasambhārasaṃvṛtaḥ / rantidevo mahīpālaḥ kalpagātīram āśritaḥ
anekabhakṣabhojyānāṃ tatra saṃkhyā na vidyate / aṣṭayojanaparyantaṃ yajñayūpāś ca maṇḍapāḥ
hemaratnamayāḥ stambhā maṇimauktikabhūṣitāḥ / hiraṇmayāni kuṇḍāni vedikāś ca sahasraśaḥ
sruvaś ca yajñapātrāṇi sarvaṃ svarṇam ayaṃ tathā / samāhūtās tato devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
candrādityau grahaiḥ sārddhaṃ nakṣatradhruvamaṇḍalam / siddhā vidyādharā yakṣāḥ surāsuramahoragāḥ
devarājaś ca devāś ca bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ / tato yajñaḥ samārabdho brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ
homena tarpitā devāḥ sarvalokanivāsinaḥ / nirdhūmaś ca jvalad vahṇiḥ saptajihvāsamanvitaḥ
pratyakṣo havyavāhaś ca svayaṃ yajñe narādhipa / tato nivartito yajño brāhmaṇair āptadakṣiṇaiḥ
ghoṣaṇā bhrāmitā rāṣṭre pratīhāraiḥ sahasraśaḥ / yo yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ so 'tra taṃ tvetyasaṃśayaḥ
āhūtāḥ pūrvajās tatra mātṛkāḥ paitṛkās tathā / apamṛtyuvaśaṃ prāptās tiryagyonigatāś ca ye
te sarve śubhayonitvam āpannā yajñayogataḥ / arcitā narmadādevīṃ pratyakṣā rūpadhāriṇī
arcito bhagavāṃs tatra pārvatyā sahito haraḥ / śrīpatiś ca śriyā sārddhaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ
śakrādayas tathā devāḥ sapatnīkā alaṃkṛtāḥ / gāścāśvāṃś ca karīndrāṃś ca brāhmaṇebhyo nyavedayat
yac cānyad vidyate kiṃcid dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ payo dadhi / agniśaucāni vastrāṇi sarvaṃ tebhyo nyavedayat
yugapat pūjitā devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / arcitā narmadādevī śailamūle vyavasthitā
pravāho nirgato yatra kubjārevāsamāgame / pitaras tarpitā devāḥ prāptāś ca paramāṃ gatim
divyayānasamārūḍho dadhīciś ca nṛpottamaḥ / śatamaṣṭottaraṃ pūrvaṃ paścimaṃ tad anantaram
devayānapathe santaḥ śataśo 'tha nṛpottama / ūcuś ca devās te sarve brahmādyā rantidevakam
vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te prītāḥ satyenānena bhūmipa / prāpto 'si paramaṃ lokaṃ pitṛbhir mātṛbhiḥ saha
rantidevo 'bravīd vākyaṃ yūyaṃ me varadā yadi / kalaśaḥ sthāpito yatra brāhmaṇair vedapāragaiḥ
caturvedadharairbhaktaiḥ pañcabrahmatanuḥ svayam / śivaliṅgaṃ bhavet tatra jvālāmālāsamaprabham
yajñaparvatam āsādya pravāho yajñanirgataḥ / snāne vinirgatā kubjā caruke carukā tathā
carmilā cāṅghrimūle tu śilpe śilpā vinirgatā / dhanado devatāś cānyāḥ sampūjya praṇipatya ca
kalpagāṃ ca namaskṛtya kāmikaṃ yānam āśritāḥ / stotraṃ cakre mahābhāga liṅgarūpasya śūlinaḥ
lokanātho jagatsraṣṭā praṇipatya yathāvidhi / brahmo vāca: nāsti rudrasamo devo nāsti rudrasamo guruḥ
nityadāmalakāyāya svaprabhāmalamūrtaye / śivabhasmāṅgarāgāya deveśāya namo 'stu te
nīlakaṇṭhāya devāya sarvāyāmitamūrtaye / bahurūpāya kāntāya śāśvatāya namo 'stu te
parāya parameśāya sarvajñāya namo 'stu te / sarvapraṇatadehāya svayam apraṇatāya ca
pūjyānām api pūjyāya namastryakṣāya śūline / brahmendraviṣṇuvedyāya utpattisthitihetave
devastuta namaste 'stu bhuktimuktipradāya ca / vāmāya vāmarūpāya vāmomāropabhāsine
vāmakāntārdhavehāya īśānāya namo 'stu te / śrutvā stotram idaṃ devo brahmaṇaḥ so 'mitadyutiḥ
vṛṇīṣva vāñchitaṃ yajñe varam ity āha śaṅkaraḥ / dadāmi te na sandeho yas tvayā vara īpsitaḥ
uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā śaṅkaraṃ sarvagaṃ prabhum / pañcavaktraṃ pañcaliṅgaṃ brahmapūjyaṃ prakīrtitam
bilvā niveditā yasminn āmrāś ca viniveditāḥ / bilvāmrakannāma liṅgaṃ saṃsārārṇavatāraṇam
prasiddhiṃ paramāṃ yātu bhagavaṃs tvatprasādataḥ / vāmanā mekalā yatra yatredaṃ liṅgam uttamam
tatra snātvā naravyāghra śivalokam avāpyate / idaṃ varam ahaṃ manye lokānugrahakārakam
śaṅkaras tu tathety evaṃ prāha brahmāṇam avyayam / evam uktvā maheśāno gaṇakoṭisamāvṛtaḥ
stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ jagāma bhavanaṃ svakam / brahmādyā devatāś caiva gatāḥ svaṃ svaṃ niveśanam
rantidevaḥ pratuṣṭāva liṅgarūpadharaṃ śivam / niśamya rantidevasya stotraṃ prāha maheśvaraḥ
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te stotreṇānena suvrataṃ / rantidevo 'bravīd vākyaṃ yadi me varadaḥ śivaḥ
idaṃ tīrthaṃ na moktavyaṃ mahādeva sadā tvayā / aghaughasamaplutā ye tu tiryagyonigatā narāḥ
asya tīrthasya māhātmyāt te yāntu paramāṃ gatim / atra yad dīyate dānaṃ sarvaṃ bhavati cākṣayam
idaṃ varam ahaṃ manye yadi tuṣṭo 'si śaṅkara / śaṅkara uvāca: amāsomasamāyoge kārttikyāṃ caiva parvaṇi
atra yad dīyate dānaṃ tad anantaṃ samaśnute / etat te kathitaṃ rājaṃs tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam
viśvedevāḥ parāṃ siddhim asmiṃs tīrthe samāgatāḥ / agastyaśaunakaś caiva parāśaro 'ghamarṣaṇaḥ
saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ prāptā nānā munigaṇās tathā / atrāyutaṃ munīnāṃ ca tapasā divamāruhat
saṃkrame ca vyatīpāte grahaṇe candrasūryayoḥ / amāsomasamāyoge ṣaḍaśītimukhe tathā
puṇyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ vṛddhiṃ satyam etac chivoditam / sapādakoṭis tīrthānāṃ kubjārevāsamāgame
dakṣiṇottarabhāge tu krośamātraṃ pratiṣṭhitam / avaśaḥ svavaśo vā 'pi prāṇān yas tu parityajet
rājā varṣasahasrāṇi vidyādharapure bhavet / kṛmikīṭapataṅgādyās tīrthe 'smin prāṇamokṣaṇe
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu rājā vidyādhare pure / bilvāmrakaṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ kāmabhogaphalapradam
kubjeśvaraṃ mahac cānyad brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati / atrāntare mahārāja śivakṣetraṃ vidurbudhāḥ
revākubjāsamāyoge yavānāṃ saptatistathā / amāsomasamāyoge snānāc chāntiḥ prakīrtitā
vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ prayāgo naimiṣaṃ tathā / puṣkaraṃ ca gayā caiva kedāraṃ tīrtham uttamam
phalam eteṣu sāmānyam amāsomasamāgame / akṣayaṃ ca phalaṃ proktaṃ kubjārevāsamāgame
tilodakapradānena mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ sutaḥ / narakād uddharet sarvān pūrvān api parān api
so 'pi rājā gṛhaṃ prāptaḥ sarvān uddhṛtya pūrvajān / ayaṃ te kathito rājan kubjārevāsamāgamaḥ
rantidevo hariścandraḥ puruhūtaḥ purūravāḥ / atreṣṭvā vividhair yajñair divyanti divi devavat
śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya tīrthasya narasattama / sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā śivaloke mahīyate
iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe kubjāmāhātmye triṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 64 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athānyat kathayiṣyāmi tīrthaṃ tīrthavaraṃ śubham / yāmyapradeśe revāyā āśramaḥ surapūjitaḥ
suvarṇadvīpapavikhyāto devadroṇīsamāvṛtaḥ / hārīto gautamo viṣṇuḥ sāvarṇiḥ kauśikas tathā
ete cānye ca bahavo munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ / māsopavāsinaḥ kecid anye pakṣopavāsinaḥ
cāndrāyaṇaparāś cānye tathānye kṛcchracāriṇaḥ / phalamūlāśinaḥ kecit tathānye vāyubhakṣakāḥ
kaṇadhūmaṃ pibanty anye jalāhārās tathā pare / ekapādāḥ sthitāḥ kecid anye cārdhapadāḥ sthitāḥ
dantolūkhalinaḥ kecidanye sūryāvalokinaḥ / brāhmaṇāś ca brahmavidaḥ śrutismṛtiviśāradāḥ
itihāsapurāṇāni mokṣopāyavicintakāḥ / agnihotraparā nityaṃ japayajñakriyāparāḥ
vedadhvanitanirghoṣais tārayanti jagattrayam / na tasmin saṃcaret pāpaṃ tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā
mekalādakṣiṇe tīre brahmaloka iva sthitaḥ / āmrajambūkadambaiś ca kapitthair bilvadāḍimaiḥ
kadalībījapūrādyair jambīraiḥ panasais tathā / nyagrodhabadarair mukhyair bahuvṛkṣavibhūṣitam
punnāgair nāgabakulair aśokais tilakais tathā / mandāraiś campakaiś cāmrātakair nīlotpalotpalaiḥ
patrapuṣpaphalopetair vṛkṣaiḥ sarvair alaṃkṛtam / nānāpakṣigaṇopetaṃ siddhagandharvasevitam
vyāharatyaṇḍajāḥ sarve mānuṣāṇāṃ girā nṛpa / etad guṇasamāyuktaṃ suvarṇadvīpam uttamam
svāyambhuve 'ntare rājann ādikalpe kṛte yuge / arcanād devadevasya suvarṇadvīpavāsinaḥ
apahāya tamaḥ kṛtsnaṃ loke krīḍanti śāṅkare / pitṝṇām annadānena tilatoyapradānataḥ
malāpakarṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā vasanti brahmaṇaḥ pure / puṇyāyāṃ bhūpakārtikyāṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradaḥ
naitat paśyanti manujāḥ kalau māyāvimohitāḥ / kalpagā yāmyabhāge tu tīrthakoṭiranekadhā
prasiddhaṃ siddhamunibhir jñāyate kevalaṃ hi tat / nāstikair bhinnamaryādaiḥ purāṇasmṛtinindakaiḥ
tailābhyaktair na vedoktakarai revātaṭe tathā / kalimāyāvimūḍhaiś ca sthānaṃ tanna pradṛśyate
hiraṇyagarbhāsthāne tu yasmin vahati kalpagā / yajñagarbheśvaraṃ nāma śivaliṅgaṃ prakīrtitam
pūjyate siddhagandharvaiḥ surāsuramahoragaiḥ / yatra vaivasvato rājā sūryaputro mahāyaśāḥ
tasya tīrthasya māhātmyāc candrabimbānano 'bhavat / caitrasyaiva tu māsasya śuklapakṣe narādhipa
caturdaśyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yatra sannihito haraḥ / tilodakapradānena piṇḍadānena bhārata
pitṝn samuddharet tatra narakād bhūridakṣiṇaḥ / nivased vaiṣṇave loke yāvac candrārkadarśanam
tatra yaddīyate dānaṃ kurukṣetrasamaṃ hi tat / prāṇatyāge kṛte tatra na paśyanti yamālayam
revāyā uttare kūle paryaṅko nāma parvataḥ / sa ca vindhyasutaḥ śrīmān sarvadevamayaḥ śubhaḥ
tatra pāpaharo viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ / narapāpaharo yas tu narmadātaṭam āśritaḥ
tatra snātvā mahārāja gosahasraphalaṃ labhet / tarpitāḥ pitaras tasya tṛptā yānti hareḥ puram
ekādaśīṃ dvādaśīṃ vā tatra yaḥ kurute naraḥ / na tasya punarāvṛttir martyaloke durāsade
krośamātrapramāṇaṃ ca harikṣetraṃ prakīrtitam / apamṛtyumṛtā ye ca te yānti paramāṃ gatim

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe viṣṇukīrtanaṃ nāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 65 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadāyāmyabhāge tu tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / māṇḍavyasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ siddhagandharvasevitam
vibhāṇḍakaś ca gārgyaś ca ṛṣyaśṛṅgādayas tathā / tasmin sahasrasaṃkhyātā munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
aśokavanikāṃ rājan chṛṇu sāmpratamuttamam / tatra sannihito deva umayā sahito haraḥ
āviṣṭaś cāśrame tatra viśoko vimalaḥ śivaḥ / viśokayā saricchreṣṭhā narmadā yatra saṅgatā
tatra snātā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ / aśokeśvaraliṅgam ca pratyakṣaṃ siddhiśaṅkaram
śāpabhraṣṭā dvijās tatra nāradena vimocitāḥ / tasya tīrthasya māhātmyāt modante divi devatāḥ
nānāvṛkṣaphalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaiḥ / nānā pakṣigaṇairjuṣṭaṃ nānāvṛkṣaniṣevitam
siddhavidyādharair yakṣair gandharvaiḥ kinnarais tathā / veṇuvīṇāninādena śaṅkhavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ
śobhate sarvadā rājan narmadā vindhyasaṅgamaḥ / aśokā devatā yatra brahmaśakrapurogamāḥ
viśvedevāśramaṃ taddhi sarvadevanamaskṛtam / viśvāyāś ca tathā putrā viśvedevāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
aśokavanikāyāṃ ca janayāmāsa kaśyapaḥ / vaivasvate 'ntare prāpte tretāyāṃ narasattama
pañcāyutāni tāni tīrthāni nivasanti śubhāni ca / tatra siddhā ca sāvitrī devamātāditis tathā
devayānī tathendrāṇī rohiṇī saṃbharāyaṇī / dākṣāyaṇī lokavandyā lopāmudrā mahāyaśā
ratnāvalī sūryabhāryā dhruvā tārā gaṇeśvarī / aśokās tena vihitās tatrasthāḥ śatasaṃkhyakāḥ
asya tīrthasya māhātmyān mucyate kilbiṣān naraḥ / śuklapakṣe caturdaśyām āśvine māsi bhārata
aputriṇī tathā bandhyā durbhagā bhartṛvarjitā / pañcaratnaphalaiḥ snātā divyakumbhaiḥ samarcayet
sahasrajanma sā bhūyaḥ putriṇī subhagā bhavet / aśokavanikā kṣetre tatra gauryā varaḥ kṛtaḥ
yasmin vahati sā devī narmadā saptakalpagā / tatreṣṭaṃ dharmarājena varuṇena mahātmanā
nairṛtyena tathānyaiś ca lokapālair yathā vidhi / pratyakṣo havyavāhaś ca lokapālānupāgataḥ
atrir marīciḥ kaśyapaś cakrus tatra makhottamam / anyakṣetrāc chataguṇā tatra dānādikā kriyā
vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ gayā vai naimiṣaṃ tathā / māyāpurī puṣkaraṃ ca prayāgaḥ śaśibhūṣaṇam
kāśyapī sarvatīrthāni yatra tiṣṭhati kalpagā / aśokavanikāyās tu nānyat tīrthaṃ samaṃ viduḥ
iṣṭaṃ yatra purā rājan hayamedhaṃ makhottamam / brahmaṇā mocitāḥ pūrvaṃ viprāḥ kauleyayonitaḥ
asya tīrthasya māhātmyāt pāṭalīputravāsinaḥ / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: hayamedhamakheneṣṭaṃ kathaṃ tāta svayambhuvā
kathaṃ ca mocitā viprāḥ pūrvaṃ kauleyayonitaḥ / ko vā rājā purā brahman devarājasamo 'bhavat
etat sarvaṃ yathā nyāyaṃ śaṃsa me munisattama / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan mahābhāga samākhyānaṃ purātanam
aśokavanikā tīrthaṃ kalpagā taṭamāśritam / na jānanti mahāmūḍhā manujāḥ pāpamohitāḥ
guptād guptataraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamam / viśokeśvaraliṅgaṃ tu tasmin paramasiddhidam
pūjyate siddhagandharvair na tat paśyanti mānuṣāḥ / darśanāt sparśanāt tasya brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati
svāyambhuve 'ntare prāpte ādikalpe kṛte yuge / raviś candro mahārāja cakravartī mahāyaśāḥ
somavaṃśe janiṃ prāptaḥ kāñcīpurapatis tathā / śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ yathā śakras triviṣṭapam
gatas tu pṛthivīpālo nānāvṛkṣasamākulam / nānāpakṣigaṇairjuṣṭaṃ nānāmuniniṣevatam
yatrāgastyeśvaraṃ nāma śambhorāyatanaṃ śubham / sevyate munibhiḥ sarvair agastyād yais tapodhanaiḥ
rāhusūryasamāyoge raviścandro nṛpottamaḥ / saptakalpavahā yatra śailaścāmarakaṇṭakaḥ
hastyaśvarathapādātaiḥ sakośabalavāhanaiḥ / tapasyantaṃ mahātmānaṃ munisaṅghaiḥ samāvṛtam
maitrāvaruṇikaṃ nāma jvalantamiti pāvakam / teṣāṃ madhye samutthāya śāṇḍilyaś ca mahātapāḥ
urasā pṛthivīṃ gatvā so 'gastiṃ paripṛcchati / raviścandro mahātejāḥ samāyātas tavāśramam
purohito 'ham asyāsmi jānīhi tvaṃ taponidhe / tvat pādārcanam ākāṅkṣī manyase ced anugrahaḥ
agastya uvāca: āgacchatu nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ śīghraṃ siṃhāsane sthitaḥ / āgatas tad anujñātaḥ pādau jagrāha tasya ca
arghapādyaiś ca sampūjya papraccha kuśalaṃ muniḥ / kuśalaṃ te mahābhāga sāntaḥ puraparicchadaḥ
uvāca vacanaṃ rājā munīndraṃ prati bhārata / adya me saphalaṃ janma rājyaṃ jīvanam eva ca
muktaś ca kilbiṣād asmāt tvātpādāmbujadarśanāt / sarvatra kalpagā puṇyā sarvatīrthamayī śubhā
kasmin sthāne yaje yajñaṃ śaṃsa me munisattama / yathā saṃsiddhyate yajñaḥ surāṇāṃ tṛptir akṣayā
etat sarvaṃ yathā nyāyaṃ trikālajña nivedaya / agastya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan mahābhāga kathyamānaṃ nibodha ca
śivena kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ pārvatyāḥ ṣaṇmukhasya ca / brahmaviṣṇvādidevānāmanyeṣāṃ ca divaukasām
mayā tatra śrutaṃ rājan mārkaṇḍena cirāyuṣā / tatte 'haṃ kathayiṣyāmi mekalātīrthasambhavam
śṛṇudhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve yat praṣṭavyāvatāraṇam / kasya śaktir mahārāja varjayitvā maheśvaram
pramāṇaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ saṃkhyāṃ vā kartum āditaḥ / uddeśamātravaktā 'haṃ mārkaṇḍasya mahāmuneḥ
etat te kathitaṃ rājan yathāvṛttaṃ purātanam
iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe narmadāmāhātmye pañcaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 66 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: evaṃ śrutaṃ purā rājñā raviścandreṇa dhīmatā / uvāca vacanaṃ śrīmānagastyo munisattama
sarasvatī na gaṅgā ca yamunā vā na sāgarāḥ / na caivānyāni tīrthāni prayāgapramukhāny api
ekaiva narmadā puṇyā saptakalpavahā śubhā / lakṣayojanaparyantaṃ jambūdvīpaṃ prakīrtitam
narmadātoyapānena lokāloke carācare / tapohīnā narāś caiva te 'pi yānti śivālayam
yo 'yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ sa taṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam / sādhu sādhu mahābhāga pṛṣṭo 'haṃ yat tvayānagha
narmadā kathitā divyā hṛdyā kasya na rocate / santi tīrthāni yāvanti dakṣiṇottarakūlayoḥ
tvatprītidāni tāvanti kathayāmi nṛpottama / anyāni granthalakṣeṇa na ca kīrtayituṃ kṣamaḥ
trayo vedāstrayo lokās tisraḥ sandhyāstrayo 'gnayaḥ / siddhagandharvayakṣāś ca sakinnaramahoragāḥ
vidyādharaś cāpsarasaḥ kalpagātaṭamāśritāḥ / oṃkārādīni liṅgāni vaidūryādinagāḥ purā
dvāpare ca kaliṃ prāpya pāvanatvam avāpnuyuḥ / brahmaviṣṇvādidevānāṃ maryādā kathyate 'dhunā
prabhābhirdyotamānāyā revāyā dakṣiṇottare / yajñabhūmiriyaṃ khyātā surāsuranamaskṛtā
aśokavanikā tatra tasyā devo maheśvaraḥ / tatra siddhyati nirvighno yajña ity āha śaṅkaraḥ
uvāca vacanaṃ rājā agastyaṃ munisattamam / svasti vo 'stu gamiṣyāmi tvayā saha mahāmune
aśokavanikāṃ prāptaḥ sa rājā munibhirvṛtaḥ / revāyā dakṣiṇe kūle puṇyatīrthesu śobhane
daśayojanaparyantaṃ yajñayūpāś ca maṇḍapam / maṇimāṇikyaratnaughaiḥ sarvadvāreṣu śobhitāḥ
patākādhvajaśobhāḍyā nānāvastrāvaguṇṭhitāḥ / viśvāmitro bharadvājaḥ kaśyapo bhārgavas tathā
brahmadṛśyo lomaśaś ca tathānye munisattamāḥ / vālakhilyā mahābhāgā mānasā brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
ete cānye ca bahavo munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ / tataḥ pravartito yajño brāhmaṇair āptadakṣiṇaiḥ
tṛptāś ca devatāḥ sarvāḥ pratijagmus triviṣṭapam / jagmuḥ sarve ca muditā munayaḥ svāśramaṃ prati
tato nivartito yajño durvāsāḥ kupito gataḥ / nātra vaivasvato nāhaṃ nāradaḥ parvatas tathā
kathaṃ nivartito yajñaḥ pāparkarminarādhamaiḥ / āgatas tu yamas tatra nāradaḥ parvatas tathā
lekhakaścitraguptaś ca kālo mṛtyus tathaiva ca / ete ca kupitāḥ sarve yajñabhāgaṃ vinā nṛpa
tān sarvān kupitān dṛṣṭvā raviścandro 'bravīd vacaḥ / aśokeśvaradevasya narmadāyāḥ prasādataḥ
ko me samartho vighnāya surāsuragaṇeṣv api / tathaiva ko 'nyo jantūnāṃ yajñavighnasya hetave
yajñakāle ca saṃprāpto ya kaścid api mānavaḥ / pūjanīyas tathārcyaś ca yathā devaścaturbhujaḥ
yathāyātā mahābhāgā brahmaputrā mahaujasaḥ / dadāmi vo na sandeho manasā yadabhīpsitam
durvāsā uvāca: paripūjyaś ca naḥ putro nāradaḥ parvatas tathā / ekākī prārthaye nāhaṃ militvā prārthayāmahe
raviścandra uvāca: yo yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ tasmai pradadāmy aham / iti sarve 'pi tenaiva prastutā munipuṅgavāḥ
suprītā vihitā rājann arghapādyapradānataḥ / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: munayaḥ kena kāryeṇa pāṭalīputravāsinaḥ
devyā śaptāḥ śvayoniṃ ca gatā muktāś ca te katham / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā tapodhanāḥ sarve jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇaḥ
naipāle vai paśupatiṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram / pūjayanti śivaṃ bhaktyā gauryā virahitaṃ haram
ardhanārīśvaraṃ devaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam / saṃśaptās tena kāryeṇa pārvatyā liṅgabhedinaḥ
varṣaṃ sahasraṃ hi mitaṃ śvayoniṃ ca gamiṣyatha / nirmālyabhakṣakāḥ pāpāścaṇḍadravyasya bhakṣakāḥ
teṣāṃ kṛte mahārāja durvāsā nṛpam abravīt / śvayoniṃ samanuprāptās tatra kāle munīśvarāḥ
mocaya tvaṃ tato rājann asmat priyacikīrṣayā / pārvatyā te 'bhiśaptāś ca narake majjanti dāruṇe
uvāca vacanaṃ rājā muniṃ durvāsasaṃ tataḥ / mocayāmi na sandehas tasmāt pāpād dvijottamān
preṣitāḥ kiṅkarās tena sīdanto yatra te vane / praṇipatya ca te sarve tānūcuś ca vanecarān
smārayanti pūrvajātim ādiṣṭāḥ prabhuṇā yathā / tatas tad vacanāt prāptās te 'śokavanikāṃ drutam
raviścandraścakravartī tān vilokya tapodhanān / mudā paramayā yuktaḥ prāha tān prahasann iva
aśokeśvaradevasya mekalāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ / mama dānaprabhāveṇa maharṣīṇāṃ prasādataḥ
tyaktvā śvayoniṃ munayaḥ śivalokaṃ prayāntu vai / etat pāpaṃ mahāghoraṃ mayi sarvaṃ niṣīdatu
tatkṣaṇān muktaśāpāste kāmikaṃ yānam āsthitāḥ / ūcur maharṣayo vākyaṃ raviścandraṃ śatakratum
tvaṃ mātā tvaṃ pitāsmākaṃ gururmokṣapradāyakaḥ / evam uktvā yayus te tu umāmāheśvaraṃ param
sādhu sādhu mahābhāga tvaṃ tu yajñataponidhiḥ / nā 'nyastvayā samaḥ kaścit somavaṃśe mahīpatiḥ
tvayā hi nirjitaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / evam uktvā suraśreṣṭhāḥ sādhuvādais tam ārcayan
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta ca / durvāsā uvāca: kṣatriyeṣu tvayā tulyo na dṛṣṭo na śruto mayā
prāṇatyāgo hi sukaro dharmatyāgo hi duṣkaraḥ / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vartate
prahasann abravīd vākyaṃ rājā durvāsasaṃ munim / mama dānaprabhāveṇa narā duṣkṛtabuddhayaḥ
prāpnuvan tu paraṃ lokaṃ vara eṣa mama priyaḥ / evamastviti tasyāgre 'bhidhāya munipuṅgavaḥ
sa mudā parayā yuktas tatraivāntaradhīyata / tad dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ karma rājñaś cāmitatejasaḥ
śaṅkayā parayā yukto dharmarājo 'bravīd idam / varaṃ dadāmi bhadraṃ te yajñabhāgabahiṣkṛtaḥ
śvayonitvaṃ gatā viprā mocitāḥ karmabandhanāt / īdṛśaṃ tava sāmarthyaṃ jānāmi ca nṛpottama
pṛthivyāṃ duṣkaraṃ karma yajñaś caiva viśeṣataḥ / yo dadāti mahābhāga svakīyaṃ puṇyamuttamam
yamaloko jitas tena devaloko jitas tathā / varayogyo 'si rājendra satyam etat mayoditam
raviścandra uvāca: yadi tuṣṭaḥ sūryaputra varaṃ dātuṃ mamecchasi / mama yajñaśatenaiva dānena tapasā tathā
pāpayonigatā ye tu ye ca duṣkṛtakāriṇaḥ / prayāntu tvatprasādena dharmarāja śivālayam
imaṃ varam ahaṃ manye prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi / yama uvāca: evaṃ bhavatu rājendra satyadharmaparāyaṇa
prāpnuhi tvaṃ paraṃ lokaṃ satyenānena suvrata / yatas te mocitāḥ sarvāḥ kaśmalāt pāpayonayaḥ
kṣatriyāḥ śataśo rājann anye caiva sahasraśaḥ / pāpāt samuddhṛtā ye ca teṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate
evamuktvā nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ dharmarājo mahābhujaḥ / kāmikaṃ yānamāruhya surāsuranamaskṛtam
yayau svabhavanaṃ rājan nāradaḥ parvatas tathā / tasyām aśītilakṣāṇi tīrthānāṃ narasattama
aśokavanikāyāṃ tu kīrtitāni tavānagha / śravaṇāt kīrtanāt teṣāṃ gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe 'śokavanikāvarṇano nāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 67 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athātaḥ kathayiṣyāmi tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / revāyā uttare kūle puraṃ vāgīśvarābhidham
vāgurnāma nadī tatra revayā saha saṃgatā / tatra snātā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ
vāgīśā tatra cāmuṇḍā dānavakṣayakāriṇī / maṇibhadro vīrabhadras tathā 'nye śataśo nṛpāḥ
babhūvur muktaśāpās te tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ / tilapiṇḍapradānena pitṝṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ
brahmadattaścakravartī sūryavaṃśe mahīpatiḥ / ayodhyādhipatiḥ śrīmān cakratulyaparākramaḥ
dhanadhānyasamāyukto bhayadāridryavarjitaḥ / prajās tasmin mahīpāle sarvā 'pi mudānvitāḥ
iṣṭaḥ kratuvarastena narmadāvāgusaṅgame / brahmādyā devatāḥ sarvāḥ śakraviṣṇupurogamāḥ
pratyakṣaś ca maheśāno gaṇeśvarasamanvitaḥ / lokapālāś ca marutaścandrādityau dhruvas tathā
ṛkṣāṇi yogasiddhāś ca somamukhyāś ca sarvaśaḥ / vaśiṣṭho munibhiḥ sārddhaṃ videhādhipatis tathā
evamādyāḥ samāhūtā mitrāvaruṇa eva ca / sarve hiraṇmayās tatra yajñayūpāś ca maṇḍapāḥ
daśayojanaparyantaṃ yajñabhūmir mahībhṛtaḥ / svārociṣe 'ntare rājann ādikalpe kṛte yuge
gavāṃ śatasahasrāṇi hemabhārānvitāni ca / hayānāṃ śyāmakarṇānām ayutaṃ sāgram eva ca
dantinām ayutaṃ caiva ghaṇṭābharaṇabhūṣitam / maṇimāṇikyam uktāś ca bhakṣyabhojyāny anekadhā
evaṃ rājā brahmadattaḥ sarvabhūpālasattamaḥ / yajñaṃ pravartayāmāsa sarvasambhārasaṃbhṛtaḥ
vedanirghoṣaśabdena gītavādyaraveṇa ca / nānāyānasamārūḍhaiḥ stūyamāno marudgaṇaiḥ
brahmadattasya yajñena vāgīśasya prasādataḥ / narmadāyāḥ prasādena pretās tṛptiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kathaṃ tu brahmadattasya kalpagātīrayājanam / kathaṃ pretā vinirmuktāḥ pretās te kena karmaṇā
etat sarvaṃ yathā nyāyaṃ kathayasva tapodhana / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan yathā nyāyam itihāsaṃ purātanam
kārttikyām utsavaṃ prāpya puṣkare jyeṣṭhapuṣkare / ayogandhaḥ svayaṃbhūś ca puṇḍarīkākṣa eva ca
pitāmahaḥ svayaṃ tatra surāsuraguruḥ pitā / kāvyaś ca hotṛsadanau vedagarbhaḥ kṛtadhvanaḥ
svastikaś caiva sāvitro vāmadevo 'ghamarṣaṇaḥ / ete cānye ca munayo brahmatejo 'śasaṃbhavāḥ
tathā te hi yathāśaktā ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ / gārhasthye ca sthitā bhāryā bhartṛśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ
cīravalkaladhāriṇyaḥ śākasyāmākabhakṣikāḥ / viṣaṇṇās tena dharmeṇa satyastā apyagarhayan
dvijasya ṣaṭ ca karmāṇi yajanaṃ yājanaṃ tathā / adhyāpanaṃ cādhyayanaṃ dānaṃ caiva pratigrahaḥ
bhūṣaṇaṃ paridhānaṃ ca yoṣitāṃ bhartṛsevanam / evaṃ ca garhitā rājan yoṣidbhiḥ patayas tathā
bhītās te vismitāḥ sarve viṣaṇṇavadanās tathā / hariścandraḥ purā rājā na bhūto na bhaviṣyati
dānena nirjitaṃ yena trailokyaṃ sacarācaram / rāhusūryasamāyoge kurukṣetraṃ jagāma ha
tyaktvā te puṣkaraṃ tīrthaṃ dhanalobhena mohitāḥ / sahasrasaṃkhyāmunayaḥ sabhāryāḥ sasutāś ca te
yatra rājā hariścandraḥ pratigrahavilipsayā / munīnāha hariścandro mudā paramayā yutaḥ
dhanyā me saphalā yātrā kurukṣetre ravigrahe / kṣudhārtā duḥkhitāś caiva bālā vṛddhāḥ kṛśāturāḥ
valkalājinavastrāś ca yauvane pretarūpiṇaḥ / yanno yūyam abhiprāptāḥ patnīputraiś ca saṃyutāḥ
uvāca vacanaṃ rājā sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇipatya ca / ādeśo dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ kiṃ karomi bhavatkṛte
evamuktvā dadau śrīmānekaikasya pṛthak pṛthak / lakṣaṃ lakṣaṃ hiraṇyasya tathā gāvaḥ sahasraśaḥ
sahasraṃ turagāṇāṃ ca dantināṃ śatam eva ca / sāptabhaumān gṛhān ramyān hemaprākāratoraṇān
nānāvidhavilāsāṃś ca yathā dhanapatiḥ svayam / kalpāntare mṛtā jātāḥ pretarūpā bhayaṅkarāḥ
lamboṣṭhā lambavṛṣaṇā vikṛtānanasaṃyutāḥ / pratigrahaprabhāveṇa dvijasya patanaṃ dhruvam
jātismarāḥ svaṃ śocanti ekākīnās tu te bahiḥ / na bhāryā na ca me putrā na bhṛtyā na ca bāndhavāḥ
na te pratigrahair dagdhā yathā pūrvaṃ tathaiva ca / vayam ekākino dagdhā vṛkṣā iva havirbhujā
rājapratigrahair dagdhā na prarohanti mānavāḥ / vaiśvānareṇa dagdhānāṃ punarjanma prajāyate
na mātā na pitā putro draviṇaṃ na ca bāndhavāḥ / yamadūtair gṛhītānāṃ dharma ekaḥ sahānugaḥ
śocitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ bhāryāputravivarjitāḥ / bhramitvā ca mahīṃ sarvāṃ puṣkaraṃ tīrthamāgatāḥ
pretarūpān munīn dṛṣṭvā viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ / tān uvāca muniśreṣṭhaḥ kathaṃ pretatvam āgatāḥ
pretā ūcuḥ: hariścandraḥ satyadharma sūryavaṃśe mahīpatiḥ / ayodhyādhipatiḥ śrīmān devatulyaparākramaḥ
tasya pratigraho 'smābhirāptaḥ sūryagrahe sthite / tena pretatvam āpannāḥ sarve brahmarṣayo mune
etat te kathitaṃ brahman mokṣo 'smākaṃ vidhīyatām / bhaviṣyabhūtatattvajño brahmaputras taponidhiḥ
uvāca vacanaṃ śrīmān nāradas tāṃs tapodhanān / kasminnavasare puṇye kārttikyāṃ divyaparvaṇi
śivena kīrtitaṃ pūrvaṃ pārvatyāḥ ṣaṇmukhasya ca / śrutaṃ mayāpi tatraiva purāṇaṃ skandakīrtitam
kānyā pāpakṣayaṃ kartuṃ śaktā revāṃ vinā nṛpa / gaṅgādyāḥ sarito viprāḥ puṇyatīrthās tathāpi ca
vāgīśaṃ ca puraṃ tatra narmadātaṭamāśritam / adhvare brahmadattasya mokṣaṇaṃ tu bhaviṣyati
uddeśaṃ tu tato dattvā nāradastridivaṃ gataḥ / te 'pi pretā mahābhāga dhyātvā śivam umāpatim
abhijagmus tam uddeśaṃ vāgīśapuram uttamam / tatra snātvābhyarcya śivaṃ hariṃ bhāskaram eva ca
adhvare brahmadattasya muktāḥ sarve 'pi kilbiṣāt / brahmayānaṃ samāruhya brahmalokaṃ samāgatāḥ
pratapanti yathādityā brahmatejovapurdharāḥ / tasyopari nareśasya puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papāta vai
etat te kathitaṃ rājan yathāvṛttaṃ purātanam / śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya gosahasraphalaṃ labhet

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe vāgīśvarākhyāna nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 68 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: pratigrahagrahagrastā lobhamohavimohitāḥ / majjanti narake ghore yatra gatvā na nirgatāḥ
saphalā vedayajñāś ca tīrthayātrā ca bhārata / tathā kliśyanti cātmānaṃ pratigrahaparā narāḥ
dātā ca yācakaś caiva karābhyām eva sūcitau / atho gacched grahītā tu dātā gacchati corddhvataḥ
sahasrāvartakaṃ nāma tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / tatra snātasya vidhivad vṛṣotsargaphalaṃ bhavet
āsaptamaṃ kulaṃ caiva punīte nā 'tra saṃśayaḥ / revāyā uttare kūle sahasrāyudhasaṃkhyayā
tataś cānte mahābhāga kārāyā vanam uttamam / agniṣṭomaphalaṃ yatra snātvā svargaṃ ca gacchati
revāyā uttare bhāge tīrtha paramaśobhanam / saugandhikaṃ vanaṃ nāma brahmacāriśucivratāḥ
siṣicuḥ pitaras tat tu brahmādyāḥ sutapodhanāḥ / siddhacāraṇagandharvāḥ sakinnaramahoragāḥ
praviśya tad vanaṃ martyaḥ sarvapāpāt pramucyate / tataḥ sarasvatī cāsti nadīnām uttamā nadī
lakṣyā devasutā rājan mahāpuṇyā prakīrtitā / tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta mānavo nṛpate jale
tarpayitvā pitṝn devān aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / īśānādhyuṣitaṃ nāma tatra tīrthaṃ sudurlabham
tatra snātvā vyatīpāte saṃkrāntau grahaṇe naraḥ / sahasrakapilādāne vājimedhe ca yatphalam
sugandhāṃ chātakumbhāś ca pañcayajñāṃś ca bhārata / abhigamya naraśreṣṭha svargaloke mahīyate
triśūlākhyaṃ tu tatraiva tīrtham āsādya bhārata / tatrābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ kuryād arcayet pitṛdaivatam
gaṇeśatvaṃ sa labhate tyaktvā dehaṃ na saṃśayaḥ / tato gacchen mahārāja brahmasthānam anuttamam
revāyā uttare kūle kāmabhogaphalapradam / brahmodam iti vikhyātaṃ prakāśyaṃ bhuvi bhārata
tatra saptarṣayaḥ prāptāḥ snānārthaṃ bharatarṣabha / kapiñjalo muniśreṣṭho havyavāhaś ca bhārata
bhagavān devayānaś ca viśvāvasumahāmuniḥ / asya tīrthasya māhātmyād brahmalokam avāpnuyuḥ
pitaraḥ śrāddhadānena prayātā brahmaṇaḥ puram / udumbarasya kṛtvā tu vidhivad darśanaṃ tataḥ
antarddhānam avāpnoti tapasā dagdhakilbiṣaḥ / tato gacchen mahārāja śaṅkaraṃ lokaśaṅkaram
kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyām abhigamya vṛṣadhvajam / labhate sarvakāmāṃś ca svargalokaṃ hi gacchati
narmadāyāmyabhāge tu gopyād gopyatara mahat / siddhaliṅgaṃ maṇimayaṃ na tatpaśyanti mānavāḥ
nāgendrasurasiddhaiś ca nāgakanyābhir arcyate / sapādakoṭistīrthānāṃ śaṅkare kurunandana
vasūnāmāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ munīnāṃ brahmacāriṇām / śivabhaktiparāṇāṃca kandamūlaphalāśinām
pitṝṇām akṣayā tṛptis tilatoyapradānataḥ / mudā paramayā yukto dātā yāti śivālayam
dhruvo dharaś ca somaś ca sāvitraś cānalo 'nilaḥ / pratyūṣaś ca prabhāsaś ca vasavo 'ṣṭau prakīrtitā
śaṅkarasya prasādena divi devatvam āgatāḥ / kalpagāsaumyabhāge tu somatīrtham anuttamam
tatra snātvā naro rājan svargaloke mahīyate / saptasārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ tato gacchen nṛpottama
brahmaṇā ca kṛtaṃ stotraṃ puṇyakīrte niśāmaya / brahmovācā: vākpatir vacasāṃ nityaṃ vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
haṃsaḥ sureśo vaktā vā vasūnāmantarā vasan / hotā diviṣadīśāno vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
svāhākāraḥ svadhākāro vaṣaṭkāro haviṣyabhuk / ṛṅmūrtiryajuṣāṃ mūrtirvāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
kṣetrajñaḥ paramaḥ sūkṣmo jagatāṃ tārako hariḥ / īśvaro hṛdayāvāso vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
śravaṇyaḥ śravaṇopāyaḥ puṇyaślokaḥ śuciśravāḥ / varado vāsudevo 'gnir vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
puruṣaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ purāṇo bhuvaneśvaraḥ / ādityāntargato vahṇir vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
kaṃsakāliyahantā ca subalo balamardanaḥ / śiśupālanihantā 'gnir vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
kālaneminihantā 'gniryaḥ kāle niyatāntakaḥ / śatāsuraśarīraghno vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
kaṅkāsuranihantā ca madhukaiṭabhanāśanaḥ / śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇir vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
śuklaḥ salilaśāyī ca viṣṇuḥ pāpakṣayāhvayaḥ / indro vacanasatpālo vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
hṛṣīkeśaś cendrapālopendro garuḍāsanaḥ / sahasranāmā dharmajño vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
śaṅkhī ca nandakī cakrī śārṅgadhanvā gadādharaḥ / dhīro vapuṣmān medhāvī vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
bṛhatsaṃkarṣaṇaḥ śambhuḥ svayambhūr bhūtabhāvanaḥ / nipuṇo lakṣaṇaḥ śuddho vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
traikālikastrikālajñastrayī kartā trilocanaḥ / trisāmā devakīsūnur vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
avyaktātmā mahātmā ca antarātmā janārdanaḥ / prāṇaścendriyabhūtātmā vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
paramātmā paraṃ brahma parameśaḥ parā gatiḥ / parameṣṭhī paraṃ jyotir vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
viśvātmā viśvakartā ca viśvasya patirātmavān / dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ kartā ca vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
sahasraśīrṣā bhagavān sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt / sahasrakoṭidhārī vā vāsudevo 'stu me gatiḥ
iti vāgīśvaro vāgmī pūjitaḥ parameśvaraḥ / bhaktasya bhagavān viṣṇuḥ prīyatāṃ me janārdanaḥ
janmaprabhṛti yat kiṃcin mayā sukṛtamarjitam / tatsamagraṃ phalaṃ cāstu śāśvataṃ puruṣottama
idam abhyasyato nityaṃ pūjitaḥ syāt sakeśavaḥ / vināśayati pāpāni prakāśayati tat phalam
eṣa niṣkaṇṭakaḥ panthā yatra sampūjyate hariḥ / kupathaṃ taṃ vijānīyād yatra nārādhyate hariḥ
vāsudevaparā vedā sudevaparākriyā / vāsudevātmakā viprā vāsudevaparāśrayaḥ
sarve devā vāsudevaṃ yajante sarve devā vāsudevāt prasūtāḥ / sarveṣāṃ vā vāsudevo 'pi devo nānyat kiṃcid avāsudevātiriktam
nānyaḥ puṇyataro devo nāsti viṣṇuparaṃ tapaḥ / nāsti viṣṇuparaṃ jñānaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jagat
ye paṭhanti narā bhaktyā viṣṇunāmāṅkitastavam / te yānti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ paraṃ brahma sanātanam
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śrutvā stotram idaṃ devo brahmaṇaḥ samahātmanaḥ / śriyā prabodhitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śayāno yoganidrayā
dṛṣṭvā 'bravīt surān sarvān nānārūpān bhayānakān / kimasti vaḥ samutpannaṃ māṃ didṛkṣur ihāgatāḥ
uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā keśavaṃ prati bhārata / tvāṃ vinātra jagannātha kas trātā devakaṇṭakaiḥ
dānavair veṣṭitā dhātrī svargaścaiva vināśitaḥ / dharmakāmādikā yajñā vedā viplāvitās tathā
danubhārabharākrāntā rasātatatalaṃ gatā / jaṭāsuraś ca jābālirdaityo mayasutas tathā
