daśakoṭyas tu daityānāṃ samagrabalaśālinām / śivaprasādayuktānāṃ svargaviplavakāriṇām
tasmāt pravartitaṃ cakramuddhara svavasundharām / śrutvā vākyam idaṃ devo bhayārtaṃ prāṇapīḍitam
uvāca vacanaṃ devo bhayaṃ tyajata daityajam / acireṇaiva kālena haniṣyāmi mahāsurān
vārāharūpamāsthāya preṣitaṃ kalpagājale / daṃṣṭrāgreṇa dhṛtā dhātrī dānavānāṃ kṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ
punaḥ pravartitā sṛṣṭir yathāpūrvaṃ tathaiva ca / brahmādyā muditā devāḥ pratijagmus triviṣṭapam
etat te kathitaṃ rājan vārāhaṃ kalpagātaṭe / śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe vārāhamahimānuvarṇano nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 69 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato devapathaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ śubham / tatra snātaś ca vidhivat sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet
māse māse kuśāgreṇa somayāgaṃ karoti yaḥ / sa revājalapūtasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm
liṅgaṃ devapathaṃ nāma surāsuranamaskṛtam / śraddhayā tad darśanena pitṝṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ
caitre māse caturdaśyā pakṣayor ubhayor api / snānārthaṃ sarvatīrthāni jagmuḥ kartuṃ ca satkriyām
yaddevaloke devānām īpsitaṃ ca nṛpadhvaja / sahasrāṇi munīndrāṇāṃ tasmiṃś śivamupāsate
cāndrāyaṇaparāḥ kecid brahmakūrcaparās tathā / kandamūlaphalāhārā jalāhārā jalapriyāḥ
agnihotraparā nityaṃ tathā hutahutāśanāḥ / upāsate devapathaṃ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ
athānyat saṃpravakṣyāmi tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / sahasrayajñaṃ paramaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam
ekādaśyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe pūjayitvā janārdanam / sahasrayajñasyeṣṭasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
na paśyed yamalokaṃ ca tiryagyoniṃ na gacchati / tīrthasyāsya prabhāveṇa naro vigatakalmaṣaḥ
etat te kathitaṃ rājan puṇyākhyānam anuttamam / śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya viṣṇuloke mahīyate
śuklatīrthaṃ tato gacchet sarvatīrthamayaṃ śubham / yatra snāto 'pi labhate daśadhenuphalaṃ naraḥ
śuklīkṛtās tena devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ / sapādakoṭistīrthānāṃ śuklatīrthe vyavasthitā
aṣṭahastapramāṇaṃ ca śuklatīrthaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / tatra kālāgnirudraś ca śrīkaṇṭhaś ca tathā paraḥ
tais tais tapobhirugraiś ca tatra siddhiṃ parā gatāḥ / śuklatīrthaprabhāveṇa modante divi devatāḥ
śakro 'pi ca purādhyakṣaṃ devadevam umāpatim / revātoyena saṃsnāpya bilvapatraiḥ samārcayat
paurṇamāsyām amāvasyāṃ somaḥ sūryaḥ prabhāvatīm / tatra snāto grahaiḥ sārddhaṃ nakṣatradhruvamaṇḍalaiḥ
tena devāś ca dīvyante śuklatīrthaprabhāvataḥ / kaśyapasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ surasiddhaniṣevitam
munīnām ayutaṃ tatra svayaṃ tiṣṭhati bhārata / kandamūlaphalāhārā jalāhārās tathā pare
śākāhārā nirāhārā brahmakūrcās tathā pare / cāndrāyaṇaparāḥ kecidanye māsopavāsinaḥ
ṛṣikoṭyas trayastriṃśac chukleśvaramupāsate / rāhugraste tathā candre paurṇamāsyāṃ tithau tathā
āyānti sarvatīrthāni snātum etac chivoditam / sthāneśvare yatphalaṃ syād rāhusūryasamāgame
tatphalaṃ prāpnuyāt sarvaṃ śuklatīrthe na saṃśayaḥ / hemadhenudharādīni rūpyadā gajadās tathā
etad dattvā mahārāja puṇyasaṃkhyā na vidyate / dhanadena kubereṇa devagandharvadānavaiḥ
rāhusūryasamāyoge śuklatīrthe maheśvaraḥ / candanāgurukarpūrapuṣpamālābhir arcitaḥ
vitānadhvajamukhyaiś ca dīpamālāprabodhanaiḥ / asya tīrthaprabhāveṇa yakṣarājo dhaneśvaraḥ
bhogā nānāvidhās tena samprāptā divi devatāḥ / sarvatīrtham ayaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvadevam ayaṃ ca yat
api varṣasahasreṇa śuklatīrthasya varṇanam / na śakyate suraiḥ kartuṃ purāṇe skandakīrtite
pāpayonigato yaś ca tiryagyonigataś ca yaḥ / brahmahā ca surāpaś ca śivanirmālyabhakṣakaḥ
mucyate tena pāpena tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ / tatra snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā pūjayitvā vṛṣadhvajam
surāsuragaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ pūjyate narasattama / etat te kathitaṃ rājan mahāpātakanāśanam
pitāmahena yatreṣṭo yajñe yajñeśvaraḥ purā / stotraṃ kṛtvā yathā nyāyaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ
pūjayitvā tu śukleśaṃ brahmā stotram udāharat / namaḥ śivāya śāntāya jñānavijñānarūpiṇe
sūkṣmāya sūkṣmarūpāya sarvasūkṣmāya hetave / sūkṣmāṇām api sūkṣmāya namaḥ sūkṣmatamāya ca
divyāya divyarūpāya divyadehāya setave / divyānām api divyāya namo divyatamāya ca
vyomaprabhāya bhāvāya aghorāya namo namaḥ / vyomapramāṇadhāmāya vāmeśāya namo namaḥ
parāya parameśāya pāramārthikahetave / parāya paramuktāya namaḥ paratarāya ca
ekajihvadvijahvāya bahujihvāya te namaḥ / tathaivāsaṃkhyajihvāya triṇetrāya namo namaḥ
pūjyāya pūjyapūjyāya sarvapūjyaikahetave / nityāyānityarūpāya nityanityaikahetave
nityānām api nityāya namo nityatamāya ca / śaktāya śaktirūpāya sarvaśaktyekahetave
śaktānām api śaktāya namaḥ śaktatamāya ca / śuddhāya sarvaśuddhāya sarvaśuddhyekahetave
kālāya kālarūpāya sarvakālaikahetave / kālānām api kālāya namaḥ kālatamāya te
sarvamantraśarīrāya sarvamantraikahetave / mantrāṇām api mantrāya namo mantratamāya ca
aprameyamaheśāya īśānāya namo namaḥ / yogāya yogarūpāya yogapuruṣa te namaḥ
ekakaṇṭhadvikaṇṭhāya bahukaṇṭhāya te namaḥ / asaṃkhyakaṇṭhayuktāya nīlakaṇṭhāya te namaḥ
anantāya maheśāya hartre kartre namo 'stu te / namaste 'stu mahādeva namaste 'stu sadāśiva
namaste 'stu mahāśuddha namas tubhyaṃ namo namaḥ / namo bhasmāṅgarāgāya namaḥ khaṭvāṅgadhāriṇe
sarvātmane namas tubhyaṃ viśveśāya namo namaḥ / sarvajñāya namas tubhyaṃ sanāthāya namo namaḥ
avyaktāya namas tubhyaṃ śāśvatāya namo namaḥ / kailāsavāsine tubhyaṃ namaḥ pātālavāsine
tvayā vyāptam idaṃ sarvaṃ lokālokaṃ carācaram / api varṣasahasreṇa kaḥ stotuṃ śaktimān bhavet
iti stavena divyena yaḥ stauti parameśvaram / vidhūya sarvapāpāni rudraloke mahīyate

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe śambhustutirnāmaikonasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 70 yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kimarthaṃ saṃstuto devo brahmaṇā tena tatra vai / śuklatīrtham idaṃ kasmādāste yatra maheśvaraḥ
etat sarvaṃ samākhyāhi pṛcchato me mahāmune / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājan kathāṃ divyāṃ svargārhaṇyām anuttamām
yāṃ śrutvā sarvapāpebhyas tīrthasnānena mucyate / yayātir nāma dharmātmā satyadharmaparāyaṇaḥ
cakravartī nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ / iyāja sa mahāyajñaiḥ śatakratur ivāparaḥ
nadī madhumatī puṇyā revayā yatra saṅgatā / yatra yajñaḥ samārabdha ṛtvigbhir brāhmaṇaiḥ saha
madhyeśvaraṃ yatra liṅgaṃ svayaṃdevo maheśvaraḥ / tatra snātā divaṃ yānti ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ
cakreṇa viṣṇunā tatra ghātitau madhukaiṭabhau / arcanāt tasya devasya gosahasraphalaṃ labhet
tilatoyapradānena piṇḍadānena bhārata / pitaras tasya tṛpyanti yāvad indrāścaturdaśa
tatra yajñaḥ samārabdho hariśaṅkaravarjitaḥ / jaṭāsuras tatra daityaś chidraṃ dṛṣṭvā samāgataḥ
tatovidhvaṃsito yajño dānavair baladarpitaiḥ / yajñayūpā yajñapātraṃ daśa dikṣu nipātitāḥ
bhukto hutapuroḍāśaḥ somapānaṃ ca taiḥ kṛtam / praṇaṣṭā devatāḥ sarvā dānavānāṃ bhayena ca
aṣṭottaraśataṃ devā mṛgarūpeṇa nirgatāḥ / dhanado yakṣarūpeṇa praṇaṣṭaḥ svapurīṃ gataḥ
mahiṣārūḍho dharmarājo gajārūḍhaś śatakratuḥ / meṣārūḍho havyavāho nirgatā vratamāsthitāḥ
varuṇaś ca samāyātaḥ praṇaṣṭaḥ svapurīṃ gataḥ / makarāsanamārūḍho vāyuś ca mṛgam āśritaḥ
īśāna īśarūpeṇa vṛṣārūḍhaḥ palāyitaḥ / astrāṇi lokapālānāṃ hṛtāni danusambhavaiḥ
ekākī yānam āruhya kathaṃ yāmi striyā saha / cintayitvā nṛpaśreṣṭhaś cāstraṃ jagrāha bhārata
tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti coktvā vai daityasiṃha durāsadam / na kṣatrakulasaṃjātā jātu dṛṣṭvā palāyitāḥ
daśa dvādaśavarṣāṇi vimukhās tava pūrvajāḥ / na cātrāhvānito rudro rudra bhāgo na kalpitaḥ
yajñe 'smin yajñapuruṣo nāhūto bhagavān hariḥ / tena doṣeṇa me yajño dānavaiś ca vināśitaḥ
evam uktvā nṛpaśreṣṭho rudraṃ dhyātvā maheśvaram / raudrarūpaṃ samāsthāya jyāghoṣaṃ ghoṣarūpiṇam
jagrāha kopān nistriṃśaṃ nijaghāna ca dānavān / āhūtāś ca punardevāḥ sarve brahmapurogamāḥ
ūcus te vacanaṃ devā rājānaṃ prati bhārata / tvayā samo 'tra rājarṣe na bhūto na bhaviṣyati
devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā yayātir vākyam abravīt / punaḥ pravartito yajño haraviṣṇuprasādataḥ
yuktaṃ palāyanaṃ cātra kṣatriyasya na vidyate / stutas tu tena kāryeṇa śūlapāṇiḥ pinākadhṛk
pātālād utthitaṃ tatra liṅgaṃ kālānalaprabham / śuklīkṛtaṃ jagat sarvaṃ prabhayā tasya bhārata
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te tam uvāca vṛṣadhvajaḥ / yayātir uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva varaṃ dātuṃ mamecchasi
idaṃ sthānaṃ na moktavyam umayā saha śaṅkara / yajñadānādikaṃ sarvam akṣayaṃ cātra sarvadā
tapohīnā narā ye ca dānahīnāḥ sakilbiṣāḥ / te sarve tvatpuraṃ yāntu śuklatīrthaprabhāvataḥ
tam uvāca mahādevaḥ satyam etat tavoditam / yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ taṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
asya tīrthasya mahātmyāl liṅgasyāsya samarcanāt / narakaṃ naiva paśyanti janmajanmani bhārata
etat te kathitaṃ rājan yathā skandaśivoditam / tatra ye nihatā daityāḥ prāptās te 'pi śivālayam
svaṃ svaṃ yānaṃ samārūḍhā yayur devās triviṣṭapam / mudā paramayā yuktaḥ stūyamāno nṛpottamaḥ
yayātir nāma rājarṣī rājyaṃ kṛtvā divaṃ gataḥ / śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya śivaloke mahīyate
rks adhyāya 71 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: dīptakeśvaradeveśaṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ prakīrtitam / nātaḥ parataraṃ kiṃcit triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
darśanād dīptadevasya sparśanād arcanāt tathā / anekabhāvikaṃ ghoraṃ kṣaṇamātreṇa naśyati
arcayed dinam ekaṃ tu yo muhūrtaṃ tu mānavaḥ / na tasya punarāvṛttir ghore saṃsārasāgare
mokṣadā nāma cāmuṇḍā viddhi gaurīṃ sarasvatīm / stutaḥ sahasranāmnā vai viṣṇunā brahmaṇā svayam
stutāni tāni liṅgāni revāyā uttare taṭe / oṃkāraścādhidevaś ca bilvāmrakamaheśvaraḥ
śukleśvaro bhṛguś ceti dvīpeśvaratrilocanau / vaivasvate 'ntare prāpte ādikalpekṛteyuge
śrīpatiḥ paramādyaś ca dvitīyaś ca pitāmahaḥ / tṛtīyo devarājaś ca caturthaḥ sūrya eva ca
pañcamaḥ kathitaḥ somaḥ ṣaṣṭho rāhuḥ prakīrtitaḥ / saptamaś ca śaniś caiva tvaṣṭamaḥ ketukaḥ smṛtaḥ
vaiśvānaraś ca navamo daśamaś ca digīśvaraḥ / ekādaśo vaikramaś ca dvādaśo vāruṇas tathā
trayodaśaś ca vāyur vai dhanadaś ca caturdaśaḥ / nānā padaprakāreṇa stuto deva umāpatiḥ
viṣṇunā devanāthena brahmaṇā ca surāsuraiḥ / sthiraḥ sthāṇuḥ prabhābhānuḥ pravaro varado varaḥ
hariśca hariṇākhyaś ca sarvabhūtaharaḥ prabhuḥ / pravṛttiś ca nivṛttiś ca niyamaḥ śāśvato dhruvaḥ
śmaśānavāsī bhagavān khecaro gocaras tathā / abhivandyo mahākarmā tapasvī bhūtabhāvanaḥ
unmattaveṣapracchannaḥ sarvalokaprajāpatiḥ / mahārūpo mahākāyaḥ sarvalokaprajāpatiḥ
parātmā sarvabhūtānāṃ virūpo vāmano manuḥ / lokapālo pihitātmā prasanno bhavanāśanaḥ
pravṛttaś ca mahāṅgaś ca nicayo niyatāśrayaḥ / sarvakāmaḥ svayambhūś ca ādinādikaro nidhiḥ
sahasrākṣo virūpākṣaḥ somo nakṣatrasādhakaḥ / candraḥ sūryaḥ śaniḥ keturgraho grahapatirvaraḥ
tapodraṣṭā balaḥ sthātur mṛgabāṇārpaṇo 'naghaḥ / mahātapā dīrghatapā ādirdīnānukampanaḥ
savatsarakaro mantraḥ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ / yogī yogamahāvīryo mahāretā haro haraḥ
mahācetāś ca sarvajñaḥ sabījo 'paharo haraḥ / kamaṇḍaludharo dhanvī prāṇahastaḥ pratāpavān
aṃśo 'nīśas tathā śūlī khaṭvāṅgī paṭṭiśī tathā / śuciś ca śucirūpaśca tejastejaskaro nidhiḥ
uṣṇīṣī ca suvaktrāśca udakyo vitanas tathā / hariś ca harinetraś ca sutīrthaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca
śṛgālarūpī sarvārthaḥ śuṇḍīśuddhaḥ kamaṇḍaluḥ / ajaś ca gandhamālī ca mṛgarūpī kapālabhṛt
ūrdhvaretā ūrdhvasākṣī ūrdhvabāhurnabhaḥ sthalaḥ / trijaṭī ca nivāsaś ca rudraḥ senāpatirvibhuḥ
ahaś caro rātricaraḥ suvāsaśca diśāmpatiḥ / rājahā daityahā caiva dhātārūpaguṇātmakaḥ
siṃhaśārdūlarūpaś ca ārdracarmadharo haraḥ / kālayogī mahānādaḥ sarvavāsaścatuṣpathaḥ
durvārapretacārī ca bhūtacārī maheśvaraḥ / bahubhūto bahudhanaḥ sarvārtho rucirā gatiḥ
nṛtyapriyo nṛtyakartā nartakaś ca balāhakaḥ / ghoro mahātapā vāso nityo giridharo nabhaḥ
sahasrabhūto vijñeyo vyavasāyaś ca niścayaḥ / amarṣo marṣaṇo dakṣo dakṣakratuvināśanaḥ
dakṣayajñāpahārī ca sumaho madhyamas tathā / tejo 'pahārī balihā muditaś cārcito bhavaḥ
gambhīraghoṣo gambhīro gabhīro havyavāhanaḥ / nyagrodharūpo nyagrodhaṛkṣavarṇaḥ prabhur vibhuḥ
tīkṣṇabāṇaś ca haryakṣo maheśaḥ karmakālavit / dīkṣaḥ prasādito yajñaḥ samudro vaḍavānalaḥ
hutāśaś ca hṛtāśāsyaḥ prasannātmā hṛtāśanaḥ / mahātejāḥ sutejāś ca vijayo jaya eva ca
jyotiṣāmayanaṃ siddhiḥ sandhirvigraha eva ca / śikhī daṇḍī jaṭī jvālī mūrtodo durbalo bahiḥ
vaiṇavī pāpavetālaḥ kālāgniḥ kāladaṇḍakaḥ / nakṣatravigraho vṛddhirajo gandhavaho 'grajaḥ
prajāpatir harir bāhurvibhāgaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ / vimocanaḥ suragaṇo hiraṇyakavaco bhavaḥ
arajo dhūlidhārī ca mahācārī śrutaśravāḥ / anādiḥ sarvabhūtādiḥ sarvasyādyaḥ pitā guruḥ
vyālarūpo mahāvāsī hīnamālī taraṅgavit / tripadas tryambako 'vyaktaḥ sarvabandhavimocakaḥ
sāṃkhyaprasādo durvāsāḥ sarvasādhuniṣevitaḥ / praskandano vibhāgaś ca tulyo yajñavibhāgavit
sarvavāsī sarvacārī durvāsā bhairavo yamaḥ / himo himakaro yajñaḥ sarvadhātā budhottamaḥ
lohitākṣo mahākṣaś ca vijayākhyo viśāradaḥ / saṃgraho vigrahaḥ karma sarpa rājavibhūṣaṇaḥ
mukhyo vimuktadehaś ca dehacārī ca kardamaḥ / sarvācāraḥ prasādaś ca khecaro balarūpadhṛk
ākāśavṛttirūpaś ca nipāta uragaḥ khalaḥ / raudrarūpaḥ surādityo vasuraśmiḥ suvarcasaḥ
vasuvego mahāvego manovego niśācaraḥ / sarvāvāsaḥ śriyāvāsa āpadīśakalo haraḥ
munir ātmagatir lokaḥ sahasravadano vibhuḥ / yakṣī ca yakṣarājaś ca śyeno dīptir viśāmpatiḥ
unmado madanākāro 'py arthānarthakaro mahān / siddhayogo 'pahārī ca siddhaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ
bhikṣuś ca bhikṣurūpaś ca vibhuḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ mṛdutvacaḥ / mahāseno viśākhaś ca yaṣṭibhāgo gavāmpatiḥ
vajrahastaś ca viṣṭambhir viṣṭhaḥ stambhana eva ca / ṛkṣo ripukaraḥ kālo madhurmadhukalocanaḥ
vācaspatyo vājaseno naiṣṭhaścāśramasūcakaḥ / brahmacārī lokacārī sarvacārī suratnavit
īśāna īśvaraḥ kālo niśācārī tvam ekadhṛk / amitaścāprameyaś ca nadīnadakaro 'vyayaḥ
nandīśvaraḥ sunandī ca nandano nandavarddhanaḥ / nāgahāro vihārī ca kālo brahmavidāṃ varaḥ
caturmukho mahāliṅgaścaturliṅgas tathaiva ca / liṅgādhyakṣaḥ suradhyakṣo kālādhyakṣo yugāvahaḥ
umāpatirumākānto jāhnavī dhṛtimān varaḥ / sarvārthaḥ sarvabhūtārtho nityaḥ sarvavrataḥ śuciḥ
yo na brahmādibhir devo jāyate na maharṣibhiḥ / stotavyaḥ sa kathaṃ nātha paramātmā parātparaḥ
jihvācāpalyam asmākaṃ kṣamasva parameśvara / śivaṃ kuruṣva devānāṃ svargyāṇāṃ puṣṭivardhanam
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śrutvā stotramidaṃ devaḥ śrīmān dvīpeśvaraḥ śivaḥ / prasannabravīd devān prārthayadhvaṃ varaṃ surāḥ
devā ūcuḥ: yadi tuṣṭo maheśāno devānāṃ varadaḥ prabhuḥ / tad vināśāya daityānāṃ trātā bhava maheśvara
pāpakarmādhamaś caiva pañcaliṅgāni yo 'rcayet / so 'pi tāṃ gatim āpnoti durlabhā yā mahāmakhaiḥ
śakreṇābhivṛtas tatra devadeva umāpatiḥ / purā nāmnāṃ sahasreṇa surāsuranamaskṛtaḥ
śivaprasādasampanno devarājas tato 'bhavat / dhanadena stutas tatra devo lakṣeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
mokṣadā nāma gaurīṃ ca tāṃ devīṃ viddhi bhārata / mokṣeśvaraṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam
siddhair vidyādharair yakṣair gandharvaiḥ kinnarair naraiḥ / devatvaṃ samanuprāptaṃ pañcaliṅgasamarcanāt
kubero mārutaś caiva varuṇo nirṛtis tathā / vaivasvato yamaś caiva tataś ca narakeśvaraḥ
tasya liṅgasya māhātmyāt sūryaputro mahāyaśāḥ / anyair abhiṣṭutas tatra pūrvaṃ dvīpeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
bhaktyā nāmasahasreṇa stutaḥ pūjyatamaḥ śivaḥ / somenāto 'bhavat tatra śambhoḥ śirasi bhūṣaṇam
rohiṇyā 'bhyarcitā gaurī subhagā tena sābhavat / ṛkṣair yogatarais tadvat stuto devaḥ pinākadhṛk
tatas tair bhāskareṇaiva tabhaḥ sthalamalaṃ kṛtam / vyādhayaḥ kālamṛtyuś ca citraguptaś ca lekhakaḥ
tathā śakraḥ suragaṇair etaiḥ parivṛtaḥ prabhuḥ / pāpiṣṭhānāṃ mahāraudro dharmiṣṭhānāṃ prasādavān
koṭyo 'ṣṭau cordhvakeśā raudrāś ca vikṛtānanāḥ / pativratāsahasraiś ca tathā māsopavāsibhiḥ
kilkilāravaśabdaiś ca dharmarājapurottamam / vyāptaṃ tu paritaḥ śrīmadasaṃkhyātair manoramaiḥ
śrutvā teṣāṃ ravaṃ sārddhaṃ dharmarājaḥ sabhāsadaiḥ / śvetavastraparīdhānaḥ śvetamālyānulepanaḥ
pādacārī gataḥ kṣipraṃ yatra te yānasaṃsthitāḥ / kṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā papraccha śubhakarmaṇaḥ
yathā śaktena yogena dharmaṃ dharmottaraṃ mahat / kasmād deśāt samāyātāḥ kathaṃ puṇyamupārjitam
vimānārūḍhā ūcuḥ: kurukṣetre tapas taptaṃ gaṅgāyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / sarveṣām eva lokānāṃ dvāraṃ taddhi pratiṣṭhitam
dharmādharmaṃ tava balaṃ kāraṇaṃ ceti tattvataḥ / vārāṇasī prayāgaś ca gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgamaḥ
pitṛtīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā / kedāraṃ bhairavaṃ caiva tathā rudramahālayam
sarasvatīrudrakoṭiḥ prabhāsaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam / nānātīrthasahasreṣu dānayajñatapaḥ kṛtam
etat te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ sūryaputramahāyaśaḥ / anye dṛṣṭvā yathā nyāyaṃ dharmarājaṃ tatas tathā
ūcuḥ sarve vacaḥ ślakṣṇaṃ dharmarājaṃ yathoditam / na tvaṃ prabhuḥ sukṛtināṃ brahmā viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ prabhuḥ
pāpakarmaratā ye tu teṣāṃ śāstā yamaḥ svayam / yama uvāca: gatvā kailāsamāyāmi yāvat tāvat pratīkṣatām
evam uktvā yayau rājan kailāsaṃ sa nagottamam / yasmin śivādyās te sarve pārvatī ṣaṇmukhas tathā
stuvanti devatāḥ sarvādevadevam umāpatim / nṛtyanti cāgrataḥ kecid utpatya nipatanti ca
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśaṃ śambhuṃ stuvantaṃ dīptatejasam / stuvannāmasahasreṇa devadevaṃ pinākinam
sāṣṭāṅgaṃ ca namaskṛtya dharmarājo 'bravīd idam / ye 'smatpurīṃ samāyātās teṣāṃ kā gatir ucyate
prahasann abravīd devo dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / atra prayāntu te sarve ye revātīravāsinaḥ
anyatīrthanivāsā ye bhogān bhuñjantu te divi / śivavākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā brahmāviṣṇur yathātatham
tuṣṭā devasya vākyena sarvadevagaṇeśvaruḥ / āgataḥ kṣaṇamātreṇa dharmarājaḥ purottamam
śivoktāḥ preṣitāḥ sarve śivalokaṃ yudhiṣṭhira / yathā yathā samādiṣṭās tato 'nye 'pi śūbhānvitāḥ
purākalpe mayā dṛṣṭaṃ kārttikyāṃ devatāgame / tato gacchen mahārāja vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthamuttamam
kokilā nāma vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpavimokṣaṇam / vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetramity āha devadevo janārdanaḥ
sapādakoṭistīrthānāṃ tatrāste caiva bhārata / upoṣyaikādaśīṃ puṇyāṃ dīpamālāṃ prabodhayet
na tasya punarāvṛttir martyaloke durāsade / sarvakāmasamṛddhena vimānāgreṇa bhārata
asaṃkhyakālikā tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ / vipre ca toṣite tatra dānasaṅkhyā na vidyate
atrāntare tyajet prāṇānavaśaḥ svavaśo 'pi vā / daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rājā vaidyādhare pure
dhruvo dhruvatvaṃ svarge tu tārātejaḥ samujjvalan / martyayoniṣu sambhūtā bhūtagrāmā tathāpare
arcanrāḍ devadevasya divi devatvam āpnuvan / devapuṇyakṣaye martyā bhaktyā puṇyaiś ca devatāḥ
svargamartyaprabhedo 'yaṃ dharmādharmaprabhedataḥ / kenāpi tatprakāreṇa pūjanīyo maheśvaraḥ
yad vā tad vā śive deyaṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā / arundhatyā sā bharaṇyā sāvitryā ca tathā tathā
ahalyayā menakayā marutvatyā ca rambhayā / apsarogaṇasaṅghaiś ca surasiddhagaṇais tathā
narmadātaṭam āśritya pūjito yena śaṅkaraḥ / tena vai vipulā bhogāḥ prāptā mokṣaś ca bhārata
na pūjayed dharaṃ yas tu śivamāyāvimohitaḥ / na tasya svargamokṣau ca kailāsaṃ prati kā kathā
na ca svargasya rājyasya bhājanaṃ ca narādhipa / sarvatīrthamayī revā sarvadevamayo haraḥ
sarvadharmamayī buddhiḥ kṣamāsatyam ayaṃ tapaḥ / brahmacaryaṃ tapomūlaṃ pañcendriyavinigrahaḥ
kṣamā satyaṃ japo 'dhītaṃ tapaḥ saṃyamalakṣaṇam / etat te kathitaṃ rājaṃ śivena kathitaṃ purā
mayā ca tava rājendra bhrātṝṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ / na sāmānyatarā devī kathitā yā mayā tava
dvīpeśvaraḥ kapileśvaras tathā vai narakeśvaraḥ / etān devān samutthāya yathāvat parikīrtayet
sarvatīrthaphalaṃ prāpya śivaloke mahīyate / aghaughe ca parikṣīṇe prāpyate saptakalpagā
śivaḥ saṃnihito yasyāṃ śivakṣetraṃ tataḥ param / śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya śivaloke mahīyate

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe dvīpeśvaravarṇano nāmaikasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 72 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: narmadāsaṅgamaṃ puṇyaṃ surasiddhaniṣevitam / tatra snātvā divaṃ yānti pūjayitvā maheśvaram
āgacchantī purā loke narmadā bharatarṣabha / stutā pūrvaṃ namaskṛtya devair brahmarṣibhis tathā
tvayā pavitritaṃ puṇyaṃ martyalokaṃ carācaram / apāṃ rūpagatā revā harasya paramā kalā
umā kātyāyanī gaṅgā yamunā ca sarasvatī / cāmuṇḍā carcikā devī revā tvaṃ saptakalpagā
śivajā pravahā puṇyā mekalādrisutā stutā / yajñayūpā ca mūrdhā ca svargamokṣapradā tathā
tāriṇī sarvabhūtānāṃ pāpaghnī ca taraṅgiṇī / lakṣmīḥ svāhā svadhā caiva puruhūtā yaśasvinī
tvayā vyāptaṃ jagatkṛtsnam apāṃ rūpeṇa suvrate / saṅgamaṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ ca surāsuranamaskṛtam
atra dattaṃ hutaṃ sarvam etad bhavati cākṣayam / atyadbhutaṃ mahārāja narmadāsnānam arcanam
anekāni sahasrāṇi vimānāni yudhiṣṭhira / nānāratnaprabhājālaiḥ sūryakoṭisamāni ca
gatāni dharmarājasya purīṃ vīṇādiniḥ svanaiḥ / nādayanti divaṃ bhūmiṃ vedanirghoṣaṇādibhiḥ
ekasmin samaye dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ vaivasvato nṛpaḥ / atriś caiva vaśiṣṭhaś ca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ
ityādyāḥ sapta munayo dharmādharmavicārakāḥ / śivena sthāpitāḥ pūrvaṃ hariṇā brahmaṇā tathā
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: akṣīṇakarmabandhus tu puruṣo munisattama / paraṃ padam avāpnoti tan me kathaya kalpaga
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: viṣṇunā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmaṇe ca mahātmane / prapadye puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim
lokanāthaṃ sahasrākṣam akṣaraṃ paramaṃ padam / bhagavantaṃ prapadye 'haṃ bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhum
sraṣṭāraṃ sarvabhūtānām anantabalapauruṣam / padmanābhaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ prapadye satyam avyayam
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ bhūgarbham amṛtaṃ viśvatomukham / anaśvaramanāthaṃ ca prapadye bhāskaradyutim
sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ tārkṣyavāhanam / prapadye sūkṣmam acalaṃ vareṇyam abhayapradam
nārāyaṇaṃ hariṃ caiva yogātmānaṃ sanātanam / śaraṇyaṃ sarvalokānāṃ prapadye dhruvamīśvaram
yaḥ prabhuḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yena sarvam idaṃ tatam / yaḥ saṃhārakaro devaḥ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
yasmāj jātaḥ purā brahmā padmayoniḥ prajāpatiḥ / prasīdatu sa me viṣṇuḥ pitāmahaparaḥ prabhuḥ
purā laye tu saṃprāpte naṣṭe loke carācare / ekas tiṣṭhati yogātmā sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
jayed yaḥ pṛthivīṃ satyaṃ kālo dharmaḥ kriyāphalam / gaṇākāraḥ sa tāṃ vāco vāsudevaḥ prasīdatu
yogāvāsa namastubhyaṃ sarvāvāsa varaprada / yajñabhogin pañcabhogin nārāyaṇa namo 'stu te
caturmūrte jagaddhāma lakṣmīvāsa varaprada / viśvāvāsa namaste 'stu sākṣībhūta jagatpate
ajeyaḥ ṣaḍvibhāgaikaviśvamūrtir vṛṣākapiḥ / mṛgādhipaś ca kālaś ca namas te jñānasāgara
avyaktādaṇḍam utpannam avyaktād aparaḥ prabhuḥ / yasmāt parataraṃ nāsti tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
cintayanto hi yaṃ nityaṃ brahmeśānādayaḥ prabhum / ekāṃśena jagatsarvaṃ yo viṣṭabhya vibhuḥ sthitaḥ
agrāhyo nirguṇaḥ śāstā tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ / divākarasya somasya madhye jyotir iva sthitam
kṣetrajña iti yaṃ prāhuḥ sa mahātmā prasīdatu / sāṃkhyayogena ye cānye siddhāś caiva maharṣayaḥ
yaṃ viditvā vimucyante sa mahātmā prasīdatu / namaste sarvatobhadra sarvato 'kṣiśiromukha
nirvikāra namaste 'stu ādikalpa hṛdi sthita / atīndriya namastubhyaṃ paramātman namo 'stu te
ye ca tvām abhijānanti saṃsāre na vasanti te / rāgadveṣavinirmuktā lobhamohavivārjitāḥ
aśarīraḥ suguptaḥ san sarvadeheṣu tan mayaḥ / avyaktabuddhy ahaṃkāramahābhūtendriyāṇi ca
tvayi tāni na teṣu tvaṃ te ca tāni na tu svayam / avyakto nātikūṭastho guṇānāṃ prabhurīśvaraḥ
āvarto hetur ahitaḥ prabhuḥ svātmavyavasthitaḥ / namaste puṇḍarīkākṣa vāsudeva namo 'stu te
īśvaro 'si jagannātha kim ataḥ paramucyate / bhaktānāṃ muktidas tvaṃ ca guruś ca tridaśeśvaraḥ
same bhūtapatis tvaṃ hi prabhur janmani janmani / ahaṃkāreṇa baddho vā tathā sattvādibhir gaṇaiḥ
pṛthivīṃ yātu me ghrāṇaṃ yātu me rasanājalam / cakṣurhutāśanaṃ yātu sparśo me yātu mārutam
śabdaś cākāśam āyātu mano vai kāraṇaṃ tathā / ahaṃkāraś ca me buddhiṃ tvayi buddhir mamāstv iti
viyogaḥ sarvakaraṇair guṇair bhūtais tathā 'stu me / sattvaṃ rajastamaś caiva prakṛtiṃ svāṃ viśantu me
prabhoḥ prabhumanavadyaṃ prapadye 'haṃ naraḥ prabhum / sahasraśirasaṃ devaṃ maharṣiṃ bhūtabhāvanam
brahmayoniś ca viśvasya sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu / brahmapatnyāṃ pralīyante naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame
āhūtasaṃplave caiva līyate prakṛtau mahat / hūyate ca punas tābhyāṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
agnisomārkadevānāṃ brahmarudrendrayoginām / yaste jayati tejāṃsi sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
ajastvaṃ jagataḥ panthā amūrtirvīśvamūrtijit / navaṃ pradhānaṃ ca mahān puruṣaś cetano 'lasaḥ
agopyo yaḥ parataras tam eva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ / somasūryopamas tejo yo 'vatārayati svayam
vijāyante diśo yasmāt sa mahātmā prasīdatu / guṇavān nirguṇaś caiva cetano 'cetano svagaḥ
sūkṣmaḥ sarvagato dehaḥ sa mahātmā prasīdatu / sūryamadhye sthitaḥ somas tasya madhye tu saṃsmṛtaḥ
bhūtatvād yo 'calo dīptaḥ sa mahātmā prasīdatu / ekatvāt tava nānātvaṃ ye viduryānti te param
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu pradveṣyātmajanapriyaḥ / samaṃ bhajaty anākāṅkṣī bhajate nānyacetasaḥ
yo 'yaṃ sarvātmanā jñeyaḥ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu / carācaram idaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham
tvayi taṃ tantuvat protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva / na te dharmo hy adharmo 'sti na garbho janma vā punaḥ
jarājanmavimokṣārthaṃ tam eva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ / indriyāṇi guṇaś caiva śvāsocchvāsaś ca yoniṣu
kevalaṃ dāruvad dehaṃ naśyaṃ yat paramāpadam / svayam ekākibhāvo me janmato 'tra punarbhavaḥ
tvad buddhis tvad gataprāṇā tvad bhaktas tvat parāyaṇaḥ / tvām evāhaṃ smariṣyāmi maraṇe paryupasthite
pūrvadehe kṛtā ye tu vyādhayaḥ praviśantu mām / vātādayaś ca duḥkhāni ṛṇaṃ tan muñcatāt prabho
śreyasāṃ ca paraṃ śreyas tv anyeṣāṃ ca yaśasvinām / sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ puṇyaṃ yatparamaṃ padam
prātar utthāya satataṃ madhyāhne ca dinakṣaye / ajasraṃ ca tathā japyaṃ sarvapāpopaśāntidam
hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ vāsudevaṃ janārdanam / praṇato 'smi jagannāthaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
govardhanadharaṃ devaṃ gobrāhmaṇahite ratam / praṇato 'smi gadāpāṇiṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
śaṅkhinaṃ cakriṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ śārṅgiṇaṃ madhusūdanam / praṇato 'smi patiṃ lakṣmyāḥ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
dāmodaraṃ mudā yuktaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣam avyayam / praṇato 'smi sthitaṃ sthityai sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu
nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ saumyaṃ mādhavaṃ ca janārdanam / śrīvatsaṃ śrīvapuḥ śrīmac chrīdharaṃ śrīniketanam
praṇato 'smi śriyaḥ kāntaṃ sa me pāpaṃ vyapohatu / yam īśaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dhyāyanti ca tamakṣaram
vāsudevamanirdeśyaṃ tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ / sarvabandhavinirmukto yaṃ praviśya punarbhavam
puruṣo naiva prāpnoti tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ / kṛtvā brahmavapuḥ sarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam
yaḥ karoti punaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ tam asmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ / brahmarūpadharaṃ devaṃ yonirūpaṃ janārdanam
sṛṣṭitve saṃsthitaṃ nityaṃ praṇato 'smi janārdanam / yasmān nānyat paraṃ kiṃcid yasmin sarvam idaṃ jagat
yaḥ sarvamadhyago 'nantaḥ sarvagaṃ taṃ namāmy aham / yo 'sti bhūteṣu sarveṣu sthāvare jaṅgameṣu ca
viṣṇur eva sa vai pāpaṃ mamāśeṣaṃ praṇaśyatu / na vṛttaṃ nirvṛtaṃ karma viṣṇor yatkarma vā kṛtam
anekajanmakarmotthaṃ pāpaṃ naśyati me tathā / niśāyāṃ ca tathā prātar madhyāhṇe cāparāhṇayoḥ
ajñānāc ca kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā manasā girā / yatkṛtaṃ cāśubhaṃ kiṃcit tatsarvaṃ naśyatu kṣaṇāt
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yātu toyeṣu lavaṇaṃ yathā / parapīḍāṃ ca nindāṃ ca kurvato janma nārjitam
paradravyaparakṣetravāñchā krodhodbhavaṃ ca yat / tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yātu toyeṣu lavaṇaṃ yathā
viṣṇave vāsudevāya haraye keśavāya ca / janārdanāya kṛṣṇāya namo bhūyo namo namaḥ
nābhāgo nāma rājarṣir narmadātīrasaṅgame / cakāra stotram atulaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tu prajāpatiḥ
brahmaṇo 'ṅgirasā prāptaṃ tasmād indreṇa bhārata / vaśiṣṭhaḥ śrāvayāmāsa nābhāgaṃ rājasattamam
snātvā ca narmadātoye dattvā dānāny anekaśaḥ / kāmikaṃ yānamāruhya nābhāgaḥ svapurīṃ yayau
stauti nāmasahasreṇa yaḥ stavena janārdanam / na tasya punarāvṛttirghore saṃsārasāgare

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe viṣṇustutirnāma dvisaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 73 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchec ca rājendra meghanādam iti smṛtam / jalamadhye mahādevo yatra tiṣṭhaty adarśitaḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: jalamadhye mahādevas tiṣṭhate kena hetunā / uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ kūlaṃ varjayitvā dvijottama
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: etad ākhyānam atulaṃ puṇyaṃ śrutisukhāvaham / purāṇe yacchrutaṃ tāta tat te vakṣyāmy aśeṣataḥ
purā tretāyuge tāta paulastyo devakaṇṭakaḥ / trilokavijayī raudraḥ surāsurabhayaṃkaraḥ
devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām / avadhyo varadānena yatra paryaṭate mahīm
tatra devagirau ramye dānavo baladarpitaḥ / mayo nāmeti vikhyāto mahānāsīn nṛpeśvara
rāvaṇas taṃ tato gatvā vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ / pūjito dānasaṃmānair mayaṃ vacanam abravīt
kasyeyaṃ padmapatrākṣī pūrṇacandranibhānanā / kiṃ nāmadheyā tapate tapa ugraṃ kathaṃ vibho
maya uvāca: dānavānāṃ patiḥ śreṣṭho mayo 'haṃ nāmanāmataḥ / bhāryā tejavatī nāma mameyaṃ tanayā śubhā
mandodarīti vikhyātā tapate patikāraṇāt / śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya rāvaṇo madadarpitaḥ
praśritaḥ praṇato bhūtvā mayaṃ vacanam abravīt / paulastyo nāma rājāhaṃ devadānavadarpahā
prārthayāmi mahābhāga sutāṃ tvaṃ dātum arhasi / jñātvā paitāmahaṃ vaṃśaṃ mayenāpi mahātmanā
sutā dattā rāvaṇāya kṛtvā vidhividhānataḥ / gṛhītvā tāṃ tadā rakṣaḥ pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ
divyair yānair vimānaiś ca krīḍate tu tayā saha / putraṃ putravatāṃ śreṣṭho janayāmāsa bhārata
tenaiva jātamātreṇa ravo mukto mahātmanā / saṃvartakasya meghasya yena loko jaḍīkṛtaḥ
śrutvā tanninadaṃ ghoraṃ trasto lokapitāmahaḥ / nāma cakre tadā tasya meghanādo bhaviṣyati
etan nāmakṛtaṃ so 'pi paramaṃ vratam āsthitaḥ / bhāvayāmāsa deveśam umayā saha śaṅkaram
vratair niyamadānaiś ca homair jāpyairvidhānataḥ / kṛcchracāndrāyaṇair divyaiḥ kliśyate ca kalevaram
evam anyad dine tāta kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam / gatvā liṅgam ayaṃ prāpya prasthito dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ
narmadātaṭam āśritya snātukāmo mahābalaḥ / nikṣipyāpūjayad devaṃ kṛtvā jāpyaṃ janeśvaraḥ
gantukāmaḥ paraṃ mārgaṃ laṅkāyāṃ nṛpasattama / ekaṃ samuddhṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ gṛhitaṃ savyapāṇinā
prathamaṃ ca dvitīyaṃ ca bhaktyā paulastyanandanaḥ / tadā devamahāliṅgaṃ patitaṃ narmadāmbhasi
pāhi pāhīti tenokto liṅgena parameṣṭhinā / dvitīyaṃ patitaṃ tāvad uttare narmadātaṭe
meghanādeti vikhyātaṃ liṅgaṃ tatra suśobhanam / madhyameśvaranāmeti jalamadhye vyavasthitam
yāvad uddhartukāmo 'sau saptapātālam āgamat / devayor niścayaṃ jñātvā nivṛtto 'sau niśācaraḥ
jagāmākāśam āviśya pūjyamāno niśācaraiḥ / tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ meghanādeti viśrutam
meghāraveti vikhyātam uttare kheṭakaḥ śubhaḥ / pūrve tu garjanaṃ nāma sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
tasmiṃs tīrthe tu rājendra yas tu snānaṃ samācaret / ahorātroṣito bhūtvā sa labhecchāśvataṃ śubham
piṇḍadānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃs tīrthe narādhipa / tena dvādaśa varṣāṇi pitaras tarpitā divi
yas tu bhojayate viprāṃs tasmiṃs tīrthe narādhipa / yatphalaṃ yogināṃ tatra labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ
agniveśaṃ jale vāpi athavāpi hy anāśakam / anivartikā gatis tasya syād idaṃ śaṅkaro 'bravīt
evaṃ te naraśārdūla garjiteśvaram uttamam / kathitaṃ smaraṇād eva sarvapāpakṣayaṃ karam

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe meghanādeśvaramahimānuvarṇano nāma trisaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 74 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchec ca rājendra dārutīrtham anuttamam / dāruko yatra saṃsiddhim indrasya dayitaḥ sakhā
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: dārukeṇa kathaṃ tāta tapaścīrṇaṃ purā 'nagha / vidhānaṃ śrotum icchāmi sarvapāpakṣayaṃ karam
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi vicitraṃ yat purātanam / vṛttaṃ samabhavat tatra ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām
sūto vajradharasyāsīt mātalirnāmanāmataḥ / sa putraṃ śaptavān pūrvaṃ kathaṃcit kāraṇāntare
śāpahetor vepamāna indrasya caraṇau śubhau / prapīḍya tatra devendraṃ vijñāpayati bhārata
mama tātābhiśaptasya anāthasya sureśvara / karmaṇā kena śāpasya ghorasyānto bhaviṣyati
śakra uvāca: narmadātaṭam āśritya toṣaya tvaṃ maheśvaram / tiṣṭha yāvad yugasyāntaṃ punarjananam āpsyasi
punarbhūtvā yadukule dāruko nāma nāmataḥ / ārohayitvā deveśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam
mānuṣaṃ tatra sampannaṃ tataḥ siddhim avāpsyasi / evam uktas tu devena sahasrākṣeṇa bhārata
praṇamya śirasā bhūmim āgato 'sau hataprabhaḥ / narmadā taṭam āśritya karśitasvakalevaraḥ
vratopavārsair vividhair japahomaparāyaṇaḥ / mahādevaṃ mahātmānaṃ varadaṃ śūlapāṇinam
abhajat parayā bhaktyā yāvad āhūtasamplavam / aṃśāvataraṇe viṣṇos tato bhūtvā mahāmatiḥ
toṣayitvā jagannāthaṃ tato yātaḥ sa sadgatim / eṣa te sambhavas tāta dārutīrthasya suvrata
kathitas tu mayā pūrvaṃ yathā me śaṅkaro 'bravīt / tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā vismayāviṣṭacetanaḥ
bhrānto 'valokayāmāsa stabdharomā muhur muhuḥ / tasmiṃs tīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhipūrvaṃ nareśvara
upāsya sabhyāṃ tatraiva saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ / dehatyāgaṃ ca tatraiva yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ
so 'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya ramate śivasannidhau / tasmiṃs tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā bhojayed brāhmaṇaṃ śuciḥ
sa tu viprasahasrasya labhate phalam uttamam / snānaṃ dānaṃ tapo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam
yatkṛtaṃ tu śubhaṃ tatra tatsarvaṃ labhate 'kṣayam

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe dārutīrthatamahimānuvarṇano nāma catuḥsaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 75 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchec ca rājendra devatīrtham anuttamam / yatra devās trayastriṃśat taptvā siddhiṃ parāṃ gatāḥ
purā devāsure yuddhe dānavair baladarpitaiḥ / indro devagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ svarājyāc cyāvito bhṛśam
hastyaśvarathayānaughair mardayitvā ca vāhinīm / viśaktā bhejire mārgaṃ prahārair jarjarīkṛtāḥ
jambhaśumbhaniśumbhādyais tu huṇḍagrahakaiḥ saha / balibhir bādhitāḥ sarve brahmāṇam upatasthire
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam / vyajñāpayanta deveśam indrāgnikapurogamāḥ
paśya paśya mahābhāga dānavair ākulīkṛtāḥ / bādhitāḥ putradārābhyāṃ tvām eva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
paritrāyasva deveśa sarvalokapitāmaha / nānyā gatiḥ sureśāna muktvā tvāṃ parameṣṭhinam
brahmovāca: dānavānāṃ vighātārthaṃ narmadātaṭam āśritāḥ / tapaḥ kuruta bho devās tapo hi paramaṃ balam
nānyopāyo na vai mantro na vidyā na ca vikramaḥ / vinā revājalaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃ karam
dāridryavyādhimaraṇabandhanavyasanāni ca / etāni caiva pāpasya phalānīti matir mama
evaṃ jñātvā vidhānena tapaḥ kuruta duṣkaram / pūjyate śāmbhavaṃ sarvaiḥ prāpnuyātābhayaṃ tataḥ
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ devā brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ / narmadāmāgatāḥ sarve tadendrāgnipurogamāḥ
vicerus tatra vipulaṃ tapaḥ paramaduḥsaham / sakalpaiḥ paramāṃ rājaṃs tat te siddhim avāpnuvan
tadā prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ devatīrtham iti śrutam / gīyate sarvalokeṣu sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram
tatra śraddhātmanā yo 'pi vidhināpi samanvitaḥ / snānaṃ samācared bhaktyā sa labhen mauktikaṃ phalam
yas tam arcayate devaṃ sarvadevais tu pūjitam / labhate cāśvamedhasya phalaṃ yāgasya cottamam
yas tu bhojayate viprāṃs tasmiṃs tīrthe narādhipa / tatra devaśilā ramyā mahāpuṇyādrirvadhinī
saṃnyāsena mṛtānāṃ tu narāṇāmakṣayā gatiḥ / agnipraveśaṃ yaḥ kuryād devatīrthe yudhiṣṭhira
rudraloke vaset tāvad yāvad āhūtasamplavam / evaṃ snānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam
sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vāpi tatra tīrthe 'kṣayaṃ bhavet / etāvad vidhir uddiṣṭā utpattiś caiva bhārata
devatīrthasya caritaṃ sarvatīrtheṣv anuttamam

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe devatīrthamahimānuvarṇano nāma pañcasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 76 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tatogacchec ca rājendra guhāvāsīti cottamam / yatra siddho mahādevo guhāvāsīti śaṅkaraḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kena kāryeṇa viprendra guhāvāsīti śaṅkaraḥ / etad vistarataḥ sarva kathayasva mamānagha
śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ deva sarvaṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: mahāpraśnaḥ kṛto māṃ yo mahāprājña nareśvara
purāṇe vistaro 'py asya na śakyo hi mayādhunā / vṛddhabhāvāt kathayitum ahaṃ ca bahukālikaḥ
pūrva dāruvane viprā vasanti sma suraiḥ samāḥ / brahmacārī gṛhasthaś ca vānaprastho yatis tathā
svadharmaniratānāṃ ca kathitaṃ paramaṃ padam / tāvadvasantasamaye kasmiṃścit kāraṇāntare
vimānastho mahādevo gamyamānomayā saha / dadarśa ca janāvāsaṃ vedadhvaninināditam
agatāgatasaṃvāsaṃ sarvapāpakṣayaṃ karam / taddṛṣṭvā muditāṃ devīṃ harṣagadgadayā girā
uvāca vacanaṃ devo dṛṣṭvā tāpasayoṣitaḥ / nānyaṃ devaṃ na vai dharmaṃ dhyāyanti himanandini
etac chrutvā paraṃ vākyaṃ devadevena bhāṣitam / kautūhalasamāviṣṭā śaṅkaraṃ punar abravīt
yat tvayoktaṃ mahādeva patidharmaparāstriyaḥ / tāsām anaṅgo bhūtvā tvaṃ caritraṃ kṣobhaya prabho
mahādeva uvāca: tvayoktaṃ vacanaṃ devi na caitad rocate priye / brāhmaṇā hi mahābhāgā na teṣāṃ vipriyaṃ caret
manyupraharaṇā viprāś cakrapraharaṇo hariḥ / cakrāt tīkṣṇataro manyus tasmād vipraṃ na kopayet
na te devā na te lokās te nāgā nāsurās tathā / dṛśyante ca tribhir lokair etair uṣṭair na vañcitāḥ
teṣāṃ kṣobhakaraḥ prāyaḥ svargabhogaphalacyutaḥ / yeṣāṃ tuṣṭā mahābhāgā brāhmaṇāḥ kṣitidevatāḥ
teṣāṃ dharmas tathārthaś ca kāmo mokṣo na saṃśayaḥ / evaṃ jñātvā mahābhāge āgrahastyajyatām ayam
etal lokaviruddhaṃ hi yadīcchasi vaśe sukham / devy uvāca: nāhaṃ te dayitā deva nāhaṃ te vaśavartinī
anyāyadharṣaṇāṃ cātra sarvāsāṃ kuru suvrata / lokāloke mahādeva aśakyaṃ nāsti te vibho
kriyatāṃ mama devaitatparaṃ kautūhalaṃ prabho / evam ukto mahādevo devyāḥ priyahite rataḥ
kṛtvā kāpālikaṃ rūpaṃ yayau dāruvanaṃ prati / mahāhināṃ jaṭājūṭaṃ niyamya śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ
kaṅkatrāṇaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā tathā sauvarṇakuṇḍale / vyāghracarmaparīdhāno hārakeyūrabhūṣitaḥ
nūpurārāvanirghoṣaiḥ kampayaṃś ca vasundharām / mahāḍamarughoṣeṇa vīraghaṇṭāninādinā
prabhātasamaye prāpte tatra dāruvanaṃ gata / tāvad viprajanaḥ sarvaḥ puṣpamūlaphalāśanaḥ
nirgato bahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ paṭhyamāna itas tataḥ / taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryarūpaṃ devasya bhārata
yuvatījanaḥ pramattaś ca kāmena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ / surūpaṃ paramaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvās tāś ca varānanāḥ
kleśabhāvaṃ tadāgacchan yāś ca dāruvane striyaḥ / vikārā bahavas tāsāṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā manojavam
saṃjātā viprapatnīnāṃ tāṃ śṛṇuṣva nṛpottama / paridhānaṃ na jānanti paribhraṣṭaṃ karodyatāḥ
dātukāmā tathā bhaikṣyaṃ ceṣṭituṃ naiva śakyate / kācid dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ rūpayauvanagarvitā
utsaṅge saṃsthitaṃ vālaṃ patitaṃ vyasmarat tataḥ / kāmabāṇahatā cānyā bāhubhyāṃ pīḍati stanau
niḥśvasantī tathā cānyā na kiṃcit parijalpate / evam akṣobhayat sarvā maheśaḥ patidevatāḥ
cālitāstā viditvā tu nirjagmur dvārisatvarāḥ / saṃcitāḥ paramaṃ kṛtvā sarvā devo maheśvaraḥ
kṣobhayitvā gaṇaṃ strīṇāṃ gataś cādarśanaṃ ca tam / tato vipragaṇaḥ sarvaḥ samāyāto dadarśa ha
kṣobhitaṃ strījanaṃ sarvaṃ hareṇa krodhamāviśat / krodhāviṣṭo dvijaḥ kaścid daṇḍam udyamya dhāvati
kuṭhārahasto hy aparas tathānyo darbhamuṣṭimān / itaścetaśca te sarve bhramitvā tac ca kānanam
ekībhūtā mahātmāno vyājahuś ca ruṣā giram / yadi dattaṃ hutaṃ kiṃcid guravastoṣitā yadi
tena satyena devasya liṅgaṃ patatu bhūtale / evaṃ satyaprabhāveṇa vacanena dvijanmanām
devasya paśyato liṅgaṃ patitaṃ dharaṇītale / hāhākāro mahānāsīl lokāloke tu bhārata
devasya patitaṃ liṅgaṃ jagaty eva mahākṣayam / patamānasya liṅgasya śabdo 'bhūt tatra dāruṇaḥ
patanti parvatāgrāṇi śoṣam āyānti sāgarāḥ / devasya patite liṅge vimānair devadānavāḥ
sametya sahitāḥ sarve brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā / kṛtāñjalipuṭā devaṃ stuvanti vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ
tatas tuṣṭo jagannātho devānāṃ varado 'bhavat / devo 'pi patite liṅge śāpena dharaṇītale
gatvā dāruvanaṃ viprāṃs toṣayāmāsa bhārata / viśvāmitro vaśiṣṭhādyā jābālir atha kāśyapaḥ
sametya sahitāḥ sarve tam ūcus tripurāntakam / mahājano 'pi balavān nāvajñeyaḥ sureśvaraḥ
kṣāntiyukto 'pi bhūtvā ca bhaviṣyasi gataklamaḥ / vidhvaṃsitā vipradārā yad etal liṅgam uttamam
patitaṃ te mahādeva etat puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati / tatpuṇyaṃ nāgnihotreṇa agniṣṭomair na labhyate
yaccharma rudra prāpsyanti mānavā liṅgapūjayā / devānāṃ caiva yakṣāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām
vacanena tu viprāṇām etat puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati / brahmaviṣṇvindrarudrāṇāṃ darśanena ca yatphalam
tatphalaṃ tasya liṅgasya darśane sakalaṃ labhet / evam ukto jagannāthaḥ praṇipatya dvijottamān
mudā paramayā yuktas tāṃś caiva pratyabhāṣata / brāhmaṇā jaṅgamaṃ tīrthaṃ nirjalaṃ sarvakāmikam
yeṣāṃ vākyodayenaiva śuddhyanti malanā janāḥ / kiṃcit tīrthaṃ na hi kṣetramūṣaraṃ gahvarāṇi ca
brāhmaṇāc chreṣṭham uddiṣṭaṃ yatra gatvā viśuddhyati / pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni gaṅgādyāḥ saritas tathā
ekasyā vipravākyasya kalā nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm / abhinandya dvijān sarvān anujñāto mahānṛṣiḥ
tato 'gāc ca mahādevo narmadātaṭam uttamam / parama vratam āsthāya guhāvāsaṃ mahārbudam
maunaṃ cacāra bhagavāñjapadhyānarataḥ sadā / samāpte niyame tāta sthāpayitvā maheśvaram
vandyamānaḥ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ kailāsam agamat prabhuḥ / narmadāyās taṭe yena sthāpitaḥ parameśvaraḥ
tenaiva kāraṇenāsau narmadeśvaramuttamam / yad yad ācarati śreṣṭhas tattad evetaro janaḥ
sa yatpramāṇaṃ kurute lokas tad anuvartate / tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā vidhinā sujitendriyaḥ
arcayitvā mahādevam aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet / pitṛbhyo dadate yas tu tilapuṣpakuśodakam
trisaptapuruṣās tasya svarge pāṇḍava modante / yas tu bhojayate viprān yathāśaktyā narottamaḥ
tasya tīrthaprabhāveṇa dattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam / suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhira
dadate toyam āspṛśya so 'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet / aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ pūjayec ca viśeṣataḥ
narmadeśvaram āsādya avāptaṃ janmanaḥ phalam / agniveśe jale vāpi anāśakamṛtaś ca yaḥ
anivartikā gatis tasya yathā me śaṅkaro 'bravīt / etat kīrtayate yas tu narmadeśvaram uttamam
bhaktyā śṛṇoti yo rājann aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe dāruvanaprasaṅge narmadeśvarakīrtanaṃ nāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 77 tato gacchec ca rājendra kapilātīrtham uttamam / snānamātraḥ prasaṅgena narmadeśvarakīrtanam
tasmiṃs tīrthe tu rājendra kapilāṃ yaḥ prayacchati / yāvanti romakūpāni tatprasūtikuleṣu ca
tāvanty abdasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke mahīyate / jale vāgnipraveśe vā athavānaśake naraḥ
tatra tīrthe mṛto yas tu na garbhe jāyate kvacit / eva hi vidhir uddiṣṭaḥ sakalo nṛpasattama
tīrthasya ca phalaṃ puṇyaṃ kim anyat paripṛcchasi / dhanyaṃ yaśasyam āyuṣyaṃ sarvaduḥkhaghnam uttamam
etac chrutvā naro rājan sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate / tato gacchet tu rājendra karañjeśvaram uttamam
tatra siddho mahābhāga daityo vai lokaviśrutaḥ / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: ko 'sau siddho mahābhāga tatra tīrthe mahātapāḥ
kasya putro 'tha kiṃkāryaṃ kālaḥ kaḥ kathaya dvija / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā cādiyuge rājan mānaso brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ
vedavedāṅgatattvajño marīcir nāma nāmataḥ / tasyā 'pi kaśyapo rājan kālena mahatānagha
putro 'tha mānaso jātaḥ sākṣād brahmeva cāparaḥ / kṣamā damā dayā dānaṃ satyaṃ śaucam athārjavam
marīces tu guṇās tv ete santi bhānti ca bhārata / evaṃ guṇagaṇāḥ kīrtiḥ kaśyape dvijasattame
jñātvā prajāpatir dakṣo bhāryārthe svasutāṃ dadau / aditir vai danuś caiva tathā hyekādaśā parāḥ
yāsāṃ putrāś ca pautrāś ca jātā bhrātarasaṃkhyakāḥ / aditir janayāmāsa putrānindrapurogamān
nāgān pretapiśācāṃś ca patatrīn yakṣarākṣasān / siṃhavyāghravarāhāṃś ca anyā ity evam ādayaḥ
jātās tasya mahābāho kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ / yais tu lokatrayaṃ vyāptaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ mahat
tathānyaś ca mahābhāgo danoḥ putro vyajāyata / sarvalakṣaṇasampannaḥ karañjo nāma nāmataḥ
baler iva mahābhāga cacāra sumahat tapaḥ / vareṇa chandayāmāsa tripurāntakaraḥ prabhuḥ
bhoḥ karañja mahāsattva parituṣṭo 'smi te 'nagha / varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yat te manasi vartate
karañja uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva tripurāntakara prabho / tataḥ putraiś ca pautraiś ca sahitaṃ me dhanaṃ kuru
tathety uktvā mahādeva umayā sahitas tadā / vṛṣārūḍho gaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata
gate cādarśanaṃ deve so 'pi daityo mudānvitaḥ / svanāmnā ca mahādevaṃ sthāpayitvā gṛhaṃ yayau
tadā prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ karañjeśvaram uttamam / snānamātro naro rājan mucyate brahmahatyayā
tasmiṃs tīrthe mahārāja tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ / so 'gniṣṭomasya yatpuṇyaṃ phalaṃ prāpnoty asaṃśayam
anāśakaṃ tu yaḥ kuryāt tasmiṃs tīrthe narottama
athāgnau ca jale prāṇān bhūtale vāpi yas tyajet / svarge sa tu vasen nūnaṃ varṣāṇām ayutadvayam
dhanavān sukule cānte jāyate vipule kule / vedavedāṅgatattvajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ
rājā vā rājatulyo vā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ
etat te sarvamākhyātaṃ yat tvaṃ māṃ paripṛcchasi / tīrthasya tu phalaṃ yuktyā sarvadāneṣu bhārata
etat puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥkhapraṇāśanam / paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva tīrthamāhātmyam uttamam
yas tu śrāvayate śrāddhe sa tatpitṛparāyaṇaḥ / akṣayaṃ tasya sarvaṃ syāc chaṅkaras tv idam abravīt

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe karañjeśvaramahimānuvarṇano nāma saptasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 78 atha aṣṭasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchec ca rājendra kuṇḍaleśvaram uttamam / yatra siddhiṃ gato devaḥ kuṇḍadhāro nṛpottama
tapaḥ kṛtvā tu vipulaṃ surāsurabhayaṃ karam / kuṇḍadhāro mandarasthaḥ krīḍate sa nṛpottama
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kasyānvaye samutpannaḥ kasya putro mahāmatiḥ / tapas taptvā suvipulaṃ toṣito yena śaṅkaraḥ
etad vistaratas tāta kathayasva mamānagha / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: purā tretāyuge rājan paulastyo nāma viśravāḥ
upaye me mahābhāga bharadvājasutāṃ nṛpa / putraḥ putraguṇairyuktas tasyāṃ jāto dhanaṃ jayaḥ
jātamātraṃ sutaṃ jñātvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ / cakāra nāma suprīta ṛṣidevasamanvitaḥ
yasmād viśravaso jāto mama pautratvam āgataḥ / tasmād vaiśravaṇo nāma mayā dattaṃ tavānagha
yaḥ svayaṃ sarvadevānāṃ dhanagoptā bhaviṣyati / caturtho lokapālānām akṣayo yakṣapo 'pi vā
yakṣo yakṣādhipaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kuṇḍadhāro 'bhavat sutaḥ / susvaṃrūpavayaḥ prāpya mātāpitroranujñayā
tapaś cakāra vipulaṃ narmadātīram āśritaḥ / yatra vyāghreśvaraṃ liṅgaṃ vyāghrakheṭakam uttamam
kuṇḍadhāreṇa tatraiva tapas taptaṃ sudāruṇam / grīṣme pañcāgnimadhyastho varṣāsvāsārathāraṇaḥ
śiśire jalamadhyastho vāyubhakṣaḥ śataṃ samāḥ / evaṃ varṣaśate pūrṇe ekāṅguṣṭho 'bhavat tataḥ
cakravad bhramate sūryamabhito bharatarṣabha / caturthe pañcame tāvat tutoṣa vṛṣavāhanaḥ
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva he vatsa yat te manasi rocate / tad dadāmi na sandehas tapasā toṣito hy aham
kuṇḍadhāra uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva varaditsur ihāgataḥ / tato mannāmakaṃ liṅgaṃ tīrthaṃ caitad bhavatv iti
tathetyuktvā mahādevaḥ somo 'ntardhānamāgamat / jagāmā kāśam āviśya kailāsaṃ dharaṇidharam
gate cādarśana deva so 'pi yakṣo mudānvitaḥ / sthāpayāmāsa deveśaṃ kuṇḍaleśvaramuttamam
alaṃkṛtvā gajaṃ dhenuṃ dhūpapuṣpavilepanaiḥ / vitānaiś cāmaraiś chatrais tathaiva liṅgapūjanaiḥ
tarpayitvā dvijān samyag annapānādi bhūṣaṇaiḥ / prīṇayitvā mahādevaṃ tataḥ svabhavanaṃ yayau
tadā prabhṛti tat tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam / yudhiṣṭhira paraṃ puṇyaṃ kuṇḍaleśvarasaṃjñakam
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścid upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / arcayed devam īśānaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vāpi maṇiṃ mauktikam eva ca / brāhmaṇebhyo dadātyatra sa mukhyo modate divi
tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā ṛgyajuḥ sāmasu dvijaḥ / ṛcam ekāṃ japitvā ca caturvedaphalaṃ labhet
tasmiṃs tīrthe tu godānam annadānam athāpi vā / yaḥ prayacchati viprebhyas tatphalaṃ śṛṇu pāṇḍava
yāvanti tasya romāṇi tatprasūtikuleṣu ca / tāvad varṣasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate
svargavāso bhavet tasya putrapautrasamanvitaḥ / tasmiṃs tīrthe mahābhāga vyāghraś caiva pipāsitaḥ
niṣādānāṃ bhayenaiva aṭavyāmaṭati svayam / niṣādānāṃ bharyair naṣṭaḥ patito narmadājale
jalapluto mahābhāga liṅgarūpadharo 'bhavat / uktaścākāśavāṇyā vai vyāghreśvaram anuttamam
pūjyaṃ vai triṣu lokeṣu khyātiṃ yāsyaty asaṃśayam / tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā tal liṅgam arcayet tu yaḥ
brahmahatyādipāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ / etat te kathitaṃ rājan kuṇḍaleśvaram uttamam
śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya gosahasraphalaṃ labhet

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe kuṇḍaleśvaramahimā anuvarṇanonāma aṣṭasaptatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 79 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra pippaleśvaram uttamam / yatra siddho mahāyogī pippalādo mahātapāḥ
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: pippalādasya caritaṃ śrotumicchāmy ahaṃ prabho / māhātmyaṃ tasya tīrthasya yatra siddho mahātapāḥ
kasya putro mahābhāga kimarthaṃ taptavāṃs tapaḥ / etad vistarataḥ sarvaṃ kathayasva mamānagha
mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: mithilāstho mahābhāga vedavedāṅgapāragaḥ / yājñavalkyaś ca purataś cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
tāpasī tasya bhaginī yājñavalkyasya dhīmataḥ / cacāra sāpi tatrasthā śuśrūṣantī mahattapaḥ
tatas tv ekasmin samaye snātāhani rajasvalā / antarvāsaṃ kṛtavatī dṛṣṭvā karkaṭakaṃ rahaḥ
yājñavalkyo 'pi tad rātrau paridhānena tena vai / svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvātyajac chukraṃ prabhāte 'nvaiṣayat punaḥ
tata sā brāhmaṇī tāta kim anveṣyasi bhārata / kena kāryaṃ tava vibho vadasva mama tattvataḥ
yājñavalkya uvāca: apavitro mayā bhadre svapno dṛṣṭo 'dya vai niśi / śuklaṃ me cātra vastraṃ svaṃ nikṣiptaṃ tan na dṛśyate
tacchrutvā brāhmaṇī vākyaṃ bhītabhītābhavan nṛpa / tadvastraṃ tu mayā brahman snātvāntardhānakaṃ kṛtam
tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā hāhetyuktvā mahātapāḥ / papāta sahasā bhūmau chinnamūla iva drumaḥ
kim etad iti jalpantam ākāśād vāgvinirgatā / toṣayantī ca taṃ vipraṃ provāca nṛpate tadā
nāsya doṣo mayā dṛṣṭas tava caiva śubhavrate / tava garbhodayo yena tatra daivaṃ parāyaṇam
na vināśo 'sya kartavyo yāvat kālasya paryayaḥ / tatheti vrīḍitā sā ca durmaneti vimānataḥ
pālayāmāsa taṃ garbhaṃ yāvat putro vyajāyata / jātamātraṃ tu taṃ garbhaṃ kathayitvā na kaṃcana
aśvasthavṛkṣamāsādya sotsasarja mahītale / yāni sattvāni lokeṣu sthāvarāṇi carāṇi vai
tāni vai pālayantv enaṃ bālakaṃ tyajati sma sā / evamuktvā tataḥ sādhvī brāhmaṇī nṛpasattama
yathāgataṃ jagāmātha sāvasthāya muhūrtakam / pādau pāṇī vinikṣipya vimṛjya nayane śūbhe
āsyaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ kṛtvā rurodoccairanāthavat / tena śabdena vitrastāḥ sthāvarā jaṅgamāś ca ye
akampayat mahīṃ tāta saśailavanakandarām / tato jñātvā mahadbhūtaṃ kṣudhāviṣṭaṃ dvijarṣabham
na jahāti nagaś chāyāmārpayac ca tataḥ payaḥ / āpyāyitas tatas tena amṛtenaiva bhārata / tataḥ sa cintayāviṣṭo nirmame grahagocaram
tena krūrasam ācāraḥ krūradṛṣṭyā nirīkṣitaḥ / papāta sahasā bhūmau śanaiścārī śanaiścaraḥ
śanaiścaraṃ bālako 'pi pādenaiva parāmṛśat / pīḍitaḥ so 'pi bālena uvāca vacanaṃ tadā
kiṃ mayā 'pakṛtaṃ vipra pippalāda mahāmune / niṣkrāman gagane caiva pātito dharaṇītale
sauriṇāpy evam uktas tu pippalādo mahāmuniḥ / krodharūpo 'bravīd vākyaṃ tac chṛṇuṣva narādhipa
pitṛmātṛvihīnasya bālabhāvasya durmate / pīḍāṃ karoṣi kasmāt tvaṃ saure tvam avaśeṣitaḥ
śanaiścara uvāca: krūrasvabhāvasaṃjātā mama dṛṣṭi dvijottama / muñca tvaṃ māṃ ca kartāhaṃ yad bravīṣi na saṃśayaḥ
pippalāda uvāca: adya prabhṛtibālānāṃ janmataḥ ṣoḍaśīḥ samāḥ / pīḍā tvayā na kartavyā eṣa te samayaḥ paraḥ
evam astv iti taṃ coktvā prajagāma yathāgataḥ / devamārgaṃ śanaiścārī praṇamya ṛṣisattamam
tataś cādarśanaṃ tatra gatavān sa mahāgrahaḥ / vicintayānaś caikākī krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ
āgneyīṃ hi diśaṃ dhyātvā janayāmāsa pāvakam / kṛttvā māṃsaṃ juhāvāgnau kriyāsambhavatattvataḥ
tāvac ca janitā kṛtyā jvālāmālāvibhūṣitā / hutabhuksadṛśākārā kiṃkaromīti cābravīt
śoṣayāmi samudraṃ kiṃ cūrṇayāmi ca parvatam / bhūmiṃ ca veṣṭayāmīha pātayitvā nabhastalam
kasya mūrdhni patiṣyāmi ghātayāmi ca kaṃ dvija / śīghramādiśa me kāryaṃ na kālātikramo bhavet
tasyās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā pippalādo mahātapāḥ / krodharaktāntanayana idaṃ vacanam abravīt
mahatā krodhavegena mayā tvaṃ cintitā śubhe / pitā me yājñavalkyas tu taṃ tvaṃ ghātaya māciram
evamuktā tu sā śīghraṃ sphuṭantīva nabhas talam / mithilāstho mahāprājño yatra tepe mahātapāḥ
yāvat paśyati diṅmārgaṃ jvalanārkasamaprabham / yājñavalkyo mahātejās tadbhūtaṃ samupasthitam
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasāyāntīṃ bhītabhīto mahāmuniḥ / bhūtenākramito vipro janakaṃ nṛpatiṃ yayau
śaraṇārtham anuprāptaṃ viddhi māṃ nṛpasattama / mahābhūtāc ca māṃ rakṣa yadi śaknoṣi mānada
rājovāca: brahmatejobhavam bhūtam anivāryaṃ durāsadam / prabhur naivādya śaknomi anyaṃ gaccha mahāmate
tataś cānyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ śaraṇārthī mahātapāḥ / jagāma tena caivokta indrasya śaraṇaṃ yayau
devarāja namaste 'stu mahābhūtāc ca rakṣa mām / tasya tad vacanaṃ śrutvābravīd indras tadā vacaḥ
na ca śaktaḥ paritrātuṃ brahmatejo hi duḥsaham / tataś ca brahmabhavanaṃ brāhmaṇo brahmavittamaḥ
jagāma viṣṇubhavanaṃ śakto 'pi tyaktavān bhayāt / tataḥ sa paramodvigno nirāśo jīvite nṛpa
anugamyamāno bhūtena agacchac ca maheśvaram / tasya yogabalopeto mahādevasya pāṇḍava
nakhamāṃsāntare lupto yathā devo na paśyati / adṛṣṭam agamad bhūtaṃ jvalanārkasamaprabham
muñca muñceti puruṣa muñceśvaram uvāca ha / evam ukto mahādevas tena bhūtena bhārata
yogīndraṃ darśayām āsa nakhamāṃsāntare sthitam / saṃsthāpya kṛtyāṃ bhūteśo jvalatkālānalaprabhām
uvāca mā bhaistvaṃ vipra mā ca gaccha mahāmune / tatas taṃ sūkṣmadehasthaṃ mahādevo 'bravīd idam
kimasya tvaṃ mahābhūta kartā kṛtya vadasva me / kṛtyovāca: krodhadīptena deveśa pippalādena cintitā
asya dehe patiṣyāmi ahiṃsyāṃ viddhi māṃ prabho / etac chrutvā mahādevo bhūtasya vadanāc cyutam
variṣṭhaṃ bandhayāmāsa yājñavalkyasya ghātakam / yogīśvaraṃ taṃ viprendraṃ dattvābhītiṃ yudhiṣṭhira
visarjayitvā devas taṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata / preṣayitvā tu taṃ bhūtaṃ pippalādo 'pi durmanāḥ
mātāpitṛvihīnas tu narmadātaṭam āśritaḥ / ekaniṣṭho nirāhāro varṣāṇi ṣoḍaśaiva tu
toṣayāmāsa deveśam umayā saha śaṅkaram / hara uvāca: parituṣṭo 'smi te vipra tapasānena suvrata
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva te dadyāṃ manasābhīpsitaṃ śubham / pippalāda uvāca: yadi me bhagavāṃs tuṣṭo yadi deyo varo mama
atra sannihito deva mama nāmnā ca śaṅkara / evam uktas tathety uktvā pippalādaṃ mahāmunim
jagāmādarśanaṃ devo bhūtasaṅghair niṣevitaḥ / pippalādo gate deve snātvā tatra mahāmbhasi
sthāpayitvā mahadevaṃ jagāmottaraparvatam / tatra tīrthe naro bhaktyā snātvā mantrayuto nṛpa
tarpayitvā pitṝn devān pūjayitvā maheśvaram / aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoty anuttamam
mṛto rudrapuraṃ yāti pippaleśvarasannidhau / athavā bhojayed viprān pitṝn uddiśya bhaktitaḥ
dvādaśābdasahasrāṇi tṛptā gacchanti sadgatim / saṃnyāsena tu yaḥ kaścit tatra tīrthe tanuṃ tyajet
anivartikā gatis tasya yathā me śaṅkaro 'bravīt / etat sarvaṃ samākhyātaṃ yat tvaṃ māṃ paripṛṣṭavān
māhātmyaṃ pippalādasya pippaleśvaram uttamam / etat puṇyaṃ pāpaharaṃ dhanyaṃ duḥkhapraṇāśanam
paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvapāpapramocanam

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe pippaleśvaramahimānuvarṇano nāmaikonāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 80 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra vimaleśvaram uttamam / tatra devaśilā ramyā mahādevena bhāṣitā
garjanaṃ kheṭakaṃ nāma tatra devaśilā śubhā / tatra snātvā tu yo bhaktyā tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
tasya te dvādaśābdāni sutṛptā divi moditāḥ / tasmiṃs tīrthe tu yo bhaktyā brāhmaṇān pūjayen nṛpa
svalpenāpi hi dānena tasya cānto na vidyate / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kāni dānāni viprendra śastāni dharaṇītale
yāni dattvā naro bhaktyā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ maṇiṃ mauktikam eva ca
bhūmidānaṃ tathā gāvo mocayanty aṃśumān naram / tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ kaścit kurute prāṇasaṃkṣayam
rudraloke vaset tāvad yāvad āhūtasaṃplavam / tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ gacchet kurukṣetrasamāṃ nṛpa
pūrvaṃ puṣkariṇī nāma kurukṣetraṃ kalau smṛtam / tatra snātvā yajed devaṃ tejorāśiṃ divākaram
ṛcam ekāṃ japet saumyaḥ sāmavedaphalaṃ labhet / yajurvedasya japanaṃ ṛgvedasya tathaiva ca
tryakṣaraṃ vā japen mantraṃ dhyāyamāno divākaram / ādityahṛdayaṃ japtvā mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ
tatra tīrthe tu yaḥ snātvā vidhinā pūjayed dvijān / tasya koṭiguṇaṃ dānaṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
kārtikyāṃ ca tathā mādhyāṃ vaiśākhyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ / amāvāsyāṃ vyatīpāte saṃkrame vaidhṛtau ravau
kurukṣetre naraḥ snātvā rudrasyānucaro bhavet / anāśake jale hy agnau pañcāgnau vā tathāpi vā
tasmiṃs tīrthe mṛto yas tu sa yāti paramāṃ gatim / brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā nṛpasattama
vihitaṃ karmakurvāṇaḥ sa gacchati satāṃ gatim / yudhiṣṭhira uvāca: kiṃ japan mucyate vyādher jñātvā varṇaṃ dvijottama
kiṃ kurvan mucyate prāṇī yāti lokam anāmayam / mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śṛṇu rājann avahita itihāsaṃ purātanam
guhyatīrthe samāsādya brāhmaṇo muktavān yathā / purā dvijavaraś cāsīd govindo nāma nāmataḥ
tasya bhāryā susampannā brāhmaṇī ca pativratā / tasyāṃ saṃjanayāmāsa putram ekaṃ ca sundaram
sa bāla eva bhavane krīḍate śiśulīlayā / kadācid brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ kāṣṭhamānayituṃ gataḥ
vanān nītvā kāṣṭhabhāraṃ gṛhe paścāc ca kṣiptavān / krīḍann āste śiśus tatra kāṣṭhabhāreṇa pīḍitaḥ
mamāra bālakas tatra dvijo na jñātavāṃs tadā / brāhmaṇy api tadā tasmai na śaśaṃsa bhayāt tathā
purnadvijaḥ sa govindo vipinaṃ saṃjagāma ha
brāhmaṇy uvāca: rāvaṇo brahmaṇaḥ pautras trailokyaṃ yasya śaṅkate / sa hato rāmacandreṇa saputrāmātyabāndhavaḥ
evaṃ putraṃ vinā saukhyaṃ martye nāke na vidyate / yaśa ākhyāyitaṃ yasya svargārthaṃ yasya bhāratī
miṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇasyārthe svargavāso 'pi vidyate / putrotpattivināśābhyāṃ nāparaṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ
brahmahatyāśvamedhābhyāṃ nāparaṃ pāpapuṇyayoḥ / kiṃ bravīmīti he vatsa nānusaukhyaṃ sutaṃ vinā
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ duḥkhaṃ pralapitvā punaḥ punaḥ / bālaṃ gṛhagate vipre saṃgopya brāhmaṇī tathā
evaṃ tasyāṃ vilapantyāṃ gatā rātrir yudhiṣṭhira / bhūmyāṃ prasuptaṃ govindaṃ putraśokena pīḍitā
yāvan nirīkṣate bhāryā bhartāraṃ duḥkhapīḍitam / kṛmirāśim ayaṃ tāvad govindaṃ nṛpasattama
duḥkhād duḥkhatare magnā dṛṣṭvā taṃ pātakānvitam / evaṃ duḥkhanimagnāyāḥ śarvarī vigatā tadā
punaḥ prātas tu govindo darbhāya ca vanaṃ gataḥ / evaṃ na jñātavān vipraḥ kāṣṭhena ca hataṃ sutam
gatāś ca divasāḥ pañcabrāhmaṇyā gopitaṃ ca yat / paśupālaḥ pañcame 'hni mahiṣīruttamāś ca gāḥ
araṇye mahiṣīr muktvā gāś ca bhoktuṃ gṛhaṃ gataḥ / vijñaptaḥ paśupālena govindo brāhmaṇottamaḥ
yāvad bhakṣāmy ahaṃ svāmin mahiṣīr gāś ca rakṣaya / tataḥ sa tvarito gāś ca brāhmaṇo mahiṣīḥ prati
jagāma mahiṣīr gāś ca viprasya tasya rakṣataḥ / dhāvamānasya gāvaś ca mahiṣyaḥ saṅgamaṃ gatāḥ
tatra praviṣṭās tu jale nadyā revāsusaṅgame / taj jalaṃ pītamātraṃ tu tvarayā tena vāritāḥ
akāmāt salilaṃ pītvā prakṣālya nayane śubhe / ājagāma tataḥ paścād bhavanaṃ dinasaṃkṣaye
bhuktvā duḥkhānvito rātrau govindaḥ śayanaṃ yayau / nidrābhibhūto duḥkhena śrameṇaiva tu kheditaḥ
punas taṃ cārdharātre tu tasya bhāryā nirīkṣate / kṛmibhir veṣṭitaṃ gātraṃ kvacit paśyaty aveṣṭitam
punaḥ sā vismayāviṣṭā tasya bhāryā guṇānvitā / uvāca duṣkṛtaṃ tasya sādhvasāviṣṭacetanā
bhāryovāca: atīte pañcame cāhṇi indhanaṃ kṣipatā tu te / gṛhe paścāt sthito bālas tv ajñāto ghātitas tvayā
mayā tat pātakaṃ ghoraṃ tvat kṛtaṃ na prakāśitam / tena pracchannapāpena dahyamānā divāniśam
na sukhaṃ tava gātrasya na ca paśyāmi cātmanaḥ / nidrā praṇaṣṭā me nātha ratiś caiva tvayā saha
śrūyate mānave śāstre śloko gīto maharṣibhiḥ / smṛtvā smṛtvā ca taṃ rātrau paritāpo na śāmyati
kīrtanān naśyate 'dharmo vardhate 'sau ca gūhanāt / iha loke pare caiva pāpasyānto na vidyate
evaṃ saṃcintyamānāhaṃ sthitā rātrau bhayāturā / kṛmirāśimayaṃ tvāṃ tu paśyāmi kathayāmi kim
punaś ca kānta tvad dehaṃ bhrūṇahatyākṛmiplutam / kvacit tudanti te caiva kvacinnaṣṭāḥ samantataḥ
etatsaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya vimṛśantī punaḥ punaḥ / na jāne kāraṇaṃ kiṃcit pṛcchāmi kathayasva me
taḍāgaṃ vāpi saritaṃ tīrthaṃ vā devatālayam / yaṃ gato 'si prabhāvo 'yaṃ tasya nānyasya me matiḥ
evam uktas tv asau vipraḥ kathayāmāsa bhārata / bhāryayā pūrvavṛttāntaṃ ramamāṇo nṛpottama
golulāyī nivṛttyarthaṃ narmadā saṅgamaṃ gataḥ / nābhimātre jale magnas toyaṃ pītaṃ yatheṣṭataḥ
nānyat tīrthaṃ vijānāmi narmadā ca saridvarā / evaṃ śrutvā ca tatsarvam upavāsaḥ kṛtaḥ kṣaṇāt
bhartrā saha gatā tatra saṅgame varavarṇinī / snātvā vidhiprayuktena saṅgame surapūjite
tarpayāmāsa deveśaṃ śaṅkaraṃ ca sahomayā / pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayitvā brāhmaṇyā sahito dvija
gandhamālyādidhūpaiś ca naivedyaiś ca suśobhanaiḥ / apūjayat tatra liṅgaṃ devīṃ kātyāyanīṃ śubhām
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā bhartrā tena sahaiva sā / tataḥ prabhāte vimale dvijaṃ sampūjya yatnataḥ
godānena hiraṇyena vastreṇānnena bhārata / govindaḥ pūjayāmāsa svaśaktyā brāhmaṇaṃ śubham
uktaś cākāśavāṇyā tu tīrthaṃ guhyāvatī tv idam / guhyeśvaraṃ tatra liṅgaṃ pātālādutthitaṃ tadā
guhyāvatīnarmadayoḥ saṅgamo guṇavānabhūt / muktapāpo gṛhaṃ yātaḥ svabhāryāsahito dvijaḥ
etat tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ bālahatyāpraṇāśanam / tatra snātvā ca japtvā ca dattvā brāhmaṇabhojanam
upāsya śrāddhakaraṇāt tilodakapradānataḥ / nivasecchivaloke hi yāvad āhūta saṃplavam

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe guhyāvatītīrthamahimānuvarṇano nāmāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 81 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato gacchet tu rājendra uttare narmadātaṭe / meghanādasamīpe tu viśvarūpā saridvarā
nirgatā viśvarūpasya śarīrād upakurvataḥ / purā dāruvane devo liṅgahīnaḥ kṛto dvijaiḥ
narmadātaṭam āśritya tapaḥ kurvaṃs tadā nṛpa / viśvarūpo 'bhavad devo nirgatā saritāṃ varā
gatā sā narmadātoyaṃ saṅgamo guṇavān abhūt / tasmiṃs tīrthe naraḥ snātvā sa bhave na punar bhavet
tatra yat kriyate karma sarvaṃ tadakṣayaṃ bhavet / sārikā siddhim āyātā patitā tīrthasaṅgame
pūrvam apsarasāṃ śreṣṭhā śakraśāpād akāmataḥ / citrāṅgadena ramitā kācit kaṣṭamavāpa ha
sārikā bhava kalyāṇi varṣāṇāṃ sā 'graviṃśatim / mṛtvā tvaṃ narmadātoye viśvarūpā susaṅgame
vicitrā bahucārvaṅgī sañjātā sārikā nṛpa / jātismarā surābhāvā narmadātaṭam āśritā
tataḥ kāle ca saṃprāpte prajvālya pāvakaṃ śubham / praviṣṭā sā śubhācārā viśvarūpā susaṅgame
divyadehadharī rājan prāptā śakrasya mandiram / etad antaram āsādya sārikātīrthamucyate
tatra yat kriyate karma śrāddhaṃ yajñaḥ śivārcanam / sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ vidyān meghanādasya darśanāt
avaśaḥ svavaśo vāpi yas tu prāṇān parityajet / na tasya punarāvṛttirghore saṃsārasāgare
khyātāni pañcaliṅgāni yāni dṛṣṭvā śivaṃ vrajet / mānavo manujaśreṣṭha śṛṇu tāni yudhiṣṭhira
meghanādaṃ ca goṣṭheśaṃ vāgīśaṃ kākaḍeśvaram / lakṣeśvaraṃ pañcaliṅgāny ekāhe yas tu pūjayet
anenaiva śarīreṇa sa naro hi śivaṃ vrajet / koṭiyajñaphalaṃ prāpya paścān mokṣamavāpnuyāt
ākhyānaṃ kathayiṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ tavānagha / dharmasenaḥ purā rājā ayodhyādhipatirbalī
dharmeṇa rājyaṃ kṛtavān yajñāṃś ca bahudakṣiṇān / śṛṇvan sa dharmaśāstrāṇi narmadācaritaṃ tathā
śrutvā vinirgato rājā revāyā uttare taṭe / meghanādaṃ samabhyarcya snātvā vai narmadājale
udgacchati dinakare aśvārūḍho nareśvaraḥ / uttarāṃ diśamāśritya gato goṣṭheśvaraṃ śivam
yathāvidhānaṃ sampūjya vāgīśvaraṃ gatas tataḥ / tatra snātvā vidhānena pūjayitvā śivaṃ nṛpaḥ
candanāgurukarpūrair dhūpair dīpair vidhānakaiḥ / aśvārūḍho nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ kākaḍeśvaram āgataḥ
taṃ prapūjya tato rājā gatvā vai nārmade jale / lakṣeśvaraṃ pūjayitvā sthitaṃ vai vidhipūrvakam
meghanādaṃ tato gatvā sūryaścāstam upāgamat / dhyātvā svayaṃ kālarūpaṃ yāvat tiṣṭhati vai nṛpaḥ
tāvad ghoro 'pi turago hy antarikṣacaras tadā / divyadehadharaḥ saścāpy apsarobhiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
vimāne devarājasya yayāvindrapurīṃ sthitaḥ / śunī pṛṣṭhe tu yā rājñastīrthayātrāṃ prakurvatī
divyadehadharā sāpi vimānena gatā divi / dharmaseno 'pi tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭacetanaḥ
aśvarūpaṃ jagādātha kim etad iti bhārata / uvācākāśago vācaṃ kathaṃ tvaṃ khidyase nṛpa
śarīrajena kaṣṭena tapaḥ sādhyā vibhūtayaḥ / pādacārī hi gaccha tvaṃ parapādair gato hyasi
bhūyo yātrāṃ prakuruṣe tadā siddhim avāpsyasi / tato rājā ca tasyātha śrutvā tadvacanaṃ tadā
punar dvitīyadivase prasthito liṅgapūjanam / pañcaliṅgān samabhyarcya samāyātas tu narmadām
meghanādaṃ yadāpaśyad dvāre devaṃ ca dṛṣṭavān / pañcavaktraṃ daśabhujaṃ trinetraṃ śūlapāṇinam
vṛṣārūḍhaṃ jagadgarbhaṃ śaśāṅkakṛtaśekharam / dṛṣṭvā taṃ devadeveśaṃ tuṣṭāva parameśvaram
jaya deva mahādeva mahāpātakanāśana / saṃsārasāgare magnaṃ māṃ samuddhara sāmpratam
hara uvāca: varaṃ vṛṇu mahābhāga yat te manasi vartate / tad dadāmi na sandehaś śvibhakto hi putraka
yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva tanmāṃ sahacaraṃ kuru / ekāhe pañcaliṅgāni pūjayiṣyati yo naraḥ
sa tavānucaro deva bhavatv eṣa varo mama / dharmasenavacaḥ śrutvā bhavatv evaṃ haro 'bravīt
taṃ gṛhītvā tu rājānaṃ kailāsaṃ sa jagāma ha / svadehasthaṃ cakārāsau dharmasenaṃ nṛpaṃ nṛpa
etat te kathitaṃ rājann itihāsaṃ purātanam / śravaṇāt kīrtanād asya aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe pañcaliṅgamahimānuvarṇano nāmaikāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 82 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: athānyat kathayiṣyāmi tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / mayūrakukkuṭaṃ nāma brahmahatyā vyapohanam
mṛkaṇḍasyāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ narmadādakṣiṇe taṭe / mṛkaṇḍo nāma bhūpāla ṛṣiḥ paramadhārmikaḥ
tapas tepe mahābhāga divyair varṣasahasrakaiḥ / tasyāśramapade ramye munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
vasanti sma jalāhārāḥ śuṣkapatrakṛtāśanāḥ / kecit tanna nirāhārā mokṣopāyavicintakāḥ
etasminn antare rājan gandharvau śakragāyanau / hetiprahetināmānau gatau śakrasabhāṃ nṛpa
vadhūrapsarasāṃ śreṣṭhā dṛṣṭā tābhyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira / dṛṣṭamātrau tu gandharvau kāmabāṇaprapīḍitau
hetiḥ kukkuṭaśabdena prahetir barhiṇas tathā / ghoṣyamāṇau sumadhuraṃ sādayāmāsa tu ca tām
vṛtrahā tad abhiprāyaṃ jñātvā śāpaṃ dadau tavā
pūrṇe divyaśate varṣe paścād atrāgamiṣyathaḥ / tiryagyonau tu saṃprāptau gandharvau hi yudhiṣṭhira
jātismarau durācārau pakṣiṇau priyadarśīnau / sarvatīrthāny uttaran tau nāradaṃ ca dadarśatuḥ
gandharvāv ūcatuḥ: bhaviṣyāvaḥ śubhācāra brahmaputra tapodhana / karmaṇā kena cāvāṃ hi muktāvetau vadasva tat
nārada uvāca: narmadā dakṣiṇe tīre mṛkaṇḍasyāśramaṃ śubham / tiryagyonivimokṣaṃ ca tīrthaṃ hi paramaṃ matam
jalāplutau narmadāyāḥ sarvaṃ tatra bhaviṣyati / tato hetiḥ prahetiś ca susnātau divyarūpiṇau
ekena snānamātreṇa pakṣiṇau divyatāṃ gatau / snātvā tu vidhinā 'nena dhyātvā devaṃ sadāśivam
uccāryyāghoramantraṃ tau sadā dhyānasthitau nṛpa / etasminn antare rājan pātālādutthitaṃ śubham
śatasūryaprakāśaṃ hi liṅgaṃ tatra yudhiṣṭhira / kukkuṭeśvaram ekaṃ tu mayūreśvaram eva ca
gandharvau tu vimānasthau gatau śakrasya mandiram / tasmiṃs tīrthe naraḥ snātvā bhave naiva punar bhavet
snātvā tilodakaṃ dattvā pitṝṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ / avaśaḥ svavaśo 'vāpi yastu prāṇān parityajet
na tasya punarāvṛttir ghore saṃsārasāgare / tatra kīṭāḥ pataṅgāś ca pakṣiṇo 'tha sarīsṛpāḥ
maṇḍūkāḥ pāpavṛkṣāś ca mṛtā yānti śivaṃ padam

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe mṛkaṇḍāśramakīrtano nāma dvyaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 83 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tato 'nyat paramaṃ tīrthaṃ candramatyās tu saṅgame / candreśvaraṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ tathā siddheśvaraṃ punaḥ
ghaṇṭeśvaraṃ mahiṣeśam aśvatīrtham ataḥ param / vṛṣasenaṃ hayagrīvaṃ śukatīrtham ataḥ param
rameśvaraṃ tato gacchet tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam / mekalāyās taṭe rājan mahāpātakanāśanam
yadā dāruvane pūrvaṃ mahādevena mohitāḥ / brāhmaṇānāṃ striyas tatra ramamāṇāḥ samāgatāḥ
cintayantyaś ca tā mokṣaṃ mekalātīram āśritāḥ / tābhiś ca ramamāṇābhir āvṛtaṃ śivapūjanam
nīlotpaladalair bilvair mallikājātikundakaiḥ / śūnyaṃ prapūjitaṃ yāvattāval liṅgaṃ samutthitam
pātālādāgataṃ liṅgaṃ jvalat kālānalaprabham / rameśvareti vikhyātaṃ ramamāṇāt samutthitam
strīṇāṃ uvāca deveśaḥ śāpamokṣo bhavatv iti / gacchantu sarvāḥ svagṛhaṃ sāmprataṃ gatakalmaṣāḥ
ityuktvā devadeveśas tatraivāntaradhīyata / tasmiṃs tīrthe naraḥ snātvā sa bhave na punarbhavet
anāśakena cāgnau hi ye mṛtā na punarbhavāḥ / tilodakaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu piṇḍadānaṃ yathāvidhi
śrāddhenaiva ca dānena pitṝṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ / indreṇa brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ viṣṇunā dhanadena ca
rakṣasā rāvaṇenātha tathā cendrajitā nṛpa / japo japtas tapas taptaṃ yajñāni vividhāni ca
kṛtāni nṛpaśārdūla gatā hi paramāṃ gatim / anyac ca kathayiṣyāmi hāriṇaṃ tīrtham uttamam
hariṇeśaṃ siddhaliṅgaṃ tathā vai dhanurīśvaram / bāṇeśvaraṃ paraviddhi tathā vai lubdhakeśvaram
liṅgarūpāṇi pūjayitvā śivaṃ vrajet / ākhyānaṃ kathayiṣyāmi purāvṛttaṃ yudhiṣṭhira
arjuno lubdhako nāma mandajātisamudbhavaḥ / paryaṭan mṛgayāṃ rājan narmadātīramāgataḥ
dṛṣṭvā yūthaṃ mṛgāṇāṃ tu dhāvamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ / palāyamānāḥ sarve te ekaḥ paścāt sthito mṛgaḥ
hato madhyadine so 'dya kuraṅgo narmadātaṭe / patito 'sau gataprāṇo divyadehadharaḥ punaḥ
vimāne haṃsayukte vai brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha / gate tu hariṇe so 'tha lubdhakaś cintayānvitaḥ
mahāpāpāny anekāni kṛtāni tu mayā punaḥ / kā gatiṃ yāmyahaṃ cātha śreyase maraṇaṃ mama
cintayitvā tato rājan patito narmadājale / tatkṣaṇād divyadeho 'sau gandharvapuram āyayau
gate tasmin devaloke dhanurbāṇau jale sthitau / catvāry etāni liṅgāni khyātāni bhuvanatraye
hariṇeśvaraṃ ca bāṇeśaṃ lubdheśaṃ dhanurīśvaram / rameśvaraṃ pañcamaṃ tu pañcaliṅgāni kīrtayet
na tasya punarāvṛttir ghore saṃsārasāgare / tasmiṃs tīrthe naro rājan snātvā śivapuraṃ vrajet
brahmahatyādi pāpāni vilayaṃ yānti pārthiva / anāśake cārdhajale mṛtaḥ śivamavāpnuyāt

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe rameśvarahariṇeśvaralubdhakeśvaradhanurīśvarabāṇeśvarakathano nāma tryaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 84 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: tatra snātvā tu bhaktyā ya upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ / kṣapājāgaraṇaṃ kuryād dadyād dānaṃ ca yatnataḥ
devasya snapanaṃ kuryād amṛtaiḥ pañcabhis tathā / samālabhed yathāśaktyā pūjāṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ
pātraṃ parīkṣya dātavyam ātmanaḥ śreya icchatā / pitaras tasya tṛpyanti dvādaśābdaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
gacchati tatra dātā ca yatra devo nirañjanaḥ / gṛhamadhye praviṣṭas tu smaran nāmāsya śaktitaḥ
nīlādrau tu ca yatpuṇyaṃ tat samastaṃ labheta saḥ / śūlabhede ca yaḥ kuryāc chrāddhaṃ parvaṇi parvaṇi
viśeṣāc caiva māsānte tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu / kedāre caiva yatpuṇyaṃ kubjāyāṃ ca tathā nṛpa
kanakhale caiva yat puṇyaṃ gaṅgāsāgarasaṅgame / sitāsite tu yat puṇyam anyatīrthe viśeṣataḥ
arbude caiva yatpuṇyaṃ puṇyam cāmaraparvate / gaṅgādyaiḥ sarvatīrthaiś ca phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
asmiṃs tīrthe tathā puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ / vidhimantrasamāyuktaṃ tarpayet pitṛdevatāḥ
kulāni tārayatyeva daśa pūrvāparāṇi saḥ / dakṣiṇāṃ caiva martyaś ca śucir bhūtvā samāhitaḥ
nyāsaṃ kṛtvā tu pūrvoktaṃ pradadyād aṣṭapuṣpakam / śāstroktair aṣṭabhir mantrair mānasaiḥ śṛṇu tāṃs tathā
vārijaṃ saumyam āgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ pārthivaṃ punaḥ / vānaspatyaṃ bhavet puṣpaṃ prājāpatyaṃ tu saptamam
aṣṭamaṃ śivapuṣpaṃ ca śṛṇv eteṣāṃ vinirṇayam / vārijaṃ salilaṃ jñeyaṃ saumyaṃ madhuyutaṃ payaḥ
āgneyaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ ca vāyavyaṃ candanādikam / pārthivaṃ kandamūlādyaṃ vānaspatyaphalātmakam
prājāpatyam annādyaṃ ca śivapuṣpam upāsanam / ahiṃsā prathamaṃ puṣpaṃ puṣpamindriyanigrahaḥ
tṛtīyaṃ ca dayāpuṣpamebhis tuṣyanti devatāḥ / tapasā cārcayed bhaktyā atra tīrthe narādhipa
chatraṃ ca cāmaraṃ dadyāc chayyāṃ copānahau tathā / tena pūjanamātreṇa pūjitāḥ puruṣās trayaḥ
svargaloke vaset tāvad yāvad āhuta saṃplavam / śūlapāṇes tu yo bhaktyā snapanaṃ caiva kārayet
pañcāmṛtena yaścaiva yakṣakardamakuṃkumaiḥ / samālabhec ca deveśaṃ śrīkhaṇḍairagarādibhiḥ
nānāvidhaiś ca puṣpaiś cārcāṃ kurvanti ye dvijāḥ / rudraṃ puruṣasūktaṃ ca loke yaḥ svasvasūtrakam
iṣe tvādikamantrādi jyotir brāhmaṇam eva ca / gāyatrī ca madhuścaiva maṇḍalabrāhmaṇam eva ca
etaj japaṃ tu ye bhaktyā yajurvedasamudbhavam / devavrataṃ nāma daivyaṃ puruṣās tatpuraṃ yayuḥ
āsīt purā mahārāja andhako nāma durjaya / ārādhayāmāsa śivaṃ cirakālam upasthitaḥ
prasanno bhagavān devo varaṃ yācasva suvrata / varaṃ labdhvā tadā daityo 'dhāvat saharṣato 'ndhakaḥ
pure janāś ca dṛśyante bhājanair ratnapūritaiḥ / sākṣatair bhājanais tasya śatasāhasrayoṣitaḥ
mantrān paṭhanti viprāś ca māṅgalyanisvanena ca / bhūpaṃ cāmātyabhṛtyaiś ca rājyāśvarathadantibhiḥ
vardhāpayanti te sarve ye kecit puravāsinaḥ / hṛṣṭaḥ puṣṭo vasaṃs tatra sa surair nābhibhūyate
varalabdhaṃ tu taṃ jñātvā gīrvāṇāḥ śaṅkitās tadā / ekībhūtāś ca te sarve śakrasya śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ
samāgatān surān dṛṣṭvā śakro vacanam abravīt / kathaṃ samāgatās sarve yūyaṃ ca tridivaukasaḥ
kathaṃ ca bhayam utpannaṃ kathayadhvaṃ mahāsurāḥ
devā ūcuḥ: mṛtyuloke 'bhavat pāpas tv andhako nāma durmadaḥ
tasmāc ca bhayamāpannā bhavac charaṇam āgatāḥ / etasminn antare raudro dānavo baladārpitaḥ
ekākī syandanārūḍha āyudhair vividhair yutaḥ / andhako rājaśārdūla yayau śakrapurīṃ tataḥ
svarṇaprākārasaṃyuktāṃ śobhitāṃ vividhair gṛhaiḥ / durgamāṃ śatruvargasya sadā pārthivasattama
praviveśāsuras tatra līlayā svagṛhaṃ yathā / samutthāya tataḥ śakraḥ svakīyaṃcāsanaṃ dadau
upaviṣṭo 'ndhakas tatra śakrasyaivāsane śubhe / śakra uvāca: kiṃ vo hy āgamanaṃ cātra kiṃ kāryaṃ kathayasva me
yadasmadīyaṃ vittaṃ ca tatte dāsyāmi dānava / andhaka uvāca: na cāhaṃ kāmaye vittaṃ na gajān na turaṃgamān
svakīyaṃ darśayasvādya svargaśṛṅgārabhūmikam / airāvataṃ mahānāgaṃ saindhavoccaiḥ śravohayam
urvaśyādīni sarvāṇi vāditratritayāni ca / anyāḥ svīyā vibhūtīś ca darśayasva śacīpate
tasyaitad vacanaṃ śrutvā śakro 'pi bhayavihvalaḥ / sarvāṇi ca padārthāni darśayāmāsa cāndhakam
tadāgatya suraiḥ sārdhaṃ yakṣagandharvakinnaraiḥ / nṛtyanty apsarasas tatra vāditrair vividhair nṛpa
tat tasya vibhramac cittaṃ dṛṣṭvāpy apsarasas tadā / tena devagaṇās sarve trastāḥ pārthivasattama
saṃgrāmair vividhais tatra cakravajrāribhīṣaṇaiḥ / santāpitāḥ surās sarve kṣayaṃ nītā hy anekaśaḥ
āditya marutād yāś ca bhagnās saṃgrāmamaṇḍale / yathā siṃhakarākrāntāḥ śvāpadā vyacaran vane
tad vad ekena te devāḥ kṛtās sarve parāṅmukhāḥ / balād deśeṣu grāmeṣu prajāḥ pīḍayate 'niśam
ākampya gṛhyate kṣīraṃ śākaṃ vāsas tathaiva ca / na sammāne vacas teṣāṃ prajāsantāpane rataḥ
gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ ca dānavo 'pi gṛhaṃ gataḥ / tataḥ surāś ca śakraś ca brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ
gajaiś ca parvatākārair aśvaiś caiva gajopamaiḥ / syandanair gaganākāraiḥ siṃhaśārdūlayojitaiḥ
kacchapair makaraiś cāpi mṛgameṣais tathoragaiḥ / brahmalokamanuprāptā devāś cendrapurogamāḥ
dṛṣṭvā padmodbhavaṃ devaṃ praṇamyeśaṃ pratuṣṭuvuḥ / jayadeva jagannātha jayasaṃbhūti kāraka
padmayone suraśreṣṭha tvām eva śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ / sodvegaṃ bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā devānāṃ bhāvitātmanām
meghagambhīrayā vācā brahmā provāca vāsavam / kiṃ vo hyāgamanaṃ devās sarveṣāṃ vai vivarṇatā
kenāvamānitās sarve tatsarvaṃ me nivedyatām / devā ūcuḥ: anyako nāma nāmneti dānavo baladarpitaḥ
tena devagaṇās sarve dhanaratnair vivarjitāḥ / hatvā devagaṇān nātha parśucakrāsitomaraiḥ
gṛhītvā śakrabhāryāṃ vai dānavo vigato balāt / tataḥ śrutvā vacas teṣāṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ
cintayāmāsa bhagavān vadhaṃ tasya tu rakṣasaḥ / avadhyo dānavaḥ pāpaḥ sarvair api surāsuraiḥ
tataḥ pratuṣṭuvuḥ sarve devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ / jaya tvaṃ deva deveśa lakṣmyā cārdhaśarīravān
āśu rakṣaya deveśa tasmāt te śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ / janārdana uvāca: svāgataṃ vo mahābhāgā bruvatāṃ caiva svāgatam
kiṃ kāryaṃ procyatāṃ sarvaṃ kāraṇaṃ yanmayepsitam / parābhavaḥ kṛto yena sa gacchatu yamālayam
evamuktās surās sarve kathayanti sma tattvataḥ / pradarśayanti cāṅgāni vepamānās tv adhomukhāḥ
hṛtarājyāḥ kṛtā nātha andhakena parājitāḥ
piteva putrān parirakṣa deva jahīha śatruṃ saha putragotraiḥ / tatheti coktvā kamalāsanaṃ prabhuḥ surāsurair vanditapādapīṭhaḥ

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe 'ndhakopākhyāne caturaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 85 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ pāśaṃ saṃgṛhya parameśvaraḥ / utthitaḥ śayanāt tūrṇaṃ devānāṃ ca jayapradaḥ
keśava uvāca: pātāle yadi vā svarge martye vā yadi vā surāḥ / andhakaṃ taṃ vadhiṣyāmi yena santāpitās surāḥ
gacchantu svagṛhaṃ devās santoṣe bhāvitātmanaḥ / viṣṇos tu vacanaṃ śrutvā brahmādyās tu savāsavāḥ
svaṃ svaṃ yānaṃ samāruhya hṛdi tuṣṭā divaṃ yayuḥ / tato devo mādhavas tu yatra tiṣṭhati cāndhakaḥ
tatra gatvā hṛṣīkeśa āgneyāstraṃ mumoca ha / dṛṣṭvā jvalantaṃ cāgneyaṃ keśavena visarjitam
visarjayāmāsa tadā vāruṇaṃ cāstram uttamam / vāruṇāstreṇa bāṇena āgneya śoṣitaṃ tadā
andhakaś cintayāmāsa kena bāṇo visarjitaḥ / kasyeyaṃ pauruṣī śaktiḥ ko yāsyati yamālayam
tato 'ndhakaḥ kopayukto bāṇamārgasya saṃcaran / dṛṣṭvā yuddhapathe prāptaṃ devaṃ taṃ cāndhako 'bravīt
na śarma prāpnuṣe cātra mama dṛṣṭyā nirīkṣitaḥ / tathā na śaknuṣe tvaṃ tu śārdūlād gavayo hare
āgataṃ ca yathābhakṣaṃ mārjārasya ca mūṣakam / tathā na śaknuṣe tvaṃ tu saṃsthito 'pi mamāgrataḥ
tatas tu deva deveśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam / caturbhujāvadāt taṃ ca dvandvayuddhapradāyinam
dṛṣṭvā gadādharaṃ devaṃ sāṣṭāṅgaṃ praṇato bhuvi / andhaka uvāca: jaya kṛṣṇa parastvaṃ hi viṣṇo jiṣṇo namo namaḥ
hṛṣīkeśāya keśāya jagaddhātre 'cyutāya ca / namaḥ paṅkajanābhāya namaḥ paṅkajamāline
janārdanāya devāya pītāmbaradharāya ca / govindāya namo nityaṃ namaścodadhiśāyine
namaḥ karālavaktrāya nṛsiṃhāya ninādine / śārṅgiṇe smitavaktrāya śaṅkhacakragadābhṛte
namo vāmanarūpāya krāntalokatrayāya ca / namo varāharūpāya yajñarūpāya te namaḥ
vāsudeva namastubhyaṃ namaḥ kaiṭabhanāśine / vasudevasutaśceśa namaste suranāyaka
viṣṇo devādhideveśa jagaddhātaḥ prajāpate / praṇāmaṃ ye 'pi kurvanti tebhyaś cāpi namo namaḥ
samastabhūtadevāya vāsudevāya dhīmate / tasmai yajñavarāhāya viṣṇave 'mitatejase
guṇānāṃ hi vidhānāya namaste 'stu punaḥ punaḥ / deva uvāca: tuṣṭo hy ahaṃ dānavendra varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam
dadāmi te varaṃ cādya yācamānasya sāmpratam / andhaka uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si me deva varaṃ dātum ihecchasi
tadā dadasva me deva yuddhaṃ paramaśobhanam / śrībhagavān uvāca: kathaṃ dadāmi te yuddhaṃ toṣito 'haṃ tvayā punaḥ
na tvāṃ prati bhavet kopaḥ kathaṃ yudhye 'ham andhaka / yadi te vartate buddhir yuddhaṃ prati na saṃśayaḥ
tarhi tvaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ vai devaṃ prati maheśvaram / andhaka uvāca: prasādāt tasya devasya vijayī bhuvanatraye
kathaṃ yuddhaṃ care tena śaṅkareṇa vadasva naḥ / etac chrutvā dānavasya bhagavān abravīd idam
ahaṃ te kathayiṣyāmi yena yuddhaṃ tvayā saha / kailāsaśikharaṃ gatvā dhunu taṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ
dhunite parvate tasmin kampitaṃ bhuvanatrayam / patanti śikharāgrāṇi śīryamāṇānyanekaśaḥ
catvāraḥ sāgarā rājannekībhūtāḥ samantataḥ / umayā sahito rudro viṣayāsaktacetanaḥ
kampamānaś ca patitaḥ pārvatyā saha śaṅkaraḥ / gāḍhamāliṅgya deveśam umā vacanam abravīt
kimarthaṃ kampate śailaḥ kathaṃ vai kampate dharā / pātālāni tu saptaiva kampate svargasaptakam
kiṃ vā yugakṣayo deva tan mamākhyātum arhasi / maheśvara uvāca: kasyaiṣā durmatir jātā 'pi pārśvacarasya nu
lalāṭe ced ayaṃ bhagnaḥ prayāsyati yamālayam / kailāse saṃsthito dhyāne supto 'haṃ pratibodhitaḥ
vadhiṣye taṃ na sandehaḥ ṣaṇmukho vā bhaved yadi / tataḥ sa cintayāmāsa jānātītyandhako 'py ayam
upāyaṃ cintayāmāsa yenāsau vadhyate kṣaṇāt / tatas samāgatā devā indrabrahmapurogamāḥ
rathaṃ devamayaṃ kṛtvā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam / kecid devāḥ sthitāś cakre kecit tuṇḍāgrasaṃsthitāḥ
kecidakṣe sthitā rājan yugaraśmiṣu saṃsthitāḥ / rathastambhe dhvajāgre tu kecid anyatra saṃsthitāḥ
evaṃ devamayaṃ kṛtvā samārūḍho jagatprabhuḥ / niryayau dānavo yatra krodhenā 'pi maheśvaraḥ
dānavānardayāmāsa ākāśaṃ cāśumān iva / na tatra dṛśyate sūryo na kāṣṭhā na ca candramāḥ
tato dānavarājena āgneyāstraṃ suyojitam / dahyamānaṃ śarais tatra sarvaṃ gīrvāṇamaṇḍalam
dahyamānāḥ śaraiś caivaṃ devaṃ śaraṇamāyayuḥ / tato devādhidevena vāruṇāstraṃ visarjitam
vāruṇāstreṇa tenaiva āgneyāstraṃ praśāmitam / dānavena tato muktaṃ vāyavyāstraṃ nṛpottama
pannagāstraṃ ca devo 'pi kopāviṣṭaḥ pramuktavān / māruto bhakṣitaḥ sarpaiḥ krodhāviṣṭair na saṃśayaḥ
dānavena tadā muktaṃ garuḍāstraṃ balīyasā / tena tac chatadhā nītaṃ pannagāstraṃ na dṛśyate
tato devādhidevena nārasiṃhaṃ visarjitam / astrairastrāṇi saṃvārya yudhyete ca parasparam
samaṃ yuddham abhūt tāta surāsurabhayaṅkaram / cakreṇālīkanārācaistomaraiḥ khaḍgamudgaraiḥ
vatsadantais tathā bhallaiḥ karṇikāraiś ca śobhanaiḥ / evaṃ na śakyate hantuṃ dānavair vividhāyudhaiḥ
tato daṃṣṭrākarālena khaḍganārācatomaraiḥ / śvaśrūn dṛṣṭvā yathā yāti lajjamānā hy adhomukhī
na saṃspṛśanti gātrāṇi śastā gauḍavadhūryathā / āyudhāni tatas tyaktvā bāhuyuddham upasthitau
karaiḥ karāṃs tu saṃgṛhya praharantau hi muṣṭibhiḥ / bandhaiḥ karaprahārādyair yudhyete sma parasparam
dānavo 'pi ca taṃ devaṃ kakṣāntaram apīḍayat / niśceṣṭaś ca tadā devo mūrchitas tu maheśvaraḥ
mūrcchāgataṃ tu taṃ jñātvā cintayāmāsa dānavaḥ / hā hā kaṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ vādya pāpena ca durātmanā
kiṃ nu kāryaṃ mayā cātra kathaṃ vāpi vrajāmy aham / taṃ gṛhītvātha deveśaṃ gataḥ kailāsaparvatam
muktvā śayānammuccetam andhako 'pi yayau kṣaṇāt / tatas sa cetano bhūtvā devadevo maheśvaraḥ
yāvat paśyati cātmānaṃ svakīye bhavane sthitam / tāvat sa cintayāmāsa parābhūto durātmanā
krodhavegasamāviṣṭo niryayau dānavaṃ prati / āyasaṃ laguḍaṃ dhṛtvā prabhur bhārasahasrakam
dānavaṃ dṛṣṭavān devaḥ prākṣipat tasya mūrdhani / khaḍgena tāḍayāmāsa dānavaḥ prahasan raṇe
gṛhītvā deva deveśaḥ kauveraṃ bāṇamuttamam / hṛdaye tāḍayāmāsa jvalitena ca tatkṣaṇāt
tatas sa dānavas tatra rudhirodgāramudgiran / adhomukhas tato bhūtvā śūlena vidalīkṛtaḥ
śūlāgravikṣataḥ pāpaś cakravad bhramate tadā / ye tu bhūmau patanti sma dehato raktabindavaḥ
tebhya udabhavan pāpā dānavāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ / vyākulaś ca tato devo dānavaiś ca punaḥ punaḥ
devena saṃsmṛtā durgā cāmuṇḍā bhīṣaṇā tadā / āgatā bhīṣaṇā devī āyudhāyutasaṃyutā
mahādaṃṣṭrā mahākāyā piṅgākṣī lambakarṇikā / uvāca devī deveśaṃ samādiśa maheśvara
deva uvāca: piba tvaṃ rudhiraṃ bhadre yatheṣṭaṃ dānavasya ca / patitaṃ ca pṛthivyāṃ tu durge yatnād gṛhāṇa tat
dānavasya vadhe cādya sahāyaṃ kartum arhasi / tato hatāś ca te sarve khaḍgenāpi sahasraśaḥ
andhako 'pi ca tān dṛṣṭvā dānavān nidhanaṃ gatān / tato vāgbhiḥ supuṣṭābhiḥ stuvan devaṃ maheśvaram
tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti deveśaṃ caṇḍīṃ prati mahābalaḥ / śūlavikṣatarandhreṇa raktaṃ vai srāvayan bahu
pṛthivīṃ pūrayāmāsa catuḥ sāgaramekhalām / antarikṣe sthitenāpi śūlāgre saṃsthitena ca
skandhe dhṛtena devena rudhiraughapravarṣiṇā / pṛthivī pūritā tena saśailavanakānanā
rudhireṇa kaṭiṃ yāvad vārito 'pi maheśvaraḥ / tato hṛdayaparyantaṃ devasya ca samāgamat
vyākulāś ca tato devāḥ praṇaṣṭāś ca diśaṃ gatāḥ / sa tu svasya śarīrasya aṅgāny aṣṭau vyamardayat
aṣṭau bhairavarūpāś ca samutpannā maheśvarāt / daṃṣṭrākarālinaḥ sarve hāhākāraṃ prakurvataḥ
kharparāgrakarās sarve khaḍginaḥ kartinas tathā / pibantu rudhiraṃ sarvam ityāha parameśvara
pītaṃ tu taiś ca rudhiraṃ kṣīṇaṃ raktaṃ sthitaṃ sthalam / śarīraṃ śoṣitaṃ tasya asthicarmāvaśeṣitam
dānavaś cāndhakaḥ prāha antarikṣacaras tathā / andhaka uvāca: jayadeva jagannātha umāṅgārdhaśarīrabhṛt
vṛṣabhāsanamārūḍha śaśāṅkakṛtaśekhara / jayakhaṭvāṅgahastāya gaṅgāṃ śirasi dhāriṇe
smarapramathanāyeha īśvarāya namo 'stu te / pūṣṇodantavināśāya gaṇanātha namo namaḥ
jaya surūpadehāya arūpāya namo namaḥ / brahmottamāṅganāśāya viśveśvara sanātana
śmaśānavāsine nityaṃ nityaṃ bhairavarūpiṇe / tvaṃ sarvagaś ca kartā tvaṃ tvaṃ hartā nānya eva ca
tvaṃ bhūmis tvaṃ diśaś caiva jyotis tvaṃ tejasas tathā / tvaṃ vāyuḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ janturūpo maheśvaraḥ
tvaṃ somastvaṃ budhaś caiva tvaṃ gururbhārgavas tathā / sauristvaṃ devadeveśa bhūmiputras tathaiva ca
ṛkṣāṇi yāni dṛśyante gagane śaśibhāskarau / etāny eva ca sarvāṇi tvatprasādān maheśvara
evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ stutvā devadevaṃ sa dānavaḥ / saṃhatābhyāṃ ca hastābhyāṃ taṃ praṇamya maheśvaram
śaṅkara uvāca: sādhu sādhu mahāsattva varaṃ yācasva dānava / dātāhaṃ yācakas tvaṃ tu dadāmīti yathepsitam
andhaka uvāca: yadi tuṣṭo 'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama / tadātmanaḥ samīpe 'haṃ sthāpitavyo hi nānyathā
bhasmī jaṭī triśūlī ca trinetrī ca caturbhujaḥ / vyāghracarmottarīyaś ca nāgayajñopavītakaḥ
etadicchāmy ahaṃ sarvaṃ yadi dāsyasi śaṅkara / śūlāgrastho vadad yāvat tāvat tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ
īśvara uvāca: dadāmi te varaṃ cādya yas tvayā paribhāṣitaḥ / mayā tvam uditaḥ pūrvaṃ bhṛṅgirīṭir bhaviṣyasi

iti śrīskandapurāṇe revākhaṇḍe 'ndhakavarapradāno nāma pañcāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || rks adhyāya 86 mārkaṇḍeya uvāca: andhakasya varaṃ dattvā tenaiva saha śaṅkaraḥ / umayā sahitaścāpi kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gataḥ
tatas samāgatā devā brahmādyās saha vāsavāḥ / hṛṣṭapuṣṭāś ca te sarve maheśa taṃ praṇemire
deva uvāca: svāgataṃ vo mahābhāgā ye kecit tv iha cāgatāḥ / nihato dānavas tatra bhavadarthe na saṃśayaḥ
raktena tasya me śūlaṃ nirmalaṃ ca na dṛśyate / kartavyaṃ kiṃ mayā cādya kathyatāṃ hi pitāmaha
